jobs.title: Analyst, Financial Intelligence Unit
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB), located in New York City, is seeking an FIU Analyst to join our Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) in the Compliance department. CFSB offers a full range of banking services, including ACH settlement services, pre-paid card issuance, and retail banking. In addition to serving our general customer base, we also service various types of money service businesses and FinTech companies.

This individual will be responsible for performing financial intelligence reviews involving potentially unusual or suspicious activity across the Bank’s products, customers, and partner programs. Under established procedures and appropriate guidance, the FIU Analyst will review alerts and referrals, analyze transactional activity and customer information, conduct relevant internal and external research, document findings, recommend appropriate dispositions, and escalate matters requiring further investigation or consideration. The FIU Analyst will contribute to timely, accurate, and consistent FIU reviews and documentation.

The role is fully remote in 24 select states or hybrid for those located in the NYC Metro area.
This position supports ongoing hiring needs and may remain posted on a continuous basis. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and candidates may be considered for current or future openings.

Key Responsibilities

Review assigned transaction monitoring alerts, internal or external referrals, and other FIU work items in accordance with established procedures and timelines.
Review transactional activity, customer profiles, account history, prior investigations and filings, and relevant internal and external research to identify potential financial crime risk indicators and unusual patterns.
Prepare clear, complete, and accurate review documentation and case narratives that summarize activity reviewed, research performed, findings, and rationale.
Recommend alert or case dispositions based on available information and established guidance and promptly escalate potential suspicious activity or other matters requiring additional review.
Manage assigned work items and priorities to meet review deadlines and quality expectations.
Collaborate with FIU colleagues and seek guidance from experienced investigators or FIU leadership when questions or complex matters arise.
Identify and communicate observed trends, recurring issues, and potential process concerns to FIU management.
Develop knowledge of AML/BSA regulatory requirements, financial crime risks, enforcement trends, and relevant typologies through training and practical experience.
Assist with special projects and other FIU priorities, as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Ability and willingness to learn and apply AML/BSA requirements, financial crime concepts, suspicious activity monitoring processes, and SAR requirements through training and practical experience.
Ability to review transactional and customer information, recognize relevant risk indicators or unusual patterns, and document findings clearly.
Strong attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to manage a deadline-driven workload while following established procedures.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or related software; familiarity with transaction monitoring or case management systems is a plus.
Analytical, organizational, research, and problem-solving skills.
Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to summarize research and findings in a concise, organized manner.
Ability to follow procedures, work collaboratively, manage assigned tasks, and seek guidance when needed.

Education, Training, And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Criminal Justice, Risk Management, Compliance, or a related field; or equivalent education and work experience.
Entry-level position; prior professional experience in financial crimes compliance or investigations is not required. Relevant internship, coursework, or experience in banking, payments, fraud, compliance, investigations, data analysis, or research is preferred.
No prior AML/BSA, financial crime, transaction monitoring, or investigative experience is required; role-specific knowledge will be provided through training.
Interest in learning about banking operations, payment services, fintech partnerships, and the broader financial services ecosystem.
Interest in pursuing a relevant professional certification, such as CAMS or CFE, is a plus but not required.
Interest in developing knowledge of financial services industry risks, fraud and money laundering typologies, applicable regulations, fintech partnerships, and payment systems.

About Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB)

Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB) is a federally chartered bank founded in 2001 and headquartered in New York City. CFSB has focused on providing superior service and added value to clients though a solid understanding of relationship banking. We offer a full range of services, including loans, bill payments, card services, internet banking, and merchant processing.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military and/or veteran status, or any other Federal or State legally-protected classes.

jobs.title: Capacity Management Analyst I - HSO AMB CAPACITY MGMT & ACCESS - Mount Sinai Hospital - Full-Time M-F 9AM-5PM (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Description

Job Description

The Capacity Management Analyst I applies knowledge of the client’s clinical or business requirements, Epic Cadence application capabilities, and technical skills to implement and support advanced scheduling throughout the Ambulatory enterprise. The Capacity Management Analyst I will be a subject matter expert (SME) in Epic Cadence, client and Access Center operations workflows. The Capacity Management Analyst I is responsible for the implementation of new decision support systems and modifications to existing systems. The Capacity Management Analyst I is also responsible for the application configuration, go-live support, and on-going client support. He/she works on multiple projects concurrently. The Capacity Management Analyst I provides outstanding client service and contributes to the organization’s mission of utilizing information technology to improve patient care while driving the migration to Epic-powered solutions which will optimize patient access across the Ambulatory enterprise.

Responsibilities

Build, test, and implement decision support across various decision support for specialties across Ambulatory. Maintain decision support system for accuracy of scheduling by Access Centers.
Intimate knowledge of Epic Cadence and advanced scheduling methodology.
Pro-actively assist with escalated operational management and client issues. Be a resource for all stakeholders to address internal and external client needs or concerns. Resolve operational/administrative inquiries for Access Centers and Ambulatory clients.
Provide consultative services to clients regarding desired outcomes and offer recommendations / solutions to Cadence related scheduling concerns, including decision support system and / or template management.
Provide consultative services to Digital and Technology Partners on tickets regarding template change requests from operational clients.
Provide go-live and roll-out support collaborating with Access Centers, Ambulatory and DTP. Support users on new Epic applications, modules, and functionality.
Analyze multiple data streams to improve the delivery of coordinated scheduling. Identify areas of improvement to increase scheduler accuracy and efficiency.
Assess impact of day-to-day change requests on centralized templates and decision trees, testing all change requests through different Epic environments in coordination with DTP to ensure process standards.
Implement and innovate processes which drive accuracy operational efficiency to provide highest level of client service.
Successful completion of all Advanced Scheduling assigned tasks and projects in timely manner.
Track and trend performance data. Quickly identify trends to resolve issues prior to causing a disruption in service delivery.
Increase throughput and efficiency of ambulatory scheduling with a focus on Access Centers.
Frequent engagement with Capacity Management leadership as an access and scheduling optimization Subject Matter Expert.

Qualifications

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree preferred (or High School Degree with equivalent knowledge, skills, experience)

Experience Requirements

1-2 years healthcare experience in outpatient setting, including experience in healthcare operations, medical office administration, and/or with healthcare information systems
Epic knowledge (Cadence, Prelude, etc.)
Microsoft Office knowledge (Outlook, Word, Excel, Visio preferred)

Employer Description

Strength through Unity and Inclusion

The Mount Sinai Health System is committed to fostering an environment where everyone can contribute to excellence. We share a common dedication to delivering outstanding patient care. When you join us, you become part of Mount Sinai’s unparalleled legacy of achievement, education, and innovation as we work together to transform healthcare. We encourage all team members to actively participate in creating a culture that ensures fair access to opportunities, promotes inclusive practices, and supports the success of every individual.

At Mount Sinai, our leaders are committed to fostering a workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We strive to create an environment where collaboration, fairness, and continuous learning drive positive change, improving the well-being of our staff, patients, and organization. Our leaders are expected to challenge outdated practices, promote a culture of respect, and work toward meaningful improvements that enhance patient care and workplace experiences. We are dedicated to building a supportive and welcoming environment where everyone has the opportunity to thrive and advance professionally. Explore this opportunity and be part of the next chapter in our history.

About The Mount Sinai Health System

Mount Sinai Health System is one of the largest academic medical systems in the New York metro area, with more than 48,000 employees working across eight hospitals, more than 400 outpatient practices, more than 300 labs, a school of nursing, and a leading school of medicine and graduate education. Mount Sinai advances health for all people, everywhere, by taking on the most complex health care challenges of our time — discovering and applying new scientific learning and knowledge; developing safer, more effective treatments; educating the next generation of medical leaders and innovators; and supporting local communities by delivering high-quality care to all who need it. Through the integration of its hospitals, labs, and schools, Mount Sinai offers comprehensive health care solutions from birth through geriatrics, leveraging innovative approaches such as artificial intelligence and informatics while keeping patients’ medical and emotional needs at the center of all treatment. The Health System includes more than 9,000 primary and specialty care physicians; 13 joint-venture outpatient surgery centers throughout the five boroughs of New York City, Westchester, Long Island, and Florida; and more than 30 affiliated community health centers. We are consistently ranked by U.S. News & World Report's Best Hospitals, receiving high "Honor Roll" status, and are highly ranked: No. 1 in Geriatrics, top 5 in Cardiology/Heart Surgery, and top 20 in Diabetes/Endocrinology, Gastroenterology/GI Surgery, Neurology/Neurosurgery, Orthopedics, Pulmonology/Lung Surgery, Rehabilitation, and Urology. New York Eye and Ear Infirmary of Mount Sinai is ranked No. 12 in Ophthalmology. U.S. News & World Report’s “Best Children’s Hospitals” ranks Mount Sinai Kravis Children's Hospital among the country’s best in several pediatric specialties. The Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai is ranked No. 11 nationwide in National Institutes of Health funding and in the 99th percentile in research dollars per investigator according to the Association of American Medical Colleges. Newsweek’s “The World’s Best Smart Hospitals” ranks The Mount Sinai Hospital as No. 1 in New York and in the top five globally, and Mount Sinai Morningside in the top 20 globally.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The Mount Sinai Health System is an equal opportunity employer, complying with all applicable federal civil rights laws. We do not discriminate, exclude, or treat individuals differently based on race, color, national origin, age, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are deeply committed to fostering an environment where all faculty, staff, students, trainees, patients, visitors, and the communities we serve feel respected and supported. Our goal is to create a healthcare and learning institution that actively works to remove barriers, address challenges, and promote fairness in all aspects of our organization.

Compensation

The Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides salary ranges that comply with the New York City Law on Salary Transparency in Job Advertisements. The salary range for the role is $65885 - $98827 Annually. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and operational need. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentive, differential pay or other forms of compensation or benefits.

We're looking for experienced GRC professionals to help evaluate and improve AI systems being trained on real-world security, compliance, and risk scenarios. Review and analyze security policies, controls, and procedures for accuracy and completeness

Apply your real-world GRC experience to identify nuanced reasoning errors in AI outputs
Provide structured, precise written feedback using defined evaluation guidelines

2+ years of hands-on experience in GRC, compliance, risk management, or information security
Solid familiarity with one or more major frameworks: SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, PCI-DSS, or similar
Comfortable reading and critically interpreting policy documents, audit reports, and control frameworks
Detail-oriented with strong written reasoning and analytical communication skills
Self-motivated and able to work independently on asynchronous, task-based assignments

Experience with data annotation, quality assurance, or AI evaluation workflows
Background in internal audit, third-party risk, or security consulting
Familiarity with GRC platforms or risk management tooling

Work directly on frontier AI projects with leading AI research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work on your schedule, at your own pace
Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
Contribute to meaningful work that shapes how AI reasons about real-world risk and compliance

jobs.title: Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Threat Intelligence Analyst (AI Training)

About The Role

We partner with the world's leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models — and we need experienced threat intelligence professionals to help us get it right.

As a Threat Intelligence Analyst, you'll apply your real-world expertise in adversary tracking, campaign analysis, and CTI workflows to help train and evaluate AI systems that need to understand how cyber threats actually work. Your knowledge of what separates genuine attacker behavior from noise is exactly what frontier AI needs.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week
Location: Fully Remote

What You'll Do

Analyze and classify threat reports, adversary campaigns, and attacker behavior across realistic scenarios
Evaluate indicators of compromise, TTPs, and end-to-end attack narratives for accuracy and consistency
Generate, structure, and validate threat intelligence data used to train and benchmark AI systems
Review AI-generated cybersecurity outputs and flag inaccuracies, gaps, or fabricated detail
Apply frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK to assess the quality and realism of AI reasoning about threats

Who You Are

2+ years of hands-on experience in threat intelligence, SOC operations, or security analysis
Familiar with MITRE ATT&CK, OSINT collection methodologies, or CTI workflows
Able to distinguish real attacker behavior from synthetic, noisy, or fabricated data
Strong analytical and written communication skills — you can explain complex threat activity clearly
Self-directed and comfortable working asynchronously on task-based assignments

Nice to Have

Experience writing threat intelligence reports or briefings
Familiarity with threat hunting, malware analysis, or incident response
Prior exposure to AI evaluation or data annotation workflows

Why Join Us

Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside top research labs
Fully remote and flexible — choose your own hours and workload
Freelance autonomy with meaningful, intellectually engaging work
Put your security expertise to use in a fast-growing, high-impact field
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

jobs.title: Director, Data Enablement & Analytics - Digital & Marketing
jobs.description:
About

Bloomingdale's makes fashion personal and fun, aspirational yet approachable. Our mission is to guide and inspire customers to make style a source of creative energy in their lives. Across all brand touchpoints, from Bloomingdales.com to our stores and emerging customer experiences, every colleague plays a critical role in bringing our mission to life. Our inclusive culture values innovation, collaboration, diverse perspectives, and customer-centered decision making.

Job Overview

Bloomingdale's is seeking a Director, Data Enablement & Analytics – Digital & Marketing to lead the strategy, governance, analytics, and measurement capabilities that support the Digital and Marketing organizations.

This leader is responsible for ensuring the business has the data foundations, measurement frameworks, reporting capabilities, and analytical insights needed to improve customer experiences, optimize marketing investments, and drive business growth. The role oversees both analytics delivery and the enablement capabilities required to scale decision-making, including data governance, KPI ownership, measurement standards, reporting frameworks, and data quality.

The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership, analytical expertise, and strong business acumen. They are comfortable influencing senior leaders, defining long-term roadmaps, developing talent, and translating complex data into actionable business recommendations.

Essential Functions

Define and lead the Digital and Marketing data, measurement, and analytics strategy, ensuring capabilities support enterprise objectives and customer growth priorities.
Own the Digital and Marketing data foundation, including governance, KPI definitions, reporting standards, measurement methodologies, data quality, and platform enablement.
Ensure the organization has the reporting, analytics, and decision-support capabilities necessary to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and guide investment decisions.
Partner with Marketing, Digital, Loyalty, Technology, Finance, Data Science, and Macy's Inc. teams to advance measurement capabilities, analytical maturity, and data enablement priorities.
Translate complex customer, digital, and marketing performance insights into strategic recommendations that influence business decisions, prioritization, and resource allocation.
Establish scalable operating models, prioritization processes, and team structures that ensure successful delivery of analytics and enablement initiatives.
Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing team of analytics leaders and individual contributors while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and business ownership.
Champion adoption of advanced analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, experimentation, and modern measurement practices that improve decision-making and business outcomes.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in Analytics, Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field preferred.
8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, measurement, digital analytics, marketing analytics, or related disciplines.
3+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading managers and developing high-performing teams.
Demonstrated success leading analytics and measurement functions within a complex, cross-functional organization.
Experience influencing senior leaders and driving data-informed business decisions.
Retail, ecommerce, digital, or customer-focused industry experience preferred.

Leadership & Technical Skills

Strong understanding of digital analytics, marketing measurement, customer behavior analytics, attribution, experimentation, and performance management.
Experience establishing analytics operating models, governance frameworks, KPI definitions, reporting standards, and measurement methodologies.
Strong technical aptitude with the ability to evaluate analytical approaches, challenge methodologies, guide technical teams, and partner effectively with Data Science, Engineering, and Technology organizations.
Working knowledge of modern analytics, cloud data, BI, and marketing technology ecosystems.
Proven ability to translate analytical findings and technical concepts into strategic business recommendations and measurable outcomes.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities.
Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a bias for action.

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at bloomingdalesJOBS.com.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB), located in New York City, is seeking an FIU Coordinator to join our Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) in the Compliance department. CFSB offers a full range of banking services, including ACH settlement services, pre-paid card issuance, and retail banking. In addition to serving our general customer base, we also service various types of money service businesses and FinTech companies.

This individual will provide administrative and coordination support to the FIU. The FIU Coordinator will prepare and gather documents and information for Section 314(b) requests and responses, subpoenas, and other information requests; coordinate Requests for Information with internal and external stakeholders; maintain accurate records and tracking logs; monitor deadlines; and escalate delays, gaps, or other issues requiring attention. The role is fully remote in 24 select states or hybrid for those located in the NYC Metro area.

This position supports ongoing hiring needs and may remain posted until headcount is available. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and candidates may be considered for current or future openings.

Key Responsibilities

Coordinate assigned FIU administrative requests and work items in accordance with established procedures, priorities, and deadlines.
Prepare, gather, organize, and quality-check documents and information needed to support Section 314(b) requests and responses, subpoenas, and other FIU information requests.
Coordinate Requests for Information with appropriate internal departments, program partners, financial institutions, and other stakeholders; communicate requirements and deadlines; and follow up on outstanding items.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Ability to collaborate effectively, handle confidential information with discretion, and recognize when matters should be escalated.

jobs.description:
Identity & Access Management (IAM) Analyst (AI Training)

We’re looking for a curious and detail-oriented Data Analyst who enjoys working with data and turning it into meaningful insights. In this role, you’ll help us understand what the numbers are telling us, identify trends, and provide information that helps the team make better decisions.
You’ll work closely with different teams to understand their needs, solve business problems, and present findings in a clear and practical way. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable asking questions, enjoys solving problems, and can explain data in a way that makes sense to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, organize, and analyze data from different sources to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Work with business teams to understand their goals, challenges, and reporting needs.
Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.
Use SQL to retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data from databases.
Identify patterns, trends, and potential issues that can help improve business performance.
Translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular reports for stakeholders.
Investigate data discrepancies and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
Support business planning and decision-making through data-driven analysis.
Look for opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, and analytical workflows.

Skills and Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Good working knowledge of SQL and data analysis techniques.
Experience with Excel and at least one data visualization tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for detail.
Ability to interpret data, recognize trends, and explain findings clearly.
Good communication skills and the ability to work with people across different teams.
A willingness to learn new tools, ask questions, and explore better ways of working.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in day-to-day work.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means more than preparing reports. It means helping the team understand what is happening in the business and why. You’ll be successful when your analysis answers important questions, your reports are reliable and easy to understand, and your insights help people make informed decisions.

We value someone who is thoughtful, dependable, and genuinely interested in understanding data. You don’t need to have every answer right away, but you should be comfortable exploring problems, learning from feedback, and working with others to find the right answers.

If you enjoy connecting the dots, finding meaning in numbers, and helping people make better decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description

Job Description

As a Senior Analyst, Analytics/Insights, you will drive business growth through data-driven insights, designing and delivering actionable dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, media partners, and stakeholders to plan, execute, and evaluate marketing initiatives, leveraging expertise in data analysis, visualization, and mining techniques. Utilizing Excel, data visualization tools, and other technologies, you will uncover trends, optimize performance, and inform strategic decisions across media delivery, website analytics, social media, and Customer Relationship Marketing (CRM).

A Day In The Life

Extract, validate, and interpret data from multiple marketing and database platforms, ensuring data quality and hygiene.
Leverage web and media analytic tools (Google Analytics, Adobe, DCM), customer databases, social listening tools, and research platforms to collect and summarize data.
Build automated dashboards (PowerBI, Tableau) and PowerPoint reports using summarized data sets, communicating insights effectively.
Design, implement, and validate media (UTM) and website (GTM) tags for accurate tracking and measurement.
Derive key findings from analyzing diverse data sources and communicate results orally or in writing, collaborating with senior analytics staff.
Interpret measurement plans, integrating KPIs and benchmarks into dashboards and reports to inform business decisions

What You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Media, Statistics, Finance, Mathematics, Accounting, or Computer Science, with coursework in Marketing, Media, and Data Analytics.
1+ year of experience in marketing analytics or related fields, with advanced skills in Excel, intermediate-to-advanced PowerPoint skills, and experience with programming languages (R, SAS, SPSS, SQL).
Experience with digital analytics tools (Google Analytics, Adobe, Webtrends, Google Tag Manager) and competency in dashboarding (Tableau, PowerBI, Google Data Studio, Datorama).
Ability to summarize disparate datasets leveraging various platforms (Excel, Tableau, PPT, SQL) and proficiency in website and media (UTM) tagging.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex business challenges using data-driven approaches, with adaptability to changing business needs and fast-paced environments.
Ability to bridge technical expertise with business understanding, driving informed decision-making and strategic insights.

jobs.description:
Why Stifel

Stifel’s Capital Structure Advisory group has over two decades of experience guiding companies, creditors, shareholders, and sponsors through complex financial restructurings, recapitalizations, and strategic transactions. With a track record of over 190 company representations, $450 billion in restructured debt, and $21 billion in M&A advisory, Stifel CSA is known for its intellectual rigor, creativity, and hands-on approach. Our professionals collaborate closely with Stifel’s industry bankers to provide clients access to the full spectrum of strategic alternatives. Most engagements are completed out-of-court and often remain confidential, underscoring our reputation for discretion and excellence.

Stifel CSA Has a Long Track Record With

Renegotiating credit facilities
Obtaining covenant waivers and amendments
Consummating exchange offers, tender offers and consent solicitations
Raising capital (bank loans, second lien, DIP financings, high yield, mezzanine loans, private equity and strategic investments)
Selling non-core assets or entire companies
Effectuating cross border and international restructurings
Providing expert valuation and related testimony
Liability management transactions
Pre-packaged / pre-arranged chapter 11 cases
Traditional restructurings under chapter 11

Past and current clients include: GNC, Carbon Health, Del Monte creditors, Commonwealth of Puerto Rico creditors, Yellow Corp. creditors, Lazydays, Checkers Restaurants, MOD Super Fast Pizza, CorEnergy Infrastructure Trust, Invacare, Rockport, Structurlam, Nice-Pak Products, Workhorse, Mallinckrodt creditors, Sequential Brands Group, TNT Crane & Rigging and Faraday Future.

What You'll Be Doing

Senior Analysts / Junior Associates will contribute meaningfully to active engagements and internal initiatives.

What We're Looking For

Senior Analysts / Junior Associates will contribute meaningfully to active engagements and internal initiatives. Responsibilities include:

Preparing presentation materials such as pitchbooks and summaries
Conducting in-depth industry and company research
Building and analyzing financial models to evaluate company projections and strategic alternatives
Supporting the development of industry databases and valuation analyses
Analyze credit agreements, indentures, and covenant compliance
Working closely with deal teams, including other junior and senior bankers

What You'll Bring

We seek candidates with strong academic performance, demonstrated leadership, and a passion for finance and restructuring. Ideal candidates will possess:

Exceptional quantitative and analytical skills
Superior attention to detail and disciplined work ethic
Strong verbal and written communication abilities
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
Financial modeling and/or accounting experience
Collaborative mindset and strong interpersonal skills

Education & Experience

Minimum Required: Bachelor's degree in Finance or related field
Minimum Required: 1-4 years experience in corporate restructuring, investment banking or similar field

Licenses & Credentials

Minimum Required: None

Systems & Technology

Minimum Required: None

Compensation Range

Salary: USD $125,000.00/Yr. - USD $200,000.00/Yr.

Actual salaries may vary, and may be based on several factors, including but not limited to each candidate’s qualifications, skills, and overall competencies for the position. The base salary is one component of Stifel’s overall compensation package for each individual employee. Other benefits and offerings include, but not limited to, discretionary bonuses, health / dental / vision / prescription insurance offerings, Stifel Total Health Connect, flexible spending accounts, tuition & certification assistance programs, paid time off, and much, much more! To view a more comprehensive list of Stifel’s current offerings, please visit https://www.stifel.com/careers/benefits. Applications are accepted until the position is filled.

About Stifel

At its core, the Stifel story is a journey of growth and optimism for the future. In our more than 125-year history, Stifel has evolved from a St. Louis-based brokerage house and is now a full-service investment bank, offering securities brokerage, trading, research, underwriting and corporate advisory services globally. Our expertise spans sectors and products in both public and private markets. We are driven by relationships, not transactions, and are committed to earning long-term trust from our clients.

Our investment banking division provides a broad range of industry-leading services to its clients, including merger and acquisition advisory services, debt and equity financings, balance sheet restructuring, and mutual thrift & insurance company conversions. The combination of a full-service product offering and more than 600 bankers’ deep domain and product expertise allows us to provide solutions that meet the evolving needs of our clients.

Stifel’s success is rooted in the power of our people and platform. We provide our employees an entrepreneurial environment that rewards collaboration and hard work. We are looking to engage with and hire talented candidates from all backgrounds – specifically, those who have the desire to expand their skills and realize ambitious goals. We are committed to a workplace that reflects the clients we serve and the communities where we live and work.

jobs.description:
Penguin Random House LLC

New York, 1745 Broadway, United States

remote

USD 70,500 - 75,000 (Yearly)

Company Description

Penguin Random House is the leading adult and children's publishing house in North America, the United Kingdom and many other regions around the world. In publishing the best books in every genre and subject for all ages, we are committed to quality, excellence in execution, and innovation throughout the entire publishing process: editorial, design, marketing, publicity, sales, production, and distribution. Our vibrant and diverse international community of nearly 300 publishing brands and imprints include Ballantine Bantam Dell, Berkley, Clarkson Potter, Crown, DK, Doubleday, Dutton, Grosset & Dunlap, Little Golden Books, Knopf, Modern Library, Pantheon, Penguin Books, Penguin Press, Penguin Random House Audio, Penguin Young Readers, Portfolio, Puffin, Putnam, Random House, Random House Children's Books, Riverhead, Ten Speed Press, Viking, and Vintage, among others. More information can be found at http://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/.

Job Description

Penguin Random House is seeking a Technical Product Analyst to join the Customer Operations team supporting Distrotheque (DTQ), our proprietary metadata and asset distribution platform. DTQ plays a critical role in distributing book metadata and digital assets to PRH customers and partners and continues to evolve alongside the changing needs of our business and the marketplace.

Reporting to the Director, Customer Operations & Product Management, the Technical Product Analyst will work closely with the team's Business Systems Analyst and internal technology partners to support the ongoing development, testing, and reliability of DTQ. This role will provide technical and analytical support throughout the product-development lifecycle, with particular focus on detailed requirements, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and release readiness.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how complex systems work, digging into technical and data-driven problems, and ensuring that software solutions function reliably and meet business requirements. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills and attention to detail with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

Specific responsibilities include:

Partner with the Business Systems Analyst and business stakeholders to translate business needs into detailed functional and technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Analyze DTQ workflows, business rules, data flows, integrations, and system dependencies to assess requirements and the impact of proposed changes.
Develop and execute comprehensive functional, regression, integration, and release testing for enhancements, fixes, and new functionality.
Document, investigate, and track defects through resolution, partnering with technology teams to reproduce issues and validate fixes.
Build and maintain regression test coverage for critical DTQ functionality and identify opportunities to improve or automate testing practices.
Support Agile development activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirements clarification, and release preparation.
Troubleshoot production and operational issues, using data and system analysis to identify root causes and recommend sustainable solutions.
Monitor system processes and exception reporting, escalating issues and identifying recurring patterns or areas of risk.
Support production releases through testing, validation, documentation, and post-release monitoring.
Maintain clear functional, technical, testing, and process documentation to strengthen shared knowledge of DTQ.
Analyze data and system performance to identify opportunities for improved reliability, efficiency, automation, and product functionality.
Collaborate closely with the Business Systems Analyst, Customer Operations SMEs, and technology partners to ensure solutions meet documented requirements and broader business needs.

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in technical product analysis, business systems analysis, software quality assurance, or a related field.
Experience translating business needs into detailed functional or technical requirements.
Experience developing and executing software test plans, test cases, and regression testing.
Strong analytical and technical problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to investigate complex system or data issues.
Experience working with data and using it to troubleshoot issues and validate system behavior.
Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with both business and technical partners.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently and as part of a collaborative team.
Experience with metadata, digital asset management, distribution systems, or other complex data-driven platforms preferred.
Familiarity with ONIX and book industry metadata standards is a plus.
Experience with automated testing, scripting and structured data feeds is a plus.
Ops nerds welcome! 

Additional Information

This is position is open to remote.

Salary range for this position is $70,500 - $75,000.
Please apply using our online application process and include your résumé and cover letter. Full-time employees are eligible for our comprehensive benefits program.

Applications for this role will be accepted through October 27 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we review applications on a rolling basis. Before applying for any role at Penguin Random House, we recommend you review our
applicant resources page

FAQs page.

jobs.title: Portfolio Management Analyst
jobs.description:
THIS ROLE IS NOT ELIGIBLE FOR SPONSORSHIP OR RELOCATION. WE ARE TARGETING CANDIDATES ALREADY LIVING IN THE NYC METRO AREA.

Ils Experience Or Investment Management Experience Is a Requirement.

Are you ready to sit at the intersection of natural catastrophe risk, capital markets, and institutional investment management? Swiss Re ILS is looking for a curious, analytically driven professional to join our Portfolio Management team in the heart of New York City. This is a rare opportunity to build deep expertise in one of the most dynamic and specialized asset classes in the market — insurance-linked securities (ILS).

About The Role

As a Portfolio Management Analyst, you will play a meaningful role across the full investment management process — from evaluating and underwriting individual ILS transactions to contributing to portfolio construction, quantitative research, and investor support. You'll work alongside experienced portfolio managers, catastrophe modelling specialists, and reinsurance experts, leveraging Swiss Re's proprietary risk models and unparalleled market knowledge to deliver attractive risk-adjusted returns for institutional investors. If you thrive on complex problems, love working with data, and want to grow your career in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Investment Analysis & Underwriting

Evaluate and underwrite ILS investment opportunities, including new catastrophe bond issuances, resets, and secondary market transactions

Analyze natural catastrophe exposures, catastrophe modelling outputs, and transaction structures to assess investment risks and relative value

Review underwriting information, exposure data, and contractual features, leveraging Swiss Re's proprietary risk models and underwriting expertise

Engage with internal specialists and external counterparties — including catastrophe modelling teams, brokers, and transaction parties — to support sound investment decisions

Portfolio Management

Contribute to investment selection, relative value assessments, and portfolio positioning across ILS strategies

Analyze portfolio performance, risk concentrations, and market developments to inform investment strategies

Quantitative Analysis & Investment Research

Develop and enhance analytical tools and models to support underwriting, investment selection, portfolio optimization, and trading

Conduct quantitative research on catastrophe risk, market pricing, and investment opportunities

Leverage data analytics and programming to improve investment processes, portfolio monitoring, and decision-making

Collaboration & Investor Support

Collaborate across Swiss Re teams — including portfolio managers and catastrophe modelling specialists — to leverage the Group's deep expertise

Support investor relations and business development by providing investment analysis, portfolio insights, and risk assessments

Contribute to investment materials and analytical content tailored for institutional investors

About The Team

Swiss Re ILS is a third-party investment management business within Swiss Re's Alternative Capital Partners Group, managing insurance-linked securities portfolios on behalf of institutional investors. The Portfolio Management team oversees investment strategies focused on catastrophe bonds, industry loss warranties (ILW), quota shares, and other insurance-linked instruments. We combine Swiss Re's extensive natural catastrophe expertise, proprietary modelling capabilities, and deep reinsurance market knowledge with active investment management, quantitative analytics, and trading — all in a dynamic, fast-paced environment focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our investors.

About You

You are an intellectually curious, analytically minded professional with a genuine passion for the intersection of natural catastrophe risk, insurance, and financial markets. You enjoy tackling complex problems, diving deep into data, and translating quantitative analysis into clear, actionable investment insights. You're a motivated self-starter who thrives in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment and is excited by the opportunity to grow across underwriting, investment analysis, portfolio management, and trading within a leading institutional investment management business.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements

Undergraduate or graduate degree in a quantitative or analytical discipline such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, meteorology, economics, or finance

2+ years of relevant professional experience in investment management, ILS, reinsurance, catastrophe modelling, quantitative analysis, or a related field (a more senior candidate will also be considered)

Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to interpret complex data and modelling outputs

Experience with programming and data analytics, particularly Python; familiarity with SQL, Power BI, or similar tools is an advantage

Knowledge of or strong interest in natural catastrophe risk modelling, including the assessment of catastrophe exposures and loss distributions

These Are Additional Nice To Haves

Knowledge of ILS markets, catastrophe bonds, or other insurance-linked investment instruments

Experience in property catastrophe reinsurance, underwriting, or catastrophe risk

Familiarity with catastrophe modelling platforms, risk metrics,

Experience in quantitative investment research, portfolio analytics, or trading

Understanding of insurance and reinsurance structures, particularly the US property catastrophe market

Exposure to institutional asset management or third-party investment management

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across disciplines and present complex ideas clearly

Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus

The estimated base salary range for this position located in NYC, NY is $132,000 to $198,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

Job Description

Quantitative Analyst, Municipal Fixed Income

Your Team

The Quantitative Analyst will be part of the broader quantitative team supporting Invesco Fixed Income. The team develops market research, data, models, and analytical tools that strengthen investment decision-making, portfolio construction, and risk management. This role will focus on municipal strategies and work closely with portfolio managers and credit researchers on market, portfolio, and security-level questions. The analyst will also partner with quantitative, technology, and data colleagues to build reliable data and reusable analytical capabilities.

Your Role

As a Quantitative Analyst, you will combine municipal market knowledge, quantitative analysis, and practical implementation to support portfolio managers and credit researchers. You will identify and evaluate investment questions involving relative value, portfolio positioning, risk, performance, and market structure and build the tools needed to test and apply your ideas. You will have end-to-end responsibility for the municipal data supporting this work, from understanding source systems and resolving discrepancies to producing controlled analytical datasets. The role requires curiosity about markets and an interest in the daily work of turning data and investment ideas into reliable, useful analytics.

You Will Be Responsible For:

Generating and evaluating quantitative investment ideas related to municipal relative value, portfolio positioning, performance drivers, and market opportunities.
Measuring portfolio exposures on an absolute and benchmark-relative basis, including interest-rate, yield-curve, spread, credit, liquidity, and optionality risks.
Developing scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess how market changes could affect performance, volatility, distributions, and portfolio positioning.
Investigating differences between expected and realized performance, distinguishing market and economic drivers from data or model issues, and communicating findings to portfolio managers and credit researchers.
Evaluating leverage and funding risks, including tender option bond and variable-rate municipal term preferred exposures and their implications for total return, liquidity, and distributions.
Managing municipal data end to end, including acquisition, definitions, transformations, timing, lineage, quality controls, reconciliation, and availability across systems such as Perform and Aladdin.
Building and maintaining analytical tools and automated workflows for holdings, transactions, pricing, benchmarks, risk, and performance while reducing routine manual processing.
Partnering with investment, quantitative, technology, and data colleagues to test new ideas, implement useful analytics, and contribute reusable data, methods, and code to the broader platform.

The Experience You Bring:

Experience applying quantitative analysis to fixed-income markets, relative value, portfolio risk, performance attribution, or portfolio construction.
Knowledge of municipal securities, market conventions, portfolio structures, benchmarks, and sources of risk, or relevant fixed-income experience and a demonstrated ability to develop new market expertise.
Demonstrated ability to formulate investment or analytical questions and build practical tools, models, or applications to evaluate them.
Strong hands-on Python and SQL skills, including experience working with complex datasets and automating analytical workflows.
Experience investigating data from multiple systems, reconciling inconsistencies, establishing data-quality controls, and developing reliable analytical datasets.
Familiarity with modern development practices and platforms such as Git or GitHub, cloud infrastructure, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable technologies.
Experience using AI-assisted research or development tools to explore ideas, develop code, test analytical approaches, or improve productivity.
Strong judgment and communication skills, including the ability to connect technical analysis to market developments, portfolio exposures, and practical investment decisions.

Overview

The Energy Storage team within Dist Resource Integration is responsible for supporting Con Edisons strategy to advance the deployment and operation of bulk energy storage in New York City and Westchester County. The Contract Administration Manager will support the procurement, contracting, implementation, and ongoing administration of bulk energy storage projects and Utility Dispatch Rights arrangements.

The Contract Planning Analyst will manage complex contract-administration activities throughout the contract lifecycle, including procurement support, contract execution, project implementation, milestone tracking, performance monitoring, invoice and payment review, change management, amendments, claims, compliance, contract closeout, and contract administration. The position will work closely with Energy Storage, Procurement, Legal, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, Energy Management, Engineering, Distribution and Transmission Planning, project developers, contractors, consultants, and other internal and external stakeholders.

The successful candidate will apply strong commercial, analytical, organizational, and communication skills to support energy storage procurements and contractual arrangements. The position will identify and manage contract obligations, assess project and counterparty risks, resolve issues, and develop recommendations that support timely and effective decisions.

This position offers an opportunity to support projects that integrate distribution-system needs with wholesale energy market applications. The selected candidate will contribute to Con Edisons strategic clean energy goals, support New York States Climate Leadership and Community Protection Act objectives and help expand the Companys capabilities to contract for and administer energy storage services while maximizing customer benefits.

Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Assist in the day-to-day administration of complex contracts supporting bulk energy storage projects and Utility Dispatch Rights arrangements with third-party developers, owners, operators, vendors, and service providers.
Support the development and administration of competitive procurements for bulk energy storage projects and related services.
Coordinate with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk Management, Regulatory Affairs, Engineering, Energy Management, and operating organizations to support contract development, review, approval, and execution.
Assist in preparing requests for proposals, procurement schedules, evaluation materials, contract requirements, commercial exhibits, approval documents, and contract-award recommendations.
Maintain accurate contract files, obligation registers, milestone schedules, deliverable logs, approval records, notices, correspondence, and related documentation.
Track project and counterparty obligations, including development milestones, permitting, interconnection, construction, commercial operation, testing, dispatch availability, reporting, insurance, and other contractual requirements.
Monitor contract performance against scope, schedule, pricing, service levels, technical requirements, availability requirements, performance standards, and other contractual obligations.
Review invoices, payment requests, milestone submissions, credits, incentives, performance payments, liquidated damages, and other commercial submissions for completeness and compliance with contract terms.
Coordinate the review and resolution of contract deviations, change orders, claims, disputes, extensions, waivers, amendments, and other contract modifications.
Support the development, implementation, and administration of Utility Dispatch Rights commercial processes, including dispatch obligations, availability requirements, operating responsibilities, data requirements, reporting, metering, communications, and performance verification.
Support commercial and financial analysis of energy storage opportunities, including project costs, payment structures, contract risks, performance requirements, market participation, and potential customer benefits.
Identify and assess schedule, cost, performance, regulatory, market, operational, and counterparty risks associated with energy storage contracts.
Prepare contract-administration summaries, issue logs, decision papers, management reports, dashboards, presentations, and recommendations for senior management.

Position Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Senior Analyst - Category Management High Jewelry drives the development and execution of High Jewelry product strategy across new product development, pricing, assortment analysis, and lifecycle management. This role owns critical product and pricing data, drives cross-functional execution, and delivers accurate, timely, and decision-ready analysis to ensure the category is positioned to drive brand desirability, market growth, and commercial performance.

This position requires a highly reliable, detail-oriented, and analytically strong candidate who can operate with urgency, sound judgment, and limited oversight. The successful candidate will translate product data and market insights into compelling strategies, manage multiple priorities seamlessly, communicate proactively across functions, and deliver polished, executive-ready materials.

Location:
This position follows a hybrid schedule requiring 4 days in-office at our New York, NY location and 1 day remote.

Key Accountabilities

Product Development & Lifecycle Management

Own and drive the maintenance of image grids, product trackers, and SKU-level information throughout all stages of development, ensuring accuracy and consistency across shared files and merchandising systems.
Initiate and lead new development projects, achieving the timely completion of milestones autonomously (e.g. SKU creation, data maintenance, pricing updates, and sign-off).
Coordinate product reviews and lifecycle management actions, including obsolescence tracking and execution, to ensure the assortment remains relevant, productive, and aligned with category strategy.
Maintain key product files, including loose gemstone and diamond tracking to support development and launch execution.

Reporting & Assortment Analysis

Analyze and interpret category performance metrics, including sales, margins, inventory, and assortment productivity, to identify trends and develop actionable recommendations to be articulated in product briefs.
Support the creation and development of reports and presentations for leadership meetings, product reviews, and business updates, summarizing new product introductions and performance of current assortment.
Independently identify opportunities and risks within the category and present product strategy recommendations with confidence and clarity, outlining calculated risks and cost/benefit analysis needed to drive growth.
Conduct regular competitive analysis and market research to support category positioning and pricing strategies.

Pricing & Cost Analysis

Develop, model, and propose SKU-level pricing scenarios aligned with departmental pricing strategy, margin objectives, and competitive benchmarks.
Maintain accurate pricing files, support formal price change processes, and ensure overall gross margin targets are met.
Analyze manufacturing costs, product economics, and competitive pricing to support new product development and assortment decisions.
Exercise sound judgment in the face of uncertainty by balancing cost accuracy, timing constraints, and business priorities when escalating issues and recommendations to leadership, appropriately identifying sources of ambiguity and outlining risks to maintain forward momentum.
Determine retail replacement values for Valuation requests, estimate retails for Custom Design requests, and price new receipts.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication

Build credible working relationships with cross-functional teams to champion High Jewelry business needs, leading the creation of impactful presentations, category reports, and completing administrative tasks.
Act as a central point of coordination for category initiatives through strong planning, ensuring strong follow-through, alignment, and project continuity.
Proactively manage timely cross-functional communication of category updates, launch statuses, potential risks, strategic recommendations and completed actions without requiring follow-up.
Own and lead cross-functional meetings with ease and impact, ensuring timely progression of projects and closure of next steps.
Drive commercial support by providing timely, accurate product details and on-order visibility to support High Jewelry daily sales, events & special client requests.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree.
3-5 years of experience in Merchandising, Category Management, Product Marketing, or related analytical experience, preferably in luxury, jewelry, or fashion.
Proven ability to function effectively in a team environment.
Ability to manage and uphold departmental standards and business direction.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
Clear, concise, and compelling verbal and written communication skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI, with a demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt new software and business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, SAP).
Strong organizational and project management capabilities, with the agility to prioritize shifting deliverables, adapt to change, and consistently meet deadlines.
Process-oriented mindset focused on operational efficiency, optimization, and continuous improvement.
Familiarity with market research.
Strong aesthetic sensibility.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of the High Jewelry industry and/or gemstone expertise (Graduate Gemologist a plus)
Experience with complex and/or high value Development processes.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us

At Botrista, we are revolutionizing beverage culture with intuitive, Nature-guided drink-making technology. By empowering restaurants and establishments to expand their menus without added complexity, we are driving growth and innovation at the touch of a button. Awarded as one of the Best California Startups in 2023, our solutions create a new industry category, applicable to any cuisine, demographic, and business. With rapid deployment of our machines nationwide, we are delivering extraordinary beverage experiences to customers everywhere.

Position Summary

Botrista is seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Revenue Operations Analyst to help us better understand what drives revenue growth, customer performance, retention, and profitability across the business.

Reporting to the Revenue Operations Manager, this role will serve as a shared analytical resource across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance. The Revenue Analyst will connect data across Sales, Account Management, customer performance, deployments, operations, and financial results to identify trends, explain performance, uncover opportunities and risks, and support better business decisions.

This is not simply a reporting role. We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable digging into complex data, and able to move beyond what happened to understand why it happened and what we should do about it.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with commercial judgment and can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for business leaders.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Performance & Business Analysis

Analyze revenue performance against plan and identify the underlying drivers of variances.
Evaluate new customer revenue, recurring ingredient revenue, same-store performance, customer retention, expansion, cups sold daily (CSD), deployments, and other key revenue drivers.
Develop cohort and segmentation analyses across verticals, customer types, sales channels, territories, deal structures, acquisition sources, and other relevant dimensions.
Identify emerging trends, risks, anomalies, and growth opportunities before they become obvious in topline results.
Partner with Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance to develop a consistent view of commercial and financial performance.
Translate analysis into clear recommendations and business actions.

Sales Analytics

Analyze pipeline health, coverage, conversion, sales velocity, win/loss performance, quota attainment, and seller productivity.
Evaluate lead sources, territories, customer segments, ICP performance, and sales motions.
Support analysis of sales capacity, territory design, quotas, and resource allocation.
Measure the downstream quality of customers acquired by Sales, including deployment, utilization, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion.
Support deployment and revenue forecasting and analyze forecast accuracy over time.

Customer Revenue & Retention Analytics

Analyze CSD, ingredient consumption, recurring revenue, account health, attrition, and expansion across the installed base.
Identify leading indicators of customer growth and churn risk.
Develop customer cohorts and account segmentation to identify which characteristics correlate with strong long-term performance.
Analyze Account Management interventions to determine which activities actually improve customer revenue, retention, and expansion.
Help develop data-driven account prioritization and opportunity/risk scoring.
Quantify revenue at risk and potential revenue upside across the existing customer base.

Customer Economics & Revenue Quality

Help develop a holistic view of customer value across the full lifecycle:

Sale → Deployment → Live → Productive → Recurring Revenue → Retention → Expansion

Evaluate customer economics across verticals, deal structures, sales channels, customer profiles, and other meaningful segments.
Partner with Finance to incorporate margin, cost, and profitability considerations into commercial analysis.
Identify customer and program characteristics associated with higher long-term economic value.
Help the organization move beyond measuring success solely by sales or installations toward measuring the quality and durability of revenue created.

Forecasting, Planning & Scenario Modeling

Support commercial revenue and deployment forecasting.
Build and maintain analytical models for revenue growth, customer performance, capacity, retention, and other business drivers.
Partner with Commercial Planning and Finance on operating plans, forecasts, and scenario analysis.
Evaluate the expected impact of changes in headcount, productivity, pricing, customer mix, retention, CSD, deployment timing, and other key assumptions.
Perform sensitivity analyses to help leadership understand the range of potential business outcomes.

Reporting & Business Reviews

Build and maintain core Sales, Account Management, and revenue performance reporting.
Support weekly and monthly business reviews with analysis of key trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities.
Maintain consistent metric definitions and help establish a trusted source of truth across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance.
Improve existing reporting by eliminating low-value metrics and introducing measures that better reflect business performance.
Automate recurring analysis and reporting wherever practical.

Strategic & Ad Hoc Analysis

Support leadership with analytical work on high-priority business questions, including:

Which customer segments and verticals generate the greatest long-term value?
What predicts high CSD, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion?
Where are we losing revenue and why?
Which sales motions and acquisition sources produce the highest-quality customers?
Where should we add or reduce Sales and Account Management resources?
Which programs and initiatives are generating measurable incremental value?
Where are operational bottlenecks limiting revenue?
Which parts of the business should we scale, improve, or reconsider?
What are we not currently measuring that could materially change how we operate?

Cross-Functional Operating Model

The Revenue Analyst will be a shared analytical resource across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance.

The role reports to the Revenue Operations Manager, who will help prioritize the analyst's overall workload and ensure analytical work translates into commercial action. However, the analyst will work directly and regularly with Commercial Planning and Finance and will support important analytical and planning needs across all three functions.

Success requires operating as part of one analytical ecosystem rather than three separate teams. The expectation is to create shared definitions, shared data, and a common understanding of business performance while bringing the appropriate functional perspective to each analysis.

* Collaborate with families, BTs/RBTs, clinical leadership, schools, providers, and other members of the care team to support coordinated and clinically appropriate care.
* Maintain ownership of assigned caseloads, including authorized service hours, supervision requirements, scheduling, reassessments, treatment-plan updates, and required clinical documentation.

* Maintain compliance with BACB ethical requirements, New Jersey licensure requirements, payer/funding requirements, Step Up policies, and all applicable professional and regulatory standards.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or higher in Applied Behavior Analysis, Psychology, Education, or another qualifying related field.
* Demonstrated experience providing ABA services and developing individualized behavioral treatment interventions.
* Experience conducting FBAs, developing treatment/BSPs, analyzing clinical data, and modifying interventions based on client progress.
* Experience supervising, coaching, or developing BTs/RBTs or other direct-care clinical staff.
* Strong clinical decision-making, communication, organization, documentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively and independently across in-home and/or center-based environments while maintaining strong collaboration with families and the broader clinical team.
* Reliable transportation and ability to travel to assigned client homes, community settings, or Step Up centers as required.
* Must successfully meet all required background checks, fingerprinting, credentialing, training, and other employment requirements.

**Credential Requirements**

* Must hold and maintain an active Board-Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) certification through the Behavior Analyst Certification Board (BACB).

* Must maintain all continuing education, supervision, renewal, and other requirements necessary to keep applicable certification and licensure in good standing.

**Core Expectations:** Successful BCBA/LBAs at Step Up are expected to demonstrate:

* Clinical Excellence: Individualized, evidence-based and data-informed care.
* Leadership: Active development, coaching, and accountability of BTs/RBTs.
* Family Partnership: Respectful, collaborative relationships with children and caregivers.
* Ownership: Proactive management of caseloads, authorized services, documentation, and clinical responsibilities.
* Collaboration: Open communication and partnership across the clinical team.
* Integrity: Consistent ethical, professional, and compliant clinical practice.

You will be expected to coordinate across client, vendor, and internal teams to run thorough testing of our system for ongoing feature development.
