jobs.title: Tax Software QA & Support Analyst
jobs.description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
---------------------------------------

At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.

### **What's hard about this job**

**Bugs don't arrive with instructions.** A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.

**Your ticket is the fix's starting point.** Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.

**The pace is fast.** Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.

**It isn't fixed until you've checked.** You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.

### **Why it might be the best career move you'll make**

**You'll sit between customers and engineering.** Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.

**Your work ships.** A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.

**You'll grow as fast as we do.** Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.

We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.

### **What You'll Own**

* Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use
* Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away
* Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox
* Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving
* Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases
* Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread

### **Your Hard Skillset**

* Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team
* Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk
* A tax background, either at a tax or accounting firm, at a tax software company, or preparing returns yourself. You don't need to be a preparer, but you should know your way around a return.
* Familiarity with at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem
* Bonus if you've used Linear or Jira, browser developer tools or screen recording to capture issues

### **Your Soft Skillset**

* Methodical: you change one thing at a time until you find what breaks
* Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion
* Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did
* Calm and patient with customers who are under deadline pressure
* You take ownership and follow a problem through to the fix

### **Who This Suits**

* People who enjoy hunting down a problem more than answering the same question twice
* Support professionals who want to move into QA and product
* Tax professionals who want to move into tech without leaving their expertise behind

### **How We Pay**

Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone sees everyone else's salary, and compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone at the same level receives the same three offers.

This role is assessed at Level 1. The salary and equity bandings are:

* **Most Equity:** $77,000 per year + $100,020 of equity
* **Great Equity:** $84,000 per year + $66,680 of equity
* **Good Equity:** $91,000 per year + $33,340 of equity

We run performance reviews every four months, so strong work is recognized quickly.

### **Benefits**

* **Platinum-level medical insurance**, fully covered for you, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* **Dental insurance**
* **Vision insurance**
* **401(k)** retirement plan
* **Paid maternity and paternity leave**
* **A minimum of 30 days of paid holiday** every year
* **Your choice of the latest and greatest computers**, plus a budget for your home office setup
* **Company-wide offsites** every four months

### **The process**

* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Bug reproduction exercise: we give you a real-style customer report, you reproduce the issue and write the ticket (60 minutes)
* Final round with Rachel and the team (60 minutes)

### **About Filed**

Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms. It works inside the software firms already use, and takes on the work surrounding the accountant so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and their clients. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog and Raine.

jobs.title: Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Gap Inc.**
------------------

At Gap Inc., we create culture as much as we create clothes. Our ambition is to become a high-performing house of iconic American brands that shape culture.

Our portfolio—Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta—each brings a distinct point of view to how we show up in the world and serve our customers.

Old Navy democratizes style with quality and value for all. Gap champions originality through essential pieces that celebrate individuality. Banana Republic is rooted in a spirit of discovery, creating modern pieces inspired by craftsmanship and travel. Athleta champions the Power of She through confidence, strength, and movement.

We’re driven by a shared purpose: to bridge gaps—between people, perspectives, and possibilities—to create a better world.

We’re building a team that performs at a high level—people who think boldly, take ownership, and turn ideas into impact. If you’re ready to learn fast and help shape what’s next, you’ll fit right in.

**About the role**
------------------

The Pricing Optimization Associate supports pricing analytics and decision support across Gap brand. In this role, you will complete foundational analyses and prepare inputs for pricing strategy, price testing, competitive pricing insights, pricing architecture, promotion scenario planning, markdown optimization, yield management, and forecast tuning. This role operates as part of Gap Inc.'s Pricing, Planning Analytics, and Inventory Optimization function, working with business partners and more experienced team members while following consistent decision standards, approved AI-enabled tools, and transparent analytical methods.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Analytical Execution**

* Complete recurring pricing analyses, data preparation, model inputs, scenario runs, reporting, and recommendation materials using established methods and templates.
* Check data and outputs for completeness and accuracy; identify inconsistencies, risks, and patterns, and escalate questions when needed.
* Prepare clear summaries, visuals, and decision-support materials that explain findings and relevant business implications.
* Maintain accurate records of assumptions, outputs, approvals, actions, and hindsights in the decision log.

**Scenario Support and Insight Development**

* Support pricing, promotion, markdown, and yield-management scenarios; learn how revenue, margin, sell-through, customer value, and inventory exposure shape trade-offs.
* Analyze elasticity, competitive, category, channel, and customer signals and summarize implications for pricing recommendations and guardrails.
* Coordinate with GMM, Merchandising, Planning, Inventory Optimization, Pricing Operations, and Finance to gather inputs, confirm execution constraints, and support approved price actions.
* Share analyses with peers across Planning, Pricing, and Inventory Optimization to connect work and reduce siloed execution.

**Tools, AI and Continuous Learning**

* Use approved AI-enabled tools, models, dashboards, and agents responsibly; validate outputs against source data, business context, and known constraints, seeking guidance for exceptions.
* Build knowledge of Gap Inc. planning, pricing, inventory, merchandising, and financial processes and apply that knowledge to assigned work.

jobs.description:
Overview:

NYREACH is a Bronx-based non-profit focused on addressing health disparities through community-driven solutions. Our work connects individuals to healthcare and essential social services while building strong partnerships across New York City.

Job Summary:

The Compliance & Data Analyst will serve as a critical oversight, quality assurance, and audit-readiness role within NYREACH, supporting Social Care Network (SCN) activities under New York State’s 1115 Waiver. This role ensures that all SCN screenings, eligibility determinations, navigation activities, referrals, and documentation meet program requirements, PHS and SOMOS audit standards, and contractual compliance expectation.

The position functions as both a compliance lead and operational analyst. The Analyst will create and maintain operating processes and policies, monitor day-to-day compliance, audit data for accuracy, and work closely with Navigators, Program Leads, and Directors to ensure a consistent level of compliance, accuracy, and audit readiness across the program.

Responsibilities:

**Eligibility Assessment & Timeliness (High Priority)**

* Ensure eligibility assessments are completed within seven (7) calendar days of referral receipt, consistent with SCN and 1115 Waiver requirements
* Track timeliness metrics and maintain audit-ready evidence of assessment completion
* Escalate delays or barriers to Program Leads and Directors
* Develop standard workflows to support timely eligibility determinations

**Closed-Loop Referral Oversight (High Priority)**

* Monitor all internal and external referrals to ensure closed-loop completion, as required by PHS and SOMOS audit standards
* Conduct compliance follow-ups on open or aging referrals
* Verify referral outcomes are documented clearly and accurately in member records
* Flag and escalate unresolved referrals that present compliance risk

**Navigation & Billing Opportunity Review**

* Review member profiles and navigation records to identify missing or open navigation activities tied to billing opportunities
* Maintain navigation trackers to ensure no eligible service or reimbursement opportunity is missed
* Validate that navigation activities are supported by appropriate documentation and eligibility criteria
* Partner with Navigators to resolve documentation gaps prior to billing or reporting

**Documentation Quality & Care Plan Compliance**

* Ensure all notes, eligibility documentation, and care plans meet SCN documentation and audit standards
* Confirm care plans are updated based on screenings, referrals, and changes in member needs
* Enforce internal documentation standards aligned with PHS, SOMOS, and NYS DOH guidance

**Audit & Monitoring Functions**

* Conduct routine audits of a minimum of ten percent (10%) of enhanced-level members
* Validate that enhanced members are connected to required referrals and services
* Document audit findings, corrective actions, and resolution timelines
* Maintain audit logs and supporting evidence for internal and external review

**Client Action & Referral Validation**

* Review all Client Action items, including internal and external referrals
* Coordinate with Navigators to obtain required responses and documentation
* Decline or return referrals that lack sufficient documentation or eligibility support
* Track and report closure and resolution status of all Client Action items

**Policy, Process & Program Oversight**

* Create, document, and maintain operating procedures and compliance policies for SCN workflows
* Ensure processes remain aligned with evolving 1115 Waiver, SCN, PHS, and SOMOS guidance
* Communicate compliance expectations and policy updates to Navigators and leadership
* Serve as an internal subject matter expert on SCN compliance requirements

**Reporting & Data Analysis**

* Produce routine compliance, productivity, and audit-readiness reports
* Monitor key indicators tied to eligibility timeliness, referral closure, documentation quality, and billing readiness
* Analyze trends and identify operational or compliance risks
* Present findings and recommendations to Directors and executive leadership

**External Audit Leadership**

* Serve as the primary lead for all SCN-related audits conducted by PHS, SOMOS, and other oversight entities
* Coordinate audit preparation, data validation, and documentation submission
* Support Directors in audit response strategy, corrective action plans, and follow-up reporting
* Maintain continuous audit readiness across all SCN program activities

**Key Performance Targets**

* Eligibility assessments completed within 7 days: 95% (PHS/SOMOS timeliness standard)
* Closed-loop referral completion rate: 90% with documented outcomes
* Navigation activities supported by compliant documentation: 95%
* Care plans updated and compliant: 95%
* Enhanced-level members connected to required referrals: 100%
* Audit sample completion and issue resolution within required timeframes: 100%
* Zero material audit findings related to missing documentation or unsupported billing

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree in public health, health administration, social work, or related field preferred
* Strong understanding of audit processes, documentation standards, and compliance monitoring

**Required Skills**

* Advanced analytical, reporting, and organizational skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with Navigators, Program Leads, Directors, and external partners
* Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; proficiency in Teams, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting internal or external audits in a healthcare or social services setting

Succeeding in this position will require extensive collaboration across multiple cross functional teams (Content Planning & Analysis, Marketing, Data & Analytics, Business Operations & Reporting, etc.) and effectively utilizing team resources to navigate an ever-changing streaming landscape.

* Produce high-quality maps, dashboards, and visualizations; compile and validate field-collected data to support planning, execution, and tracking of vegetation management activities.
* Analyze operational and system data to generate actionable insights, improve program performance, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Reliability and IT teams to define data and technology requirements, enhance geospatial capabilities, and implement scalable solutions.
* Troubleshoot and support GIS platforms, mobile data collection tools, and mapping applications to ensure system reliability and user effectiveness.
* Deliver timely and accurate reporting, including program metrics, mapping products, and performance dashboards, to support compliance, monitoring, and strategic planning.

**Job Specific Qualifications**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor Degree with a minimum of 5 years of experience working with large datasets and generating insights
* + OR candidates without a degree must have 7 years of experience working with large datasets and generating insights
* Experience using software systems similar to ESRI software and ArcGIS
* Ability to apply statistics to analyze trends, performance, and risk
* Understanding circuit performance metrics (e.g., reliability, outages, SAIDI/SAIFI)
* Working knowledge of Electrical distribution systems (how power flows, feeders, circuits)
* Overhead (OH) utility infrastructure (poles, lines, vegetation risk zones)
* Familiarity with remote sensing technologies (LiDAR, satellite imagery, aerial imagery)

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

**About the Role**
==================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

You will join the Data & Analytics Platform (DAP) team within the Pinnacle engineering organization. The DAP team owns and operates two data consolidation platforms — Quantum (contract-driven, next-gen) and Analytics 2.0 (SQL-driven, legacy) — that ingest, transform, and serve billions of records daily from social platforms, measurement systems, and third-party partners. The data powers Looker dashboards, customer-facing reports, and downstream APIs used across DoubleVerify's product suite.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Platform Abstraction & Design: Design and maintain the YAML-based "Contract" system that allows users to define data entities, transformations, and SLOs without writing low-level orchestration code.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop the translation engine that converts user contracts into automated dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and Snowflake objects.
* API Development: Transition the platform from static configuration files to a dynamic, API-first architecture, enabling programmatic creation of data artifacts.
* Self-Service Enablement: Build tooling and guardrails that allow business units to deploy their own data solutions while maintaining global standards for governance and security.
* Performance & Scale: Optimize the "translation" layer to ensure that generated jobs are efficient, cost-effective, and leverage the full power of the Snowflake/dbt stack.
* Developer Experience (DevEx): Act as the "Product Manager" for your platform, gathering feedback from internal users to simplify the data development lifecycle.
* Design and build data pipelines that process billions of records a day across consolidation, semantic, and externalization layers using the DV Internal Data Platform — a self-service, contract-driven architecture where pipelines are defined via YAML contracts and automatically deployed to Snowflake, Airflow, and Looker.
* Develop and extend the Contract Interpreter — a Python library (Pydantic, Jinja2) that reads contract driven platform based YAML and generates dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and environment configurations for each deployment environment (dev, stg, prod).
* Lead new initiatives and integrations with the world's largest social platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Reddit, Netflix, etc.) to measure ad performance end-to-end.
* Build and maintain the semantic layer — design LookML models, explores, and views that translate consolidated data into customer-ready analytics through Looker.
* Implement and maintain observability — build monitoring, alerting, watermarking, and data consistency checks to ensure pipeline reliability and data freshness at scale.
* Leverage AI agents and tooling — contribute to and use the team's AI agent workspace (meta-repo with AGENTS.md context files, skills, and MCP integrations) to accelerate development, automate workflows, and encode institutional knowledge for AI-assisted engineering.
* Design schema evolution and data migration strategies — manage schema versioning, backward compatibility, incremental vs. full-refresh deployments, and large-scale data backfills.
* Work in multi-functional agile teams with end-to-end responsibility for product development and delivery — from contract definition to customer-facing data.
* Collaborate directly with engineers from partner platforms on API development and data integration specifications.
* Train and mentor a team of software engineers.

**Who You Are**
===============

**Required Experience & Qualifications**
----------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in a Data Engineering or related role.
* Strong SQL skills — advanced querying, performance tuning, window functions, and complex transformations at scale.
* Proficiency in Python — building libraries, data processing scripts, and automation tooling (experience with Pydantic, Jinja2, or similar templating frameworks is a plus).
* Deep experience with Snowflake — schema design, Snowpipe, streams, tasks, materialized views, clustering, and query optimization.
* Experience with dbt (data build tool) — building and maintaining models, macros, custom materializations, and incremental strategies.
* Experience with orchestration tools — Airflow / Cloud Composer, DAG design, scheduling, and monitoring.

* Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts — dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, fact/aggregate table design, and data consistency patterns.

jobs.description:
Meta is seeking an experienced Demand Planner to support supply chain and business planning functions through rigorous data analysis and forecasting. In this role, you will develop and maintain demand forecasting models that inform inventory positioning, capacity planning, and go-to-market readiness across Meta's hardware and consumer product lines. You will partner closely with supply chain, finance, product, and sales operations teams to translate market signals and business inputs into actionable demand plans that drive efficient resource allocation and minimize supply-demand imbalances.  
  
  

### **Demand Planner, Strategic Analytics Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain statistical demand forecasting models that integrate sell-through data, market trends, promotional calendars, and product lifecycle signals
* Own the end-to-end demand planning process for assigned product lines, including baseline forecasting, consensus planning, and exception management
* Analyze historical shipment, inventory, and point-of-sale data to identify demand patterns, forecast variances, and root causes of forecast error
* Collaborate with supply chain, finance, and product teams to align demand plans with inventory targets, capacity constraints, and financial commitments
* Build and maintain centralized planning dashboards and reporting tools that enable automated tracking of forecast accuracy, bias, and key demand planning metrics
* Support monthly and quarterly Sales and Operations Planning processes by delivering demand insights, scenario analyses, and recommendations to planning leadership
* Translate ambiguous business inputs and market intelligence into structured demand assumptions and quantitative forecast adjustments
* Identify gaps in planning data infrastructure and partner with data engineering and analytics teams to prioritize and deliver improvements
* Communicate forecast rationale, risks, and opportunities to cross-functional stakeholders and planning leadership in a clear and structured manner
* Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess the demand impact of product launches, channel shifts, promotional events, and macroeconomic changes

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in demand planning, supply chain analytics, or business planning with demonstrated ownership of statistical forecasting processes
* Experience building and maintaining demand forecasting models using quantitative and statistical methods
* Experience working with large datasets using SQL or similar data querying tools to extract and analyze supply chain or sales data
* Experience developing planning dashboards and automated reporting tools to support business decision-making
* Experience communicating complex analytical findings and forecast recommendations to cross-functional teams and planning leadership

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with product lifecycle planning, channel inventory management, or new product introduction forecasting
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience using Python or R for statistical modeling and demand signal analysis
* Experience with demand planning software or advanced planning systems such as SAP IBP, Kinaxis, or comparable platforms
* Experience supporting Sales and Operations Planning processes in a consumer electronics or hardware product environment

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. The Human Resources Administration (HRA) is dedicated to fighting poverty and income inequality by providing New Yorkers in need with essential benefits such as Food Assistance and Emergency Rental Assistance. As the largest local social services agency in the country, HRA helps more than three million New Yorkers annually through the administration of more than 15 major public assistance programs.
  
  
Housing Services Administration is a division of New York City’s Department of Social Services that oversees housing stability and rehousing efforts. HSA administers rental assistance, housing supply, and placement programs to help individuals and families exit shelter, prevent homelessness, and secure safe, affordable housing across the city.
  
  
The Office of Supportive Housing and Specialized Services helps formerly homeless clients succeed in the community by providing access to permanent housing with support services. Supportive Housing and Specialized Services works closely with other divisions of DSS/HRA/DHS and with other governmental and non-governmental providers to create new programs and to integrate and refine existing services so that clients experiencing homelessness and those at risk can move into safe, affordable housing that best supports their stability and integration in the community.
  
  
Program areas under Supportive Housing & Specialized Services purview include the Coordinated Entry Unit which oversees the Coordinated Assessment and Placement System (CAPS). CAPS serves as NYC’s Coordinated Entry system per the HUD mandate to ensure that localities use a coordinated system to assure systematic and timely referral and placement of homeless and at-risk clients into the most appropriate permanent housing programs. CAPS includes assessment services for individuals/families potentially eligible for supportive housing or rental assistance programs; an application system to determine supportive housing eligibility; a rapid-rehousing request, referral and enrollment module; an electronic referral component; and a vacancy control system to verify and monitor placements.  
  
  
  
The Office of Supportive Housing and Specialized Services is recruiting for one (1) City Research Scientist II to function as a Research Analyst who will support the Director of Coordinated Entry and the Senior Research Analyst by providing research and evaluation to inform the development and implementation of the CAPS Coordinated Entry system and who will:

* Support DSS/HRA supportive housing policy directives and respond to data and analytic requests from leadership and external stakeholders by: designing, executing and analyzing analyses of CAPS data; developing non-automated ad hoc SQL code for extraction and analysis of complex data sets; designing, preparing and presenting data visualizations; and disseminating research findings beyond the unit through writing memos and reports including Local Law submissions and creating and delivering presentations.

  

* Monitor administrative CAPS data for survey, application, determination, rapid-rehousing, and vacancy control modules; make and record observations, including developing new recording systems; design and prepare visualizations and communicate findings to internal and external stakeholders.

  

* Prepare responses to legal and media requests, including creating non-automated SQL code to extract and analyze CAPS data.

  

* Support Federal reporting to HUD; validate, troubleshoot, and upload file sets extracted from CAPS into NYC's HMIS data warehouse; collaborate with the Office of Business Strategies and Solutions to refine file generation logic as needed.

  
- Conduct data sharing in support of intra- and interagency research and evaluation efforts.
  
  

* Perform literature and data reviews to evaluate the validity and reliability of prior studies and reports to be used in formulating research questions and future report methodologies.

  

* Perform other related duties as directed.

jobs.description:
Company

Federal Reserve Bank of New York

When you work at the New York Fed, you have the opportunity to make an impact in our communities and across the nation. Our mission-driven, curious, and dedicated colleagues apply their diverse perspectives and unique talents to support the strength of the U.S. economy and stability of the global financial system. At the Bank, we work full-time onsite with our teams. We believe being physically together allows us to draw on our collective strengths, while recognizing that the ability to work flexibly from time to time remains important to achieving our mission.

Our Unique Work:   

The New York Fed, on behalf of the Federal Reserve System, offers correspondent banking and custody services to foreign central banks and international monetary authorities (FIMA) and the System Open Market Account (SOMA) to facilitate their official financial operations, as well as support financial stability operations in the U.S. and abroad. The Central Bank and International Account Services (CBIAS) area of the New York Fed's Markets Group serves the U.S. dollar reserve management needs of its official customers by offering payments, custodial, clearing and settlement, collateral management, and investment and liquidity services. CBIAS has a long history of providing safe and efficient banking services to its customer base by managing over $7 trillion for FIMA customers and SOMA with transaction volume presently exceeding $300 billion per day. CBIAS maintains operating locations in New York City (FRB-NY) and Richmond, Virginia (FRB-R).

The Account Transaction Monitoring (ATM) and Account Risk Analytics (ARA) staff units are two of three units within the Account Risk Management (ARM) Directorate within CBIAS. The ARM Directorate is responsible for risk management activities for its international account services. As the first line of defense for the FRBNY on these international accounts, ARM is principally focused on implementing anti-money laundering (AML), Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) compliance, and fraud programs. The ATM staff conduct day-to-day operations and analytic initiatives related to account control, legal and reputational risk management activities associated with fraud, AML, and OFAC monitoring. The ARA staff supports and coordinates analysts with responsibility for the administration and operation of account control and legal and reputational risk management activities and the execution of AML and OFAC compliance programs.

How You’ll Make an Impact as an Account Risk Management Analyst: 

Monitor payment and currency activity to ensure compliance with OFAC requirements, Bank and CBIAS AML policy. Take the lead in escalating transactions for concerning activity.
Develop and maintain customer profiles that identify key areas of activity and potential transactional risk using a variety of available tools. This includes analytics software and other databases, including Microsoft Office.
Monitor international geopolitical, economic, and regulatory developments that may affect customer activity and governance, including changes in U.S. government sanctions programs.
Develop regional geographic specialization to better understand risks presented by a global customer base.
Provide analysis of customer trends and activity related to global activity.
Participate in programs geared toward technological enhancements, risk reduction and improved customer service.
Author and present briefings to management on transaction typologies, customer, or geopolitical developments or other topics which may present undesired compliance or reputational risk.
Contribute to FIMA customer risk reviews using historical activity to identify higher risk typologies, summarize past engagement and provide rating recommendations.
Analyze and manage the distribution of intelligence derived from open-source research, transaction analysis, and other sources.

The Unique Skill Sets We’re Looking For: 

Demonstrated ability to perform operational and analytical responsibilities under time pressure with a high degree of accuracy and strong attention to detail.
Ability to work independently with general supervision, and support projects/processes.
Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Personal and professional interest in international relations and knowledge of global affairs and current events encouraged.
Ability to leverage analytical tools to organize, analyze and present data in support of compliance activities.
Flexibility to travel between the New York and Richmond, VA sites.

Other Things to Know:

Salary Range:

New York: $90000 - $110000 / year 

Richmond: $75000 - $92000 / year 

We believe in transparency at the New York Fed. This salary range reflects a variety of skills and experiences candidates may bring to the job. We pay individuals along this range based on their unique backgrounds. Whether you’re stretching into the job or are a more seasoned candidate, we aim to pay competitively for your contributions. 

How We’ll Support You: 

Our programs and benefits are designed to support you through all your life stages:

Learning & Growing: Educational assistance, career development tools, and stretch opportunities
Supporting Your Family: Parental leave, adoption assistance, back-up dependent and elder care, college planning resources, and more
Managing Your Health: Comprehensive insurance plans, leave policies, onsite Health & Wellness Center, and onsite Fitness Center
Optimizing Your Finances: Pension plan, 401(k) with generous match, financial planning resources, and subsidized public transportation program

Our Culture is deeply grounded in our Touchstone Behaviors
— By working with us, you’ll have the opportunity to develop and demonstrate your ability to Communicate Authentically, Collaborate Inclusively, Drive Progress, Develop Others, and Take Ownership. These competencies shape our culture here at the Bank. They also provide a shared language for how we work together and achieve success and set clear expectations for leading with impact at every stage of your career. Learn more. 

Apply now if you’re ready to join us in strengthening the U.S. economy together. Want to consider our other opportunities?

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

As digital threats continue to evolve and threaten businesses large and small, bad actors are improving their tactics, techniques and procedures faster than corporate security teams can keep up. Your Key Responsibilities

The nature of this role means no two projects will be the same. You will balance your time between directly liaising with our clients to understand their situation and create an appropriate investigation plan to perform technical review and analysis of data. This will include investigating what happened and helping the client to determine the potential impact and how the company’s data was potentially misused. You will be helping clients assess and resolve insider threats on an ongoing basis for multiple clients at a time. That means thinking differently about the type of data misuse, identifying malicious insiders, improving the client’s data integrity, investigation methodology and mitigate privacy risks.

Desire to constantly develop your understanding of our clients’ industries, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for improvement
Understanding of multiple technologies to distribute your knowledge of leading practices to enhance service delivery
Ability to develop your team through constant coaching and feedback, knowledge and opportunities to grow
Experience in large scale, complex investigations, using techniques such as digital forensics, log analysis and timeline creation have been applied

Ability to preserve network and host-based digital evidence in an industry accepted forensically sound manner

Experience performing mobile-based digital forensics on Apple and Android based systems

Knowledge of Windows, Unix and Mac host-based forensics, Mobile OS’s and command line
Global client network, experience working with fortune 500 companies, international and frequent travel opportunities
Working knowledge of hardware configuration and network/data communications, software development and scripting, and database technology and database exploitation/forensics
Experience with evidence seizure, chain of custody and conducting analysis

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

The Master Data Analyst
is responsible for the end-to-end setup, maintenance, and synchronization of master data supporting North America Supply and Demand Planning and Haleon's customers and retailers.

The role serves as a key point of contact for master data-related inquiries and is responsible for maintaining data quality, accuracy, and system integrity. The Master Data Analyst also supports NPI activities, process improvements, system enhancements, and implementation initiatives to drive efficient and standardized master data processes.

Key Responsibilities

Data Management

Collect, validate, and maintain master data in collaboration with key stakeholders.
Create and maintain master data in SAP systems, including GMM, ECC, and APO, across plants, sales organizations, distribution channels, and storage locations supporting the U.S., Puerto Rico, and Canada.
Generate and maintain UPCs and GTINs through PIM.
Support the NPI process by ensuring required master data and SKU setup activities are completed prior to product launch.
Publish and synchronize product data with retailers.
Monitor data quality reports, resolve identified issues, and complete required standard work.
Manage SKU lifecycle activities and maintain accurate master data throughout the product lifecycle.
Create and maintain vendor master data.

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve master data processes and ways of working.
Collaborate with Planning, Customer Service, Sites, and other key stakeholders to promote consistent data management practices.

Systems and Project Support

Support master data process development, system implementations, data verification, and system enhancements.
Identify opportunities to improve master data systems and related processes.
Partner with cross-functional teams to understand changes impacting master data and incorporate new processes and ways of working within the Planning Hub.

Documentation

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Supply Chain, Technical, or a related field.

About Gap Inc.

At Gap Inc., we create culture as much as we create clothes. Our ambition is to become a high-performing house of iconic American brands that shape culture.

Our portfolio—Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta—each brings a distinct point of view to how we show up in the world and serve our customers.

We’re driven by a shared purpose: to bridge gaps—between people, perspectives, and possibilities—to create a better world.

We’re building a team that performs at a high level—people who think boldly, take ownership, and turn ideas into impact. If you’re ready to learn fast and help shape what’s next, you’ll fit right in.

About The Role

The Pricing Optimization Associate supports pricing analytics and decision support across Gap brand. In this role, you will complete foundational analyses and prepare inputs for pricing strategy, price testing, competitive pricing insights, pricing architecture, promotion scenario planning, markdown optimization, yield management, and forecast tuning. This role operates as part of Gap Inc.'s Pricing, Planning Analytics, and Inventory Optimization function, working with business partners and more experienced team members while following consistent decision standards, approved AI-enabled tools, and transparent analytical methods.

What you'll do

Analytical Execution

Complete recurring pricing analyses, data preparation, model inputs, scenario runs, reporting, and recommendation materials using established methods and templates.
Check data and outputs for completeness and accuracy; identify inconsistencies, risks, and patterns, and escalate questions when needed.
Prepare clear summaries, visuals, and decision-support materials that explain findings and relevant business implications.
Maintain accurate records of assumptions, outputs, approvals, actions, and hindsights in the decision log.

Scenario Support and Insight Development

Support pricing, promotion, markdown, and yield-management scenarios; learn how revenue, margin, sell-through, customer value, and inventory exposure shape trade-offs.
Analyze elasticity, competitive, category, channel, and customer signals and summarize implications for pricing recommendations and guardrails.
Coordinate with GMM, Merchandising, Planning, Inventory Optimization, Pricing Operations, and Finance to gather inputs, confirm execution constraints, and support approved price actions.
Share analyses with peers across Planning, Pricing, and Inventory Optimization to connect work and reduce siloed execution.

Tools, AI and Continuous Learning

Use approved AI-enabled tools, models, dashboards, and agents responsibly; validate outputs against source data, business context, and known constraints, seeking guidance for exceptions.
Build knowledge of Gap Inc. planning, pricing, inventory, merchandising, and financial processes and apply that knowledge to assigned work.
Follow established workflows and contribute practical ideas to improve templates, data quality, recurring work, and the usability of insights.

Business Partnership and Quality Contribution

Deliver accurate, timely work; communicate progress and risks, seek feedback, and bring curiosity, responsiveness, and a service mindset to business partners and team members.

Who you are

Bachelor degree required in business, economics, finance, analytics, mathematics, statistics, engineering, retail, or related field.
1+ years of relevant analytical experience in retail, planning, pricing, inventory, finance, data analytics, consulting, or related fields.
Foundational analytical, modeling, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn data into clear findings and practical next steps.
Exposure to retail, apparel, consumer products, consulting, finance, data analytics, planning, pricing, inventory, or merchandising preferred.
Comfort using Excel and data tools; exposure to BI platforms, SQL, Python, forecasting, optimization, pricing tools, or AI-enabled workflows preferred.
Structured learner who follows established methods, asks thoughtful questions, and communicates clearly.
Commercially curious and detail-oriented; interested in how customer, product, revenue, margin, inventory, service, and execution factors connect.
Enterprise-minded and brand-aware; applies common standards while learning relevant brand context.
Comfortable using AI-enabled tools and agentic workflows with human review, appropriate validation, and timely escalation of exceptions or risks.
Collaborative team member who builds trust, responds with urgency, welcomes feedback, and contributes to continuous improvement.

$76,400.00 - $95,500.00

Description

Job Description

The Data Analyst II oversees activities related to data integrity, security and enhancement of the value of data. The Data Analyst II may direct the movement of data across multiple systems; oversee its validation and organization and make sure that data is available to appropriate people and systems within an organization. The Data Analyst II will also develop and execute reports that will be important assets of the practice as they continue to develop and evaluate a new model of care.

The Department of Population Health Science and Policy is seeking a Data Analyst II to work on projects related to maternal health policy and equity, pregnancy-related influences to lifecourse cardiometabolic disease, school-level influences on adolescent preconception health, economic evaluation, and health services research. The Data Analyst II will be an integral member of our research teams, and will collaborate with study investigators (including epidemiologists, health economists, OBGYNs, etc), and other research team members on projects related to maternal health disparities and inequities. This is a one-year position with an opportunity for longer-term renewal.

The ideal candidate would be: 1) highly motivated and responsible; 2) an effective communicator; 3) extremely organized and detail-oriented; 4) someone who combines initiative with responsiveness to supervision; 5) someone comfortable asking questions and eager to learn; and, 6) flexible and able to shift gears as new tasks present themselves. Opportunities exist for mentorship and professional development for Data Analysts.

Plan, organize, conduct, and communicate data-intensive analysis and research within the overall scope of cardiovascular disease prevention, economic evaluation, maternal health disparities, and health equity.
Develop required research skills in health services research and quantitative analysis
Engage in data management, regression-based data analysis, and manuscript writing
Guide and mentor research interns
Communicate and work with internal and external collaborators.

Bachelors degree in computer science, statistics and/or related field required, or combination of equivalent work experience and education. Masters degree in relevant field of study preferred (e.g., statistics, epidemiology, computer science, etc.).

jobs.description:
Corporate & Investment Banking (“CIB”) delivers a comprehensive suite of capital markets, banking, and financial products and services. A trusted partner to our clients, we provide corporate and transactional banking; commercial real estate lending and servicing; investment banking; equity; and fixed income solutions including sales, trading, and research capabilities to corporate, commercial real estate, government, and institutional clients across the globe. Learn more about our career areas and lines of business at wellsfargojobs.com.

About This Role

Wells Fargo’s CIB Fund Finance Group is seeking a Corporate Banking Analyst to join its Investor Analysis Team in its Charlotte or New York office.

The Fund Finance Group provides financing to private equity funds and other asset managers through structured credit facilities. Fund Finance is part of the Corporate and Investment Bank (CIB). The Investor Analysis Team focuses specifically on the credit analysis and underwriting of limited partners (investors) which serve as the collateral for Fund Finance subscription credit facilities (i.e., insurance companies, pension funds, endowments, sovereign wealth funds, large corporations, and other institutional investors).

The Corporate Banking Analyst role is primarily focused on credit underwriting and analysis and legal diligence on limited partners, preparing fulsome credit materials to synthesize and present this analysis to key stakeholders, as well supporting ongoing portfolio monitoring, credit administration, data analytics and project management across the Fund Finance portfolio

In This Role, You Will

Preparing comprehensive financial analysis on limited partners (including, but not limited to, pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, asset managers, insurance companies and banks)
Developing a credit opinion on limited partners and presenting analysis to senior team members and Independent Risk Management partners
Ongoing review of performance and ratings of limited partners across the Fund Finance portfolio
Conducting deep-dive analysis via periodic presentations on particular investor types and trends, economic events, and geopolitical events and potential impacts to the portfolio
Liaising with various teams within Fund Finance, inclusive of senior bankers, Credit partners, and other lines of business across Wells Fargo
Participating in the monitoring, documenting and coverage of business-wide portfolio and collateral surveillance and reporting
Navigate business-wide projects including, but not limited to, internal/external exams, improved data sourcing, ad-hoc research, and other value-add initiatives

Required Qualifications

6+ months of Corporate Banking Relationship Management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Accounting, Math, Economics or Engineering (or MBA)
6+mos of underwriting or credit experience with a focus in finance
Experience with Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel and PowerPoint
Strong technical and analytical skills including financial analysis
Ability to work effectively, as well as independently, in a team environment
Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment
Familiarity with private equity funds
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Effective organizational, multi-tasking, and prioritizing skills
Solid problem solving and decision-making skills
Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
Professional presentation skills

jobs.title: Senior Benefits Analyst
jobs.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks.

As Via’s Senior Benefits Analyst
, you will be supporting the strategy, administration and execution of our US and global health, welfare, retirement and wellness programs. This position is focused on optimizing the employee experience across the lifecycle, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting the scale of our benefits offerings to support our growing, dynamic team.

This is a hands-on role— we’re a one-team culture, and you’ll be rolling up your sleeves to support across the board, whether it’s executing annual open enrollments, managing complex leave requests, auditing carrier billing, or delivering clear employee communications. Collaborating closely with Via’s broader People Operations team, global payroll, and external partners, you’ll act as a subject matter expert and trusted resource, helping shape a competitive and exceptional benefits experience that aligns with Via’s mission.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end to end benefits experience for employees, managing new hire enrollments, offboarding workflows, COBRA, life event changes and qualifying status updates.
Serve as a thought support lead for day-to-day employee benefit inquiries, while creating clear, engaging employee communications, benefit booklets, policy guides, and education sessions.
Lead monthly carrier billing reconciliation and audits across all plans, partnering with payroll and finance to ensure deduction and invoice accuracy.
Support compliance with federal, state and local regulations (ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, FMLA, SF HCSO, etc) managing required non-discrimination testing, ACA reporting and required annual notice distributions.
Maintain all plan documents (SPDs, SBC, plan summaries, etc) and lead the project management and execution of annual Open Enrollment, including HRIS system set up, broker liaison, and employee Q & A sessions.
Assist with the administration of leave of absence workflows (FMLA, state paid family leave, STD/LTD, parental leave, and ADA accommodations) in close coordination with other members of the People and Payroll team.
Manage benefit administration workflows and data integrity within our HRIS (Workday), auditing carrier integrations (EDI feeds).
Act as a point of contact for benefits brokers, carriers, 401(k) recordkeepers, pension fund contacts, and wellness vendors, resolving claim escalations.
Analyze program utilization, claims trends, employee feedback, and market benchmarking to partner with Director of People Operations on continuous plan optimization and cost-containment initiatives.

Who You Are:

4-6+ years of dedicated experience in US benefits administration (preferably with self-insured plans), plan design, and leave management in a fast-paced environment.
Deep, practical knowledge of employment and benefit laws (ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, FMLA, COBRA, FLSA) and experience executing non-discrimination testing.
Experience working with unionized employee populations and understanding of collective bargaining agreements.
Highly organized with exceptional financial and auditing skills; meticulous when reconciling monthly carrier bills, payroll deductions, and employee census data.
Proven proficiency with enterprise HRIS platforms (experience with Workday Benefits Administration and carrier EDI feeds is a strong plus).
Ability to breakdown complex medical, financial and regulatory concepts into easy to understand, supportive communications for employees.
Comfortable with ambiguity, flexible in adapting to changing needs, and proactive in driving process improvements alongside leadership.
High integrity, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential material including medical records, sensitive employee situations, and compliance audits.

Compensation and Benefits:

Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable
Salary Range: $80,000-$90,000 per year
Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans
A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting
Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options
Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks)
20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager (Reporting and Analytics)
jobs.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

Who Are We Looking For?

Vestwell's marketing team is looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to serve as the primary owner of marketing analytics and reporting. This person will partner with Data, Product, and Revenue Technology to understand the data available across Google Analytics, HubSpot, and Salesforce, bring those sources into a consistent reporting view, and build the dashboards marketing needs to measure performance and make better decisions.

The role will also own marketing attributes, the data points used to identify meaningful customer groups and support targeted campaigns. Working closely with Product and Engineering, this person will understand how attributes are defined and used, represent Marketing when attributes change, and help campaign teams apply them effectively.

This is a hands-on analytics and reporting role, not a software or data engineering position. Success requires strong data judgment, practical reporting and dashboard-building skills, a clear understanding of how business systems connect, and the ability to translate stakeholder needs into useful reporting.

What Will You Be Doing?

Own marketing analytics and reporting. Serve as the main point of contact for marketing performance data, dashboards, recurring reporting, and measurement questions. Establish clear metric definitions and reporting standards so teams use a consistent view of performance.
Understand and connect the data. Partner with Data and Revenue Technology to map the available pre and post-sale data across Google Analytics, HubSpot, and Salesforce. Determine how those sources should work together, identify access or quality gaps, and create a reliable reporting view of the customer journey.
Build dashboards and recurring reports. Translate marketing questions into practical dashboards and reports that track initiatives, campaign performance, funnel movement, and business outcomes. Maintain the reports, validate the underlying data, and improve them as needs change.
Own marketing attributes. Maintain Marketing's understanding of the customer attributes used for segmentation and targeting. Partner with Product to understand how an attribute is defined, where it comes from, and how it can be used. Act as Marketing's point of contact when Product or Engineering proposes a new attribute or a change to an existing one.
Enable targeted campaigns. Help marketing teams identify useful customer groupings and apply approved attributes to campaign design, audience selection, personalization, and performance analysis. Confirm that segments are based on reliable data and can be measured consistently.
Measure the marketing funnel. Connect upper-funnel activity and pre-sale engagement to lead progression, sales outcomes, and relevant post-sale signals. Develop campaign and funnel reporting while clearly documenting data and attribution limitations.
Coordinate across teams. Work comfortably with Marketing, Data, Revenue Technology, Product, and Engineering to define requirements, resolve data questions, prioritize work, and communicate findings in terms each team can use.

Requirements

The Necessities

5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing operations, business intelligence, or a similar data-focused role.
Advanced hands-on experience with Google Analytics and HubSpot reporting, including the ability to build, validate, and explain reports within each platform.
Working knowledge of Salesforce reporting and data structures, with the ability to partner with Revenue Technology to obtain and apply the data Marketing needs.
Experience building dashboards and reporting frameworks in a business intelligence or data visualization tool such as Tableau, Sigma, or Looker.
Experience reconciling data from multiple systems, documenting metric definitions, identifying data-quality issues, and explaining the limits of the available data.
Experience using customer attributes, segments, or product data to support targeted marketing campaigns and measurement.
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to translate business questions into clear data requirements, useful reports, and actionable findings.
Demonstrated ability to work across Marketing, Data, Revenue Technology, Product, and Engineering teams, including stakeholders with different technical backgrounds.
Strong project management and communication skills, with close attention to accuracy, consistency, and follow-through.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, analytics, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

The Extras

Experience in financial services, technology, or another regulated industry.
Relevant Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce, or business intelligence certifications.
Familiarity with product or behavioral analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Pendo.
Basic familiarity with SQL, data warehouses, or data integration concepts. This knowledge is helpful for partnering with technical teams but is not an engineering requirement.

This role will be based in either the New York City office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

The expected base salary range for this position is $105K - $140K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

Employee Benefits

We’re an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

Interview Process

Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team.

Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here: Vestwell’s California Privacy Rights Policy.

Joining us is a chance to do important work that creates change and shapes the future of healthcare. Thinking differently is what we do best. To us, change equals opportunity. Every day, our colleagues are challenging what’s possible and making headway to innovate new treatment pathways to advance patient outcomes and set new standards of care.

Support financial reporting with process improvement mindset such as report automation
Participation in the development and preparation of weekly, monthly, and quarterly business financial review packages which are presented to various levels of management including the CEO and CFO
Building strong reporting relationships with business partners at all Specialty Surgery locations to improve communication and understanding of the business
Assisting with the overall achievement of the division’s and company’s financial targets

Prepare ad hoc analyses as needed

The Data Analyst II may direct the movement of data across multiple systems; oversee its validation and organization and make sure that data is available to appropriate people and systems within an organization. The Data Analyst II will also develop and execute reports that will be important assets of the practice as they continue to develop and evaluate a new model of care.

The Department of Population Health Science and Policy is seeking a Data Analyst II to work on projects related to maternal health policy and equity, pregnancy-related influences to lifecourse cardiometabolic disease, school-level influences on adolescent preconception health, economic evaluation, and health services research. The Data Analyst II will be an integral member of our research teams, and will collaborate with study investigators (including epidemiologists, health economists, OBGYNs, etc), and other research team members on projects related to maternal health disparities and inequities. This is a one-year position with an opportunity for longer-term renewal.

The ideal candidate would be: 1) highly motivated and responsible; 2) an effective communicator; 3) extremely organized and detail-oriented; 4) someone who combines initiative with responsiveness to supervision; 5) someone comfortable asking questions and eager to learn; and, 6) flexible and able to shift gears as new tasks present themselves. Opportunities exist for mentorship and professional development for Data Analysts.

Responsibilities

Plan, organize, conduct, and communicate data-intensive analysis and research within the overall scope of cardiovascular disease prevention, economic evaluation, maternal health disparities, and health equity.
Develop required research skills in health services research and quantitative analysis
Engage in data management, regression-based data analysis, and manuscript writing
Guide and mentor research interns
Communicate and work with internal and external collaborators.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in computer science, statistics and/or related field required, or combination of equivalent work experience and education. Masters degree in relevant field of study preferred (e.g., statistics, epidemiology, computer science, etc.).
3+ years of analytics experience including report development and database application/management experience, preferably in a large medical center or healthcare environment

Preferred

Strong quantitative skills and proficiency working with data analysis tools such as STATA, SAS, and R.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Highly motivated and interested in developing a research career.

jobs.title: Technical Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
About ViewTrade

ViewTrade Technology builds capital markets infrastructure for financial institutions around the world. We provide clearing, execution, and the technology behind them to brokers, primarily across Asia-Pacific and EMEA. Our finance team is small, works closely with leadership, and covers multiple operating entities.

About The Role

We’re hiring a Technical Financial Analyst to work directly with our Head of FP&A and Global CFO. This role runs the full range: you’ll pull the data yourself, build the analysis, and take it all the way to the strategy conversation about what the numbers mean and what the options are.

“Technical” means you work from the source. You’ll query our Snowflake data warehouse directly rather than waiting on someone else to send you an export.

This is a corporate finance role, not an accounting or controller role.

What You’ll Do

Your first 90 days

Learn the business, including how a broker’s trading activity turns into revenue for us, working closely with the Head of FP&A.
Take ownership of the models currently running, and improve them as you learn them.
Get comfortable in our Snowflake warehouse and the data behind each revenue line.
Build working relationships with business unit owners and the technology teams that supply our data.

Ongoing

Break down revenue by client, region, and type across our main income lines, including transaction fees, payment for order flow, and interest income, working toward daily visibility.
Write and maintain the SQL behind your models, querying Snowflake directly.
Build and maintain forecasts and the analysis leadership uses to make decisions.
Support cost analysis and ad hoc requests from senior leadership.
Automate recurring work and build in checks so the numbers hold up.
Document your models and processes so others can follow and pick them up.

What We’re Looking For

Must Have

1–3 years of experience as a financial analyst or data analyst.
Working SQL: comfortable writing queries with joins and aggregations against a data warehouse.
Strong Excel modeling skills.
A working understanding of how capital markets operate at a high level, including what brokers, exchanges, and clearing firms do.
Regular hands-on use of AI tools (such as Claude) for real work deliverables, and a clear sense of what context and checks they need to produce accurate results.
Based in the U.S. and authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

Nice to Have

Experience with Snowflake specifically.
Experience with Claude Cowork or Claude Code, including creating Skills, Artifacts, Shared Projects, and context files.
Experience at a brokerage, clearing firm, or brokerage technology provider.

How You Work

You’re curious about how the business works, not just what the numbers say.
You think in automation, and you test your work for accuracy.
You pick up new systems and context quickly.
You build things others can follow, and you explain them clearly and concisely.
You’re comfortable with ambiguity: you make a reasonable call, and you document why.

If you meet most of these, we’d like to hear from you.

What We Offer

Fully remote, with no office attendance required. Because our clients and colleagues span Asia-Pacific, EMEA, and the U.S., you’ll work outside the typical 9–5 Eastern a few times a week.
Health, dental, and vision insurance fully paid for you and your spouse.
401(k) with a 3% company match.
25 days off a year: 15 days PTO, plus 5 sick days and 5 personal days.
Performance-based annual bonus.

How To Apply

Send your resume and a few sentences on a forecast, model, or analysis you owned: what question it answered and how you made sure it was right. No cover letter required.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.title: Analyst, State Dispute Operations
jobs.description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, they’re often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement they’re entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. We’re building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About The Role

We’re looking for a State Dispute Analyst to handle the day-to-day filing and tracking of Pivotal’s state-level healthcare reimbursement disputes. You’ll prepare and submit disputes through state portals, agencies and arbitration entities. You’ll track deadlines and fees while ensuring accurate case records from filing through resolution.

Each state runs its process differently, with its own deadlines, forms, fees and submission rules. You’ll work from the team’s state-by-state references, follow them closely and flag anything that looks off or has changed. You’ll sit within our dispute operations team while working with our analytics and product teams to keep case data clean.

This is a great fit for someone who is highly detail-oriented, likes fast changing, high-volume work and wants to build expertise in healthcare reimbursement. In this work, one missing detail can delay a provider’s payment.

What You’ll Do

Prepare and submit filings: Enter and submit state dispute and arbitration requests through state portals, agencies and arbitration entities, following each state’s documentation and formatting requirements.
Track deadlines, fees and payments: Monitor filing and response deadlines, process fees and confirm payers pay awarded amounts. Follow up when a payment is late or incorrect.
Manage inbox and correspondence: Monitor shared inboxes, respond to payers, state agencies and arbitration entities, and log next steps for each case.
Keep case records accurate: Update internal systems and spreadsheets with case details and statuses, and close disputes only once they’re fully resolved.
Follow state requirements: Work from state references for eligibility, deadlines, forms and fees, and flag rule changes or gaps so the references stay current.
Flag data issues: Tell our analytics and product teams when a case file is incomplete or inaccurate.

Who You Are

2–4 years of experience in data management, operational tracking, revenue cycle operations, claims management, or insurance operations
Experience with medical billing or coding, and comfortable reading EOBs, claims and reimbursement codes
Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables
Highly detail-oriented, and catches inconsistencies in documents and data
Manages high volume and competing deadlines accurately
Comfortable following detailed, state-specific processes
Clear written communicator who asks good questions and flags problems early

Extra Credit
Experience

Familiarity with the federal No Surprises Act and how it interacts with state surprise billing laws
Prior experience with state arbitration programs (e.g., New York, New Jersey, Texas)
Experience with tools like Asana or Metabase or other project management tools
Medical billing/coding certification (e.g., CPC)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

We’re a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubs–Los Angeles and New York–we remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If you’re excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you .

Benefits Include:

Competitive compensation, including equity
Full health, dental, and vision coverage
Retirement savings plan through 401(k)
Flexible time off
Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and let’s transform healthcare reimbursement together .
