Amex Offers & Digital Media (AODM) is building an integrated Offers and Ads business designed to strengthen Membership while delivering differentiated value to advertisers. Analytics serves as the intelligence layer of this business; connecting business performance, customer behavior, advertiser opportunity, and strategic economics to enable sustainable growth.

We are seeking a highly strategic and commercially oriented Director of Strategy & GTM Analytics to shape where and how AODM grows. This leader will own the analytics agenda supporting AODM’s most important forward-looking strategic choices; connecting business strategy, commercial economics, growth opportunities, go-to-market intelligence, and AI-enabled transformation.

The Director will serve as a senior thought partner to AODM leadership and cross-functional partners across Product, Sales, GTM, Finance, Analytics, and Technology. The role will frame ambiguous business questions, develop fact-based strategic choices and business cases, evaluate trade-offs, and translate analytical insight into clear recommendations that influence investment, product, pricing, revenue, and GTM decisions.

A critical part of the mandate is incubation: identifying emerging growth opportunities and analytical capabilities, establishing the thesis and evidence required to test them, and determining whether they should scale, stop, or transition to a durable owner. This includes leadership of the AODM AI and advanced analytics agenda; connecting AI investments and emerging analytical capabilities to measurable business, customer, advertiser, and productivity outcomes.

This Director will lead a team spanning complementary areas of Growth Strategy & GTM Analytics and Strategic Analytics, AI & Revenue Strategy, creating a unified strategy organization capable of moving from strategic question to evidence, recommendation, incubation, and ultimately scaled execution.

Responsibilities

Own the Strategy & GTM Analytics agenda for AODM, establishing a prioritized roadmap of strategic questions and analytical initiatives tied to the organization’s growth objectives.Shape business and portfolio strategy through rigorous analysis of Offers and Ads growth opportunities, strategic scenarios, industry dynamics, and cross-business trade-offs.
Lead AODM revenue strategy, and business-case development, including revenue models, pricing and monetization assessments, cost-to-serve analysis, investment cases, and economic guardrails.
Advance GTM and growth strategy by evaluating new propositions, strategic Card Member opportunities, enterprise and Heat Moments, commercial readiness, product adoption, Sales effectiveness, and cross-functional growth initiatives.
Own strategic scenario and investment modeling to help leadership evaluate product economics, monetization cases, and market scenarios, partnering with Performance Analytics and Finance on the underlying enterprise outlook.
Lead the AODM AI and advanced analytics strategy by defining the vision and roadmap, establishing portfolio governance, identifying high-value use cases, and connecting investments to measurable business outcomes.
Evaluate and incubate emerging analytical capabilities, including research, semantic foundations, AI-enabled tools, and new analytical methods, with explicit hypotheses, success criteria, economics, and paths to scaled ownership.
Create disciplined incubation and transition mechanisms that move successful strategic initiatives into durable operating owners rather than creating permanent bespoke work within the Strategy team.
Serve as a senior analytical thought partner to AODM leadership by translating complex analysis into clear choices, trade-offs, and executive recommendations.
Partner across Analytics, Product, Sales/GTM, Finance, and Technology to connect strategic analysis to execution and measurable outcomes.
Build and develop a high-performing strategy and analytics team, strengthening commercial judgment, structured problem solving, analytical rigor, executive communication, and leadership capability.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, data science, consulting, corporate strategy, or a related field, with significant experience in commercially oriented environments.
Proven track record of using analytics to influence strategy, investment, product, pricing, revenue, or go-to-market decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Marketing - Resy
jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Team Amex and let's lead the way together.

Resy is the American Express global dining platform within U.S. Consumer Services (USCS). Our mission is to power the world’s best restaurants, using technology to imagine the future of hospitality. Our customers discover the amazing world of restaurants thanks to our content-rich website and innovative mobile app. Our diners are insiders, and we love having them at the table. The team is responsible for reimagining hospitality and redefining the way restaurants and diners connect through a single network.

Interested in joining our team of restaurant-obsessed explorers? Right this way.   

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior
Analyst, Venue Retention & Lifecycle Marketing
, to support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention, nurture, and B2B content marketing strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Venue Lifecycle and Retention Marketing
, this role will play a key part in bringing data-driven, multi-channel marketing programs to life that deepen restaurant partner engagement, strengthen loyalty, drive product adoption, and support long-term partner retention.

This individual will work closely with the Manager of Venue Retention Marketing to execute partner nurture strategies and B2B content programs across the venue lifecycle
, translating strategic priorities, partner insights, and product value into relevant and compelling communications. They will own key executional workstreams across email and editorial content
including the B2B Content Calendar and end-to-end development of Resy’s partner eNewsletter, while supporting the development and execution of trigger-based and ongoing nurture journeys.

The role will sit at the intersection of lifecycle marketing, B2B content, email execution, and marketing operations
. This person will partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Partner Success, Product, Creative, Compliance, and other teams to move campaigns and initiatives from ideation and briefing through development, approval, deployment, measurement, and optimization. They will bring strong operational rigor to the team, ensuring that multiple campaigns, stakeholders, approvals, and deadlines are effectively managed.

The ideal candidate is an organized and execution-oriented marketer with strong email, editorial, and social instincts and analytical curiosity
. They are equally comfortable developing a content idea, building an email campaign, coordinating a legal review, analyzing campaign performance, and managing a complex project plan. They have a desire to understand our hospitality partners and use data-driven lifecycle marketing to create communications that deliver meaningful value.

Responsibilities

Support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention and lifecycle marketing strategy, bringing partner-facing content and communications to life across email, editorial, and social channels.
Lead execution of partner email and lifecycle programs, including Resy’s partner eNewsletter, developing relevant, engaging communications across key partner moments while evolving and optimizing evergreen engagement strategies.
Manage Resy’s B2B editorial ecosystem, including supporting blog maintenance and owning the content calendar, translating product capabilities, industry trends, partner stories, and business priorities into timely partner-facing content.
Partner with the Manager to advance personalization, segmentation, and ongoing optimization of email and content, using partner insights and performance data to improve the relevance and effectiveness of communications.
Support cross-functional campaign execution, partnering with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, Compliance, and other stakeholders to keep initiatives aligned and on track.
Support the development of partner retention and loyalty strategies, identifying opportunities to deepen engagement through new channels, programs, events, and partner experiences.
Maintain strong operational processes and project management across campaigns and content, ensuring clear timelines, approvals, documentation, and performance reporting.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, and other teams to ensure partner communications reflect shared business objectives.

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, email, B2B, content, digital, or integrated marketing, ideally within a SaaS, technology, hospitality, or partner-focused organization.
Hands-on experience developing and executing email or lifecycle marketing campaigns, with an understanding of campaign development from audience definition and content creation through QA, deployment, and reporting.
Strong editorial and writing skills, with the ability to generate content ideas and translate business priorities, product capabilities, and audience needs into clear and compelling B2B communications; familiarity with SEO principles is a plus.
Experience supporting or executing nurture and lifecycle marketing programs, with an understanding of segmentation, personalization, behavioral triggers, and journey-based marketing; familiarity with HubSpot is a plus.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use campaign performance, CRM data, partner feedback, research, and other qualitative and quantitative insights to inform marketing decisions and identify opportunities for optimization.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, and approval processes.
Experience navigating Compliance, Brand, or other structured marketing approval processes is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.

You’ll Thrive In This Role If You

Are both creative and execution-oriented—you enjoy developing content and campaign ideas and are equally energized by bringing them to life.
Have strong editorial instincts and intellectual curiosity, with an interest in understanding what content will be useful and engaging for Resy’s partners.
Are a highly organized project manager with exceptional attention to detail who can bring structure to complex work and keep multiple workstreams moving at once.
Are proactive and take ownership, following up with stakeholders, anticipating roadblocks, and keeping projects moving without needing every next step defined.
Have a “can do” approach to problem solving and are comfortable operating amid ambiguity, white space, evolving priorities, and strategic pauses.
Are analytically curious and interested in using performance data, partner behavior, and feedback to understand what’s working and continuously improve your work.
Are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can build productive relationships across Marketing, Partner Success, Product, Creative, Compliance, and external partners.
Have a desire to continuously learn and improve, building your expertise across lifecycle, content, and B2B marketing.
Have a passion for the hospitality industry and curiosity about the challenges, priorities, and opportunities facing Resy’s partners.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

American Express Global Commercial Services (GCS) is a leading B2B solutions provider for businesses and corporations of all sizes. The B2B Brand & Demand Strategy team is responsible for producing and informing compelling, insight-driven marketing that cohesively showcases the holistic value of American Express to business customers. The Senior Analyst, Social Execution & Channel Management, will support the execution, optimization, and day-to-day management of American Express Business social channels. This role is responsible for executing social-first content strategies, managing channel performance, and leveraging data-driven insights to strengthen audience engagement and support enterprise marketing priorities. The ideal candidate is a collaborative marketer with a strong understanding of social media who can translate business priorities into compelling social content, optimize channel performance through analytics, and contribute to the continued evolution of the Amex Business social presence.

Responsibilities

Own day-to-day management of Amex Business organic social channels, including publishing, feed curation, content pacing, and community management to support enterprise marketing priorities.

Partner with Product, Brand, Go to Market, Enterprise Social, and agency partners to support the execution of product launches, campaigns, and heat moments through organic social.

Support ongoing social planning and intake processes by maintaining visibility into upcoming business priorities and ensuring timely execution across the editorial calendar.
Ensure all social content complies with brand standards, compliance requirements, and reputational risk guidelines prior to publication

At American Express, we empower early career data and analytics colleagues to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. This role sits at the intersection of technology, finance, portfolio management, reporting, and data analytics. Use Agentic AI, reporting, data analytics, and productivity tools to support research, summarization, analysis, workflow efficiency, and human validated outputs.

Must have earned a Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, or another relevant field before the full time start date.

Foundational understanding of Generative AI concepts, responsible use, appropriate use contexts, prompt based workflows, and human validation of AI generated outputs.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, organization, problem solving, and collaboration skills.

Job Description

Business Unit / Role Specific Info

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.

At American Express, we empower technologists to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As a Cybersecurity Analyst in Enterprise Technology Services, you’ll join a full-time graduate program and contribute to work that helps protect American Express information systems, customer data, colleague experiences, and digital assets.

Cybersecurity teams help identify, reduce, monitor, and respond to technology and information security risks. In this role, you may support cybersecurity operations, security architecture, identity and access management, endpoint protection, application security, security monitoring, cloud security, documentation, and AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows while collaborating with cybersecurity teams, product partners, software development teams, operations teams, and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Supports in monitoring security systems and events using a variety of tools, alerts, and logs to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring timely detection and prevention of security or operational issues
Triages and investigates security or operational issues to determine root causes, impacts, and potential mitigation strategies, helping to prevent future incidents and minimize damage
Support secure network, endpoint, identity, access management, application security, and cloud security activities under guidance from experienced engineers.

jobs.description:
About The Role

At Equitable, we help clients secure their financial well-being so they can pursue long and fulfilling lives - a mission we’ve honed since 1859.

The Equitable Law Department’s Mission is to Serve as Equitable’s trusted counsel, e
mpowering Equitable to pursue its noble purpose by upholding the highest standards, forging collaborative relationships and delivering creative solutions.

At Equitable we have reimagined how we want to work and are guided by principles of inclusivity, flexibility, and connection. Come join us and enjoy working for a leading financial services company with an amazing and diverse culture! We offer a flexible hybrid office/remote work environment, and this position is located in our New York, NY office.

Equitable is looking for a Senior Investment Compliance Analyst to join our team. The Equitable Investment Management (EIM) Portfolio Compliance team oversees compliance with investment guidelines and regulatory requirements on behalf of EIM’s registered mutual funds and private funds. The team supports product development, new product launch, daily compliance testing, regulatory implementation and reporting to the funds’ board of directors.

What You’ll Be Doing

Analyze investment guidelines of 1940 Act funds and create corresponding compliance rules
Support new fund launches through implementation of compliance rules
Update compliance rules based on changes in prospectus disclosures and investment guidelines
Troubleshoot coding issues and making appropriate adjustments
Ensure compliance with prospectus guidelines, regulatory requirements and applicable EIM policies and procedures relating to 1940 Act funds

Assist in development of the compliance program for 1940 Act funds, including implementation of new regulations
Assist with regulatory filings, annual compliance reviews and testing and applicable board reporting obligations
Responsible for the investigation, resolution and remediation of compliance errors in coordination with internal and external stakeholders
Assist with the ongoing compliance and risk management requirements of the funds’ Derivatives Risk Management Program
Participate in special projects and strategic initiatives

This position offers a hybrid work schedule, with an on–site presence of 2–3 days per week combining flexibility with team collaboration.

The base salary range for this position is $130,000 - $160,000. Actual base salaries vary based on skills, experience, and geographical location. In addition to base pay, Equitable provides compensation to reward performance with base salary increases, spot bonuses, and short-term incentive compensation opportunities. Eligibility for these programs depends on level and functional area of responsibility.

For eligible employees, Equitable provides a full range of benefits. This includes medical, dental, vision, a 401(k) plan, and paid time off. For detailed descriptions of these benefits, please reference the link below.

Equitable Pay and Benefits: Equitable Total Rewards Program

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications:

Bachelors Degree
5+ years of portfolio compliance experience
Established knowledge of the Investment Company Act of 1940 and Investment Advisers Act of 1940
Oversight of the compliance system monitoring post-trade activity, including escalation and resolution of issues
Experience supporting 1940 Act fund launches, ongoing fund compliance, testing, and/or disclosures
Knowledge of valuation, liquidity, affiliation, portfolio guidelines, and 1940 Act fund governance

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with sub-advised mutual funds, fund-of-funds and multi-advised fund structures
Demonstrated attention to detail combined with developed analytical, organizational, and critical-thinking skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities, evaluate complex information, and deliver high-quality results with accuracy and precision

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

The AML/KYC Senior Analyst supports the day-to-day execution of the investor onboarding and lifecycle due diligence. This role is focused specifically on private fund investor KYC, including intake, documentation review, entity verification, screening, and file completion, day-to-day production activities supporting investor onboarding and lifecycle monitoring. This role executes defined procedures while developing deeper AML/KYC expertise and supporting SLA‑driven workstreams. Senior Analysts execute defined onboarding procedures across a range of investor types, ensuring subscription-related due diligence files are complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable AML requirements and internal standards.

This role is production-oriented and SLA-driven, with responsibility for identifying documentation gaps, escalating risk triggers, and maintaining high-quality case documentation across onboarding volumes.

What you’ll do:

Perform investor intake, document collection, review, and verification.
Execute AML/KYC tasks in accordance with SOPs.
Handle lower-complexity onboarding or lifecycle cases.
Clearly document findings and decisions.
Escalate issues or data gaps following defined guidelines.
Meet productivity, quality, SLA, and turnaround time targets.

To Qualify for the role, you will have:

2–4 years of AML/KYC, compliance, or financial services experience.
Prior experience supporting onboarding and due diligence workflows.
Familiar with institutional investor documentation and entity structures.
Strong attention to detail, file organization discipline, and ability to work in SLA-driven environments.
Willingness to learn and expand AML/KYC expertise.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Major or concentration in compliance, criminal justice, law, business, accounting, finance, and/or economics preferred.

Skills and Attributes for Success:

Demonstrated professional integrity
Dependable, flexible, and adaptable to new ACA initiatives and changing client needs
Ability to exercise discretion and make independent judgments on matters of significance
Ability to work in a fast-paced, small team environment
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and clients
Highly motivated and goal oriented; pro-active in one’s own education and career progression; volunteers for and shows initiative on both internal and external projects and tasks
Dedicated to upholding ACA’s high-quality standards and customer service focus
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Strong oral and written communication skills
Proficient with Microsoft Office applications and comfortable working in a tech enabled environment.

What working at ACA offers:

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. We also offer unique benefits such as Student Debt Forgiveness and Pet Insurance.

ACA Group is the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. We empower our clients to reimagine GRC and protect and grow their business. Our innovative approach integrates consulting, managed services, and our ComplianceAlpha® technology platform with the specialized expertise of former regulators and practitioners and our deep understanding of the global regulatory landscape.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Salary Range: $60,000.00 - $75,000.00 plus discretionary bonus

The cash compensation range we have provided has been benchmarked against similar organizations of comparable size, sector, and age. Our offers of employment consider a variety of factors, including but not limited to, unique skill sets, specific expertise or certifications and business/organizational needs. Title : FP&A Gross Margin Planning

Pay: $50-$55/hr
Location: Hybrid NYC
Assignment length: 12 months

Primary Purpose:
This position is responsible for developing and managing financial models and tools to forecast, analyze and report Gross Margin results across domestic and international businesses in direct and indirect channels. This role will report to the Sr. Manager, FP&A.

The successful individual will leverage their proficiency in FP&A to…

• Prepare rolling 12-month Gross Margin forecasts on a channel level for each Business Unit and analyze actuals versus forecast and prior year. Explain key variances, business trends and performance drivers. Own communication to TPR.

• Adhoc reporting to support inventory management and BU finance teams.
• Analyze product plans to understand future category assortment and product strategies of all Coach Channels and assess the impact these will have on financial margin.
• Drive strategic planning process through development and analysis of annual operating plans and long-range plans for Gross Margin each year.

The accomplished individual will possess…

• Strong skills in data manipulation and development of dynamic financial models
• Strong analytical, problem solving and decision-making skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable interacting with all levels of the company
• Highly organized and detail-oriented with excellent time management skills. Ability to multi task, prioritize workload and work in a fast paced environment

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or other related field

• Advanced skills in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint required

jobs.title: Manager, Ad Sales Strategy & Analytics
jobs.description:
TelevisaUnivision is the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching audiences across streaming, digital, social, audio, live events, sports, and linear television. Powered by the scale of ViX, premium content, first-party audience capabilities, and deep cultural connection with Hispanic consumers, we help brands drive measurable business outcomes across every stage of the consumer journey.

The Manager, Ad Sales Strategy & Analytics plays a key role in driving advertising revenue growth through revenue forecasting, sales performance analytics, competitive intelligence, and strategic decision-making.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Sales Planning & Analytics, this role owns the weekly advertising revenue forecast and develops bottoms-up revenue projections while partnering closely with Ad Sales and Finance leadership. The Manager will evaluate pipeline and bookings performance, identify revenue risks and opportunities, and translate complex business data into actionable recommendations for Sales and executive leadership.

The role partners across Ad Sales, Finance, Research, Business Development, and Sales Operations.

YOUR DAY TO DAY: Revenue Strategy & Forecasting

Own the weekly advertising revenue forecast and develop bottoms-up projections by account, category, platform, and other relevant dimensions.
Analyze revenue pacing, bookings, forecast accuracy, and performance against budget, plan, and prior year.
Identify and quantify revenue risks and opportunities and provide recommendations to Sales and Finance leadership.
Partner with Ad Sales and Finance on forecasting, annual planning, budgeting, target setting, and long-range revenue planning.
Develop scenarios and sensitivity analyses to assess changes in sales performance and marketplace conditions.

Sales Performance & Pipeline Analytics

Leverage Salesforce to analyze pipeline health, bookings, opportunity stages, expected revenue, aging, win rates, conversion, and pipeline coverage.
Monitor sales performance against revenue targets and quotas and identify opportunities to improve pipeline generation, conversion, and sales productivity.
Develop dashboards, scorecards, and performance reporting for Sales leadership.
Evaluate account, seller, category, and platform performance to identify revenue opportunities and risks.

Sales Compensation & Incentive Analytics

Support sales compensation and incentive planning through quota, attainment, performance, and revenue analysis.
Develop and validate analytics supporting bonus and incentive calculations.
Evaluate the relationship between sales performance, compensation plans, and revenue outcomes.

Market & Competitive Intelligence

Analyze market share, advertiser spending, category trends, competitive activity, and marketplace dynamics.
Leverage syndicated research and competitive intelligence platforms including Nielsen, MediaRadar, Vivvix, and similar sources.
Identify whitespace, share-of-wallet, and growth opportunities across advertisers, categories, and platforms.
Translate market intelligence into actionable revenue and sales recommendations.

Cross-Platform Revenue & Monetizatio
n

Analyze advertising performance across linear television, streaming, digital, social, audio, sports, live events, and emerging platforms.
Evaluate ViX, digital, and social revenue opportunities and audience/content monetization.
Partner with Sales, Research, Product, and Business Development on new advertising products, packages, and cross-platform monetization opportunities.
Assess the financial and revenue implications of new products and monetization strategies.

Executive & Strategic Decision Support

Develop executive presentations, dashboards, and strategic narratives covering revenue performance, forecasts, pipeline, financial results, market trends, risks, and opportunities.
Present analyses and recommendations to the CFO, President of Ad Sales, senior Sales leadership, and broader Sales organization.
Lead ad hoc analyses and strategic projects addressing key business priorities.
Serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales and Finance leadership.

Reporting, Analytics & Team Leadershi
p

Build and automate recurring reporting, dashboards, and forecasting processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
Partner with Sales Operations, Finance, Data, and Technology teams to improve data quality and reporting processes.
Manage and mentor a junior analyst, providing prioritization, coaching, quality control, and professional development.

YOU HAVE Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
2+ years in analytics, sales strategy, finance, revenue management, business intelligence, media, advertising, or a related field.
Experience with revenue forecasting, sales performance analytics, financial analysis, or strategic planning.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations and executive-level insights.
Experience managing multiple priorities and independently owning projects.
Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in media, advertising, television, streaming, or digital advertising.
Experience with Salesforce and sales pipeline analytics.
Experience with Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar BI platforms.
Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python.
Experience with Nielsen, MediaRadar, or similar syndicated research platforms
Familiarity with AI-powered tools for data analysis, reporting, and process improvement.
Experience with sales compensation, quota, bonus, or incentive analytics.
Experience developing revenue forecasting models and measuring forecast accuracy.
Experience partnering with Finance and Sales leadership on budgeting, forecasting, or financial performance.
Prior people management or mentorship experience.

Eligibility Requirements

Must be willing to work 3 days in office in New York.
Employment and education will be verified
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

SALARY RANGE Base Salary – $100,000- $115,000 + Benefits

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. Please note the national salary range listed in the job posting reflects the new hire salary range across levels and U.S. locations that would be applicable to the position.

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401(k); and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental, and vision coverage options.

jobs.title: Senior Contracting Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

Job Description

Mount Sinai is one of the largest U.S. health systems with a strong reputation for quality of care and research. We have over 38,000 employees working together to provide billions of dollars in high-quality care each year for millions of patients.

We are accelerating a transition to a business model focused on population health management – our goal is to keep entire communities healthy and out of the hospital. Mount Sinai Health Partners (MSHP) is the team driving this transformation within Mount Sinai. The team includes 400+ employees with clinical, contracting, finance, IT, analytics, operations, and product development expertise.

MSHP is a fast growing business unit within Mount Sinai and is looking for team members who:

Are comfortable “playing up” and “playing down” as needed to accomplish business objectives
Work productively amidst ambiguity
Thrive in fast-paced work environments
Seek to improve the status quo

What We Offer

Opportunity for advancement within MSHP team
Opportunity to work directly with senior leaders from across the Mount Sinai Health System and external organizations
Opportunity for mentorship from senior MSHP leaders
Opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking team driving a system-wide transformation
Opportunity to work at the forefront of innovation in healthcare

The Managed Care Contracting Team within MSHP is responsible for the negotiation, implementation and contract compliance related to Facility Contracts for all Commercial, Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Managed Care Plans. The team serves as MSHP’s subject matter experts on: Facility related Agreements and Amendments, financial performance for all contracts, and facility, ancillary related contract negotiations. The Managed Care Team is at the forefront of implementing Facility and Ancillary Contracts across the Mount Sinai Health System.

MSHP seeks a Senior Contracting Analyst
to analyze and report the financial performance for all Commercial and Medicare Contracts with Mount Sinai. The Senior Contracting Analyst has responsibilities that include: analyzing medical and pharmacy trends, researching all facility amendments, procuring all financial data necessary for driving Mount Sinai’s Facility models, and reconciling financial data. The Senior Contracting analyst is also expected to liaise and coordinate with other departments in Mount Sinai Health Partners.

Responsibilities

Research from the original contract amendments all financial terms.
Procure and upload all financial data into Experian Contract Manager Tool to determine financial performance.
Model Payer Proposals in Experian Contract Manager Tool.
Reconcile budgeted revenue vs actual revenue collected.
Perform Root Cause Analysis on medical and pharmacy trends for all contracts.
Create Power Point Presentations detailing any analysis regarding facility contracting performance.
Collaborate and liaise with other departments such as Commercialization, Finance, and Patient Accounts.
Responsible for overall management and delivery of the business plan. Financial analysis and creation of reports as requested by department administrator or chairman as applicable
Compiles productivity, compliance and profit/loss reports
Analyzes revenues to identify collection problems, billing issues and other trends.
May be well versed and take a proactive role in the revenue cycle, which includes all administrative and clinical functions that contribute to the capture, management and collection of patient service revenue, including overseeing those who may counsel patients on how best to meet their financial obligations.
Reviews processes and makes recommendations to implement effective changes in procedures and policies.
Assists with or leads special projects and provides analytical support.
Performs other related duties

Qualifications

Education Requirements

HS/GED; Bachelors strongly preferred. Additional experience needed in addition to “experience requirements” listed below in lieu of education.

Experience Requirements

At least seven years of experience in healthcare analytics required (with a Bachelors degree).
Health plan experience in Medical Economics or Value Based Payments preferred.

Additional Skills And Qualification

Understanding of Excel functions such as VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and SUMIFS required.
Basic understanding of statistical concepts such as per capita, weighted averages, variances, and forecasting required.
Experience analyzing Facility, Professional and Pharmacy cost trends preferred.
Familiarity with amendments between payers and providers preferred.
Firm understanding of Facility, Professional and Pharmacy claim reimbursement preferred.
Oral presentation experience, especially with senior management, preferred.
Understanding of data and financial reconciliation preferred.

Employer Description

Strength through Unity and Inclusion

The Mount Sinai Health System is committed to fostering an environment where everyone can contribute to excellence. We share a common dedication to delivering outstanding patient care. When you join us, you become part of Mount Sinai’s unparalleled legacy of achievement, education, and innovation as we work together to transform healthcare. We encourage all team members to actively participate in creating a culture that ensures fair access to opportunities, promotes inclusive practices, and supports the success of every individual.

At Mount Sinai, our leaders are committed to fostering a workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We strive to create an environment where collaboration, fairness, and continuous learning drive positive change, improving the well-being of our staff, patients, and organization. Our leaders are expected to challenge outdated practices, promote a culture of respect, and work toward meaningful improvements that enhance patient care and workplace experiences. We are dedicated to building a supportive and welcoming environment where everyone has the opportunity to thrive and advance professionally. Explore this opportunity and be part of the next chapter in our history.

About The Mount Sinai Health System

Mount Sinai Health System is one of the largest academic medical systems in the New York metro area, with more than 48,000 employees working across eight hospitals, more than 400 outpatient practices, more than 300 labs, a school of nursing, and a leading school of medicine and graduate education. Mount Sinai advances health for all people, everywhere, by taking on the most complex health care challenges of our time — discovering and applying new scientific learning and knowledge; developing safer, more effective treatments; educating the next generation of medical leaders and innovators; and supporting local communities by delivering high-quality care to all who need it. Through the integration of its hospitals, labs, and schools, Mount Sinai offers comprehensive health care solutions from birth through geriatrics, leveraging innovative approaches such as artificial intelligence and informatics while keeping patients’ medical and emotional needs at the center of all treatment. The Health System includes more than 9,000 primary and specialty care physicians; 13 joint-venture outpatient surgery centers throughout the five boroughs of New York City, Westchester, Long Island, and Florida; and more than 30 affiliated community health centers. We are consistently ranked by U.S. News & World Report's Best Hospitals, receiving high "Honor Roll" status, and are highly ranked: No. 1 in Geriatrics, top 5 in Cardiology/Heart Surgery, and top 20 in Diabetes/Endocrinology, Gastroenterology/GI Surgery, Neurology/Neurosurgery, Orthopedics, Pulmonology/Lung Surgery, Rehabilitation, and Urology. New York Eye and Ear Infirmary of Mount Sinai is ranked No. 12 in Ophthalmology. U.S. News & World Report’s “Best Children’s Hospitals” ranks Mount Sinai Kravis Children's Hospital among the country’s best in several pediatric specialties. The Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai is ranked No. 11 nationwide in National Institutes of Health funding and in the 99th percentile in research dollars per investigator according to the Association of American Medical Colleges. Newsweek’s “The World’s Best Smart Hospitals” ranks The Mount Sinai Hospital as No. 1 in New York and in the top five globally, and Mount Sinai Morningside in the top 20 globally.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The Mount Sinai Health System is an equal opportunity employer, complying with all applicable federal civil rights laws. We do not discriminate, exclude, or treat individuals differently based on race, color, national origin, age, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are deeply committed to fostering an environment where all faculty, staff, students, trainees, patients, visitors, and the communities we serve feel respected and supported. Our goal is to create a healthcare and learning institution that actively works to remove barriers, address challenges, and promote fairness in all aspects of our organization.

Compensation

The Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides salary ranges that comply with the New York City Law on Salary Transparency in Job Advertisements. The salary range for the role is $96461 - $144692 Annually. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and operational need. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentive, differential pay or other forms of compensation or benefits.

Data Analytics Manager will be responsible for the development of our strategy to bring on new and grow existing partner relationships leveraging all available data sources and capabilities. The candidate will work closely with external vendors as well as internal marketing and analytics teams to uncover opportunities for growth and deepening partner relationships and customer engagement across all credit card product portfolio.

Responsible for working on big data/analytics projects that gather and integrate large volumes of data, performs analysis, develop predictive models and/or segmentation trees.
Interprets data and analyzes results using various statistical techniques and tools.
Work with partners to create a secure data environment to build insights based on multiple data sources
Leverage existing relationships to build out use cases from internal and external data sources to identify life-events
Evaluate new tools, data, measurement techniques to assess the effectiveness of strategy
Collaborate with cross functional teams to enable data driven product management, customers & partners engagement
Deliver insights and provide actionable recommendations based on reported results, benchmarks, discovered patterns and all necessary context.
Lead efforts to build, develop and maintain dashboards and performance metrics support that support key business decisions.

Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent work experience
Five to seven years of statistical and/or data analytics experience

Working experience working on structured and unstructured data, proficient in analytics and statistical software such as SAS, SQL, Python, R or others to perform analyses and interpret data
Experience in advanced analytics/statistics and predictive modeling
Proficiency in analytics data visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI
Strong problem solving, quantitative and analytical abilities.
Effective interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills, excellent project management and collaboration skills.
Demonstrated marketing and marketing research skills
Familiarity with cardholder transactions data, network and other external data sources

Description

Director, Hospital Revenue Reporting, Recognition, Reimbursement & Analytics-Corporate 42nd Street- Hybrid

The Director, Hospital Revenue Reporting, Recognition, Reimbursement & Analytics for the Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides leadership for revenue recognition, revenue reporting, reimbursement analysis, accounts receivable performance, cash realization, and revenue cycle financial performance across the health system's hospital operations.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Revenue, the Director is responsible for supporting a comprehensive and scalable framework for revenue recognition, reimbursement analytics, financial reporting, accounts receivable oversight, and revenue performance management. The position serves as Finance's primary leader for revenue recognition compliance, net patient service revenue reporting, reimbursement analysis, accounts receivable performance, cash collections analytics, revenue cycle performance measurement, and financial forecasting.

This role ensures compliance with U.S. GAAP, ASC 606, and applicable healthcare regulatory requirements while providing independent financial oversight of the health system's revenue portfolio. The Director transforms operational, reimbursement, and financial data into actionable business intelligence that supports executive decision-making, strengthens revenue integrity, improves liquidity and cash flow performance, enhances financial forecasting, and drives sustainable financial performance.

Working collaboratively with Revenue Cycle, Reimbursement, Managed Care Contracting, Financial Planning, Accounting, Compliance, Internal Audit, and operational leadership, this position develops standardized reporting, establishes governance and controls, identifies financial risks and opportunities, and drives continuous process improvement across the organization.

Responsibilities

Revenue Recognition, ASC 606 Governance & Financial Reporting

Serve as the enterprise leader for revenue recognition governance, ensuring compliance with U.S. GAAP, ASC 606, healthcare regulatory requirements, and organizational policies.
Oversee the revenue recognition process and ensure consistent application of revenue recognition methodologies across all hospital entities and revenue streams.
Develop, implement, and maintain revenue recognition policies, procedures, controls, and documentation supporting ASC 606 compliance.
Evaluate significant accounting estimates and judgments affecting net patient service revenue, including contractual allowances, implicit price concessions, settlements, third-party reimbursement adjustments, and other revenue valuation methodologies.
Direct the preparation, review, and presentation of revenue-related financial reporting, analyses, disclosures, and executive summaries.
Establish and maintain standardized reporting methodologies and definitions across the health system to ensure consistency and transparency.
Partner with Accounting and Finance leadership to support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes related to revenue reporting and revenue recognition.
Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support financial statement audits, revenue-related reviews, compliance assessments, and accounting documentation.
Assess the revenue recognition implications of operational, reimbursement, contractual, regulatory, and strategic business changes.
Ensure accurate and timely preparation of revenue-related financial statement disclosures and supporting documentation.

Revenue Analytics, Accounts Receivable & Reimbursement Performance

Lead the development and maintenance of enterprise accounts receivable reporting across hospital revenue streams.
Monitor and analyze accounts receivable performance by facility, service line, payer, network, and financial class.
Evaluate trends affecting collections, aging, denials, reimbursement, payment velocity, cash realization, and working capital performance.
Assess payer payment patterns, underpayments, reimbursement delays, contractual variances, and collection effectiveness.
Identify emerging financial risks and opportunities affecting revenue recognition, revenue realization, collections, liquidity, and overall financial performance.
Support initiatives to reduce denials, improve clean claim rates, accelerate reimbursement, strengthen payer performance, and optimize cash collections.
Partner with Revenue Cycle leadership to improve financial performance while maintaining independent financial oversight responsibilities.
Analyze managed care contracts, reimbursement arrangements, and payment methodologies affecting hospital services to assess financial impact, revenue implications, reimbursement trends, and financial risk.
Monitor reimbursement performance by payer, contract, facility, service line, and payment methodology to identify opportunities for revenue enhancement and operational improvement.
Evaluate payer compliance with contractual terms and identify reimbursement variances, underpayments, payment integrity concerns, and collection opportunities.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of major reimbursement methodologies affecting hospital reimbursement, including managed care, commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and other payer arrangements.
Understand and analyze the key terms and financial provisions of managed care contracts affecting hospital reimbursement, including reimbursement rates, fee schedules, case rates, bundled payments, value-based arrangements, incentives, and other payment methodologies.
Develop reporting and analytics that assess reimbursement performance and support organizational revenue optimization initiatives.

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management

Develop revenue forecasts and financial performance projections utilizing historical trends, reimbursement analyses, operational drivers, and ASC 606 revenue recognition assumptions.
Support enterprise cash forecasting through comprehensive analysis of accounts receivable performance, collection trends, reimbursement patterns, and revenue realization.
Perform financial modeling to assess the impact of operational, payer, reimbursement, and regulatory changes on revenue, cash flow, and liquidity.
Establish, monitor, and continuously enhance key performance indicators (KPIs) related to revenue recognition, financial reporting, accounts receivable, collections, reimbursement performance, and revenue cycle effectiveness.
Produce recurring executive dashboards, scorecards, analytics packages, and performance reports for senior leadership and governance committees.
Analyze actual versus expected performance and provide actionable insights to improve financial and operational results.
Develop revenue trend analyses and benchmarking reports to support strategic planning and organizational decision-making.
Monitor and interpret government reimbursement methodologies and regulatory changes affecting hospital revenue streams and assess implications for reimbursement performance, revenue recognition, financial reporting, forecasting, and cash flow.
Evaluate proposed changes to Medicare, Medicaid, managed care, and commercial reimbursement methodologies and quantify projected financial impacts across hospital revenue streams, including modeling changes in rates, payment methodologies, coverage policies, and reimbursement requirements.
Incorporate reimbursement assumptions, payer-specific trends, contractual provisions, regulatory developments, and payment methodology changes into forecasting models, financial planning processes, and long-range revenue projections.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning initiatives through advanced reimbursement and revenue performance analytics.

Strategic Leadership & Business Partnership

Identify financial risks, opportunities, and emerging trends impacting revenue performance, reimbursement, collections, and financial sustainability.
Collaborate with Managed Care, Revenue Cycle, Reimbursement, Financial Planning, Compliance, and operational leadership to identify revenue optimization opportunities.
Investigate revenue shortfalls, payment variances, and other performance concerns and develop recommendations for corrective action.
Promote standardization, automation, and continuous improvement of reporting, analytics, forecasting, and governance processes.
Create feedback mechanisms and performance measurement frameworks that support sustainable organizational improvement.
Provide leadership and support governance processes that facilitate effective, efficient, standardized, compliant, and transparent practices.
Challenge existing assumptions and operational practices to facilitate informed decision-making and balanced evaluation of risks and opportunities.
Present complex financial analyses and recommendations to executive leadership and operational stakeholders.
Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of reimbursement methodologies applicable to hospital services, including managed care, commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, bundled payments, value-based payment arrangements, and alternative reimbursement models.
Understand and evaluate key financial provisions within managed care contracts, including reimbursement rates, fee schedules, case rates, bundled payments, incentives, risk arrangements, capitation methodologies, and alternative payment models.
Monitor government reimbursement methodologies, payer policies, industry developments, and regulatory changes affecting revenue recognition, reimbursement performance, financial reporting, and organizational financial results.

Support contract modeling, reimbursement analysis, and strategic initiatives designed to improve reimbursement performance, mitigate financial risk, and strengthen long-term financial sustainability.

Compliance & Other Responsibilities

jobs.description:
Overview

The Systems Manager, GCP Data Engineering, Enterprise Data & Analytics, leads the hands-on technical team responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the enterprise-grade data pipelines that power the Enterprise Data & Analytics Platform (EDAP). This role manages a highly skilled team of engineers who own the core stages of the data lifecycle on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)including data transfer, ingestion, transformation, curation, exposure, and activation.

In this role, you will lead the strategic build-out of scalable data pipelines to enable reliable downstream data activation for business stakeholders, analytics, and AI/ML model deployment. You will collaborate directly with solution architects, business system owners, and platform partners to deliver high-quality data products while maintaining hands-on depth in SQL, Python, Spark, and GCP-native serverless architecture. The ideal candidate blends outstanding technical, data engineering, and data modeling expertise with a proven track record of people management, fostering a culture of operational excellence, FinOps cost-efficiency, and rigorous data governance implementation.

This position does not provide employment pursuant to the terms of a STEM OPT Training Plan.

Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a technical, high-performing team of GCP data engineers, establishing work plans, setting performance metrics, and managing day-to-day agile execution
Hands-on Technical Leadership: Maintain deep technical expertise to guide architecture, review code, and directly assist with prototyping, troubleshooting, and unblocking complex pipeline issues
Data Ingestion & Transfer: Oversee the secure onboarding of diverse batch and streaming datasets from legacy on-premises systems and cloud sources into the landing zone of the platform
Data Transformation & Curation: Drive the design and development of performant, automated data transformations, establishing trusted, clean datasets via a structured medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers) using tools such as SQL, Python, and Dataform
Data Exposure & Activation: Lead the delivery of secure exposure layers (views, authorized datasets, APIs) that surface curated data products to business consumers, dashboard interfaces, and advanced AI systems (Enterprise Gemini/Vertex AI / Model & Agent Garden)
Pipeline Reliability & FinOps: Establish monitoring, alerting, and performance-tuning frameworks to ensure data pipelines are resilient, highly available, and cost-efficient. Coordinate closely with FinOps to identify spend anomalies and optimize GCP query and storage costs
Governance & Compliance Alignment: Implement and operationalize data quality rules, data classification, lineage tracking, and access controls in tight integration with the Data Governance team, ensuring compliance with privacy rules (PII, NERC CIP)
Collaborative Partnering: Act as the key liaison between data engineering, platform operations, legacy migration workstreams, and business stakeholders to align platform capabilities with immediate use cases

Qualifications

Required Education/Experience

Master's Degree and a minimum of 6 years relevant full-time work experience or
Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 8 years relevant full-time work experience

Preferred Education/Experience

Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, Business, or a technology-centric field and a minimum of 6 years of relevant full-time work experience in GCP data engineering building scalable data pipelines, managing skilled teams, and delivering governed, cost-efficient data products for analytics and AI/ML

Relevant Work Experience

Demonstrated experience in hands-on data engineering, pipeline architecture, or data platform operations, including time spent leading and managing technical teams, required
Extensive hands-on experience designing, developing, and operating large-scale data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform, using services like BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataplex, and Cloud Storage, required
Proficient in SQL, Python, or Spark for large-scale data processing and data modeling, required
Solid experience with ETL/ELT pipeline design, workflow orchestration (e.g., Composer/Airflow), CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred), and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform), required
Experience defining and managing operational metrics, SLAs, and KPIs for enterprise-level data integration platforms, required
Familiarity with implementing data governance frameworks, metadata management, and data quality testing tools (e.g., Great Expectations, Dataplex), preferred
Background in utilities, energy, or other regulated industries with exposure to NERC CIP compliance, security protocols, and data classification, preferred
Experience supporting migration initiatives moving data workloads off legacy ecosystems (such as Azure, Databricks, and C3.ai) onto GCP, preferred

Skills and Abilities

Effective leadership skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment
Demonstrated problem solving skills
Demonstrated time management and priority setting skills
Well organized, detail oriented and flexible to handle multiple assignments

Licenses and Certifications

Driver's License Required

Accredited Asset Management Specialist (AAMS) Technical certification(s) in IT Preferred

jobs.title: Security & Network Analyst II
jobs.description:
**Security & Network Analyst II**
---------------------------------

Under intermediate supervision, the Security & Network Analyst II supports cybersecurity operations by monitoring security events, identifying potential threats, and assisting with incident response activities. This role supports threat detection and incident response efforts, collaborates with security engineers and analysts to improve security controls, and contributes to threat hunting and detection tuning initiatives. The Security Analyst II applies developing expertise to identify risks, strengthen defenses, and enhance the organization's overall security posture.

**Key Responsibilities & Essential Functions**
----------------------------------------------

* Support security and network operations activities with a focus on threat detection, cyber defense, incident response, and maintaining the security and availability of enterprise systems.
* Monitor, investigate, and resolve alerts from SIEM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, firewall, vulnerability management, identity, cloud security, and network monitoring platforms.
* Analyze logs, endpoint telemetry, authentication records, firewall events, DNS activity, proxy logs, packet captures, and network flow data to identify security threats, operational issues, and performance concerns.
* Investigate and manage assigned tickets, including suspicious activity reports, security alerts, vulnerability findings, VPN issues, access requests, connectivity problems, and service interruptions.
* Conduct incident response activities, including event analysis, scoping, evidence collection, documentation, containment support, escalation, and post-incident follow-up in accordance with established procedures.
* Troubleshoot issues involving DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, firewall policies, VPN connectivity, wireless networks, identity services, endpoints, and application access.
* Evaluate false positives, benign activity, policy violations, operational issues, and security incidents requiring escalation or response.
* Escalate complex technical issues to Security Engineering, Network Engineering, Infrastructure, or application support teams with appropriate documentation, supporting evidence, and impact assessments.
* Assist with identifying recurring issues, monitoring gaps, alert quality concerns, and process improvement opportunities; recommend enhancements to strengthen operational effectiveness and security visibility.
* Support vulnerability management activities by validating findings, assessing exposure, assisting with remediation prioritization, and tracking resolution efforts.
* Assist with firewall rule reviews, VPN troubleshooting, network segmentation validation, access control issues, implementation testing, and post-change monitoring with minimal oversight.
* Collaborate with Security Engineering, Network Engineering, Infrastructure, and application teams to improve security monitoring, detection capabilities, operational procedures, and incident response processes.
* Create and maintain investigation notes, knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, operational procedures, and incident documentation with minimal oversight.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to less experienced analysts and contribute to team training initiatives when needed.
* Participate in security projects, technology implementations, and continuous improvement efforts to enhance cybersecurity and network operations capabilities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. A combination of education and experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Three or more years of experience in technology, cybersecurity operations, network operations, infrastructure support, incident response, or a closely related technical role.
* Intermediate knowledge related to SOC, NOC, security operations, network operations, managed security, enterprise infrastructure, or hybrid security/network operations environment preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex tickets, alerts, incidents, and troubleshooting tasks with limited supervision and strong judgment on when to escalate.
* Intermediate Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, firewalls, proxy services, wireless networking, endpoint security, identity and access management, and common enterprise security controls.
* Intermediate experience using several of the following tools preferred: SIEM (e.g., Splunk), EDR/XDR (e.g., Microsoft Defender, Cortex XDR), firewall management platforms (e.g., Palo Alto Panorama/PA firewalls, Cisco firewalls), vulnerability scanners (e.g., Tenable), email/phishing security tools (e.g., PhishER), IDS/IPS, packet capture tools, network monitoring systems, log analysis platforms, ITSM/ticketing systems, and cloud security or infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Experience to analyze endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and application telemetry to identify anomalous activity, unauthorized access, malware behavior, phishing, credential abuse, lateral movement, vulnerability exploitation, or service degradation.
* Ability to perform structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across security, network, endpoint, identity, and application layers.
* Experience supporting incident response activities such as alert validation, event correlation, impact assessment, containment coordination, evidence collection, timeline development, and post-incident documentation.
* Experience reviewing or supporting firewall policies, VPN access, network segmentation, remote access technologies, and secure connectivity workflows preferred.
* Understanding of frameworks and models such as NIST NICE, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, or similar operational security frameworks preferred.
* Experience supporting hybrid cloud or SaaS environment

**JOB TITLE**: Data Analyst

**DEPARTMENT:** Data Strategy & Reporting

**HOURS**: 40 Hours Monday – Friday 9:00a – 5:00p

**FLSA STATUS**: Exempt

**JOB TYPE:** Full-Time

**About Healthix**  
Healthix is the largest public health information exchange (HIE) in New York State, securely connecting thousands of healthcare providers, hospitals, health plans, and community organizations to improve the quality, safety, and efficiency of care. Through the secure exchange of health information, Healthix helps ensure that clinicians, care teams, and public health partners have access to the data they need to make informed decisions and deliver better outcomes for the communities they serve.

As part of our ongoing **organizational transformation**, Healthix is expanding its focus beyond data exchange to making health information more actionable and impactful for healthcare providers, community partners, and public health initiatives. This transformation reflects our commitment to strengthening community partnerships, improving health equity, and supporting innovative approaches that connect healthcare with community-based services.

Through initiatives such as **Healthix Connects**, our internal volunteer and community engagement program, we are deepening our relationships with local organizations and creating opportunities for our team to actively support healthier, safer communities.

Joining Healthix means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that is shaping the future of health information sharing while building stronger connections between healthcare systems and the communities they serve.

**THE ROLE:**  
The Data Analyst provides the foundation for analytics, namely the collection, quality assurance and availability of data. This IT role requires a significant set of technical skills, including a deep knowledge of SQL, SQL database design and multiple programming languages as well as communication skills to understand what data and analysis the healthcare analysts want to gain from Healthix data stores. They are responsible for the maintenance, improvement, cleansing and manipulation of data in the organization’s operational and analytics databases. The Data Analyst works with team members to define and build data pipelines to orchestrate the movement, transformation, validation, and loading of data from the source to the final destination – data stores defined and implemented based on system requirements and data consumer requirements.

Typical tasks performed include working with the data architect on data warehouse design, ensuring data loads quickly, is easily accessible and rapidly comprehensible for analysts/users; extract, transform, and load (ETL) processing; performing thorough testing and validation in order to support the accuracy of data transformations and data verification to ensure correctness and that data is generally reliable for downstream consumption; data bounds checking and database tuning.

The Data Analyst strives to ensure proper data governance and quality for the Data Strategy team and the entire organization. They analyze complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. They work collaboratively within the Data Strategy team, providing support for their data centric needs. The candidate has strong working and conceptual knowledge of database queries multidimensional query and index tuning, monitoring, disaster recovery, backup, automated testing, automated schema migration, and continuous deployment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Enhance and streamline data and pipeline architecture to improve data flow and collection.
* Partner with software developers, database architects, and data analysts to support data initiatives and ensure reliable data delivery.
* Independently address the data requirements of multiple teams, systems, and products.
* Refine or redesign Healthix’s data architecture to enable next‑generation products and data capabilities.
* Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and reporting solutions to support growing data volumes, performance and complex queries across Databricks, MS SQL Server, and InterSystems HealthShare.
* Work with Data Strategy and Business teams to improve data models and increase data accessibility for business intelligence.
* Implement monitoring processes to safeguard data quality, accuracy, and availability for key stakeholders.
* Develop queries, support reporting needs, and tailor reporting solutions to enable data‑driven decision‑making.

* Provide general reporting and project support across the organization.
* Ensure reporting meets standards for reliability, accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Support the development, ETL processes, and maintenance of company data assets and data models, design data integrations and data quality frameworks.
* Evaluate open‑source and vendor data‑lineage tools and contribute to long‑term data platform architecture planning across IT and Business teams.
* Assist in developing an integrated data warehouse to provide a comprehensive healthcare dataset.

 **Requirements**

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS and COMPETENCIES:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in a Data Analyst role, with a graduate degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Healthcare Informatics, Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field. IBM Certified Data Engineer or Google Certified Professional is preferred.
* Experience with healthcare data, including HL7, CCDAs, MS SQL Server, Databricks, Tableau, InterSystems HealthShare, and Cache databases.
* Advanced SQL knowledge and experience with relational datab

jobs.title: Research Analyst - Enterprise Tech
jobs.description:
Enterprise technology is our largest and fastest-moving area of coverage, and demand for our research there is growing faster than we can produce it. That gap is why this role exists. You’ll join our Enterprise Tech team and cover software, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, data & AI, and IT services. You’ll write the research investors and corporate strategy teams use to judge where enterprise IT budgets are going, which vendors are winning and losing, and how fast AI is moving from pilots into production spend.

You’ll learn the sector from two sources: the domain expert who leads it, and the thousands of transcripts we collect from CIOs, CISOs, IT decision-makers, and other senior operators who buy and deploy enterprise technology. Institutions pay for that data to get up to speed on the space, and you’ll be analyzing it from day one. We’re hiring for analytical ability, writing quality, and speed of learning. Over time, you’ll build real depth and rigor, and you’ll own sub-sectors of your own.

**What the day-to-day looks like**

* Use our proprietary datasets to build company and market analyses across enterprise tech: application software, infrastructure and hyperscalers, security, data platforms, AI/LLM vendors, and IT services. You’ll work under the sector lead at first and own more of the coverage over time.
* Track the signals that drive the sector, including IT budget intentions, vendor consolidation and displacement, seat and consumption trends, pricing and renewal dynamics, and AI adoption and spend. Turn them into quantified, time-series views of who is gaining share and why.
* Turn data collection studies into client-ready outputs, such as quantified findings, charts, vendor scorecards, and written takeaways that investors can use ahead of earnings and corporate teams can use in planning.
* Build forward-looking analyses on emerging themes, such as agentic AI, security platformization, cloud optimization cycles, and the effect of AI on seat-based software models, and form a view before the market does.
* Write for our newsletter and client communications so that Qualitate is a go-to voice on enterprise tech.
* Support client and prospect conversations through calls, webinars, and events, and learn to lead them over time.
* Shape how we study enterprise tech: design survey and interview frameworks for buyer behavior, and partner with product and engineering to keep our methodology best-in-class.
* Grow into a coverage area of your own within enterprise tech. We’ll help you find the space where your judgment compounds fastest.

**Who This Role Is For**

* 1–3 years of professional experience in data-driven research, such as equity research, financial analysis, market research, and/or consulting. Exposure to software, internet, semiconductors, or IT services coverage is a strong plus but not required.
* Familiarity with enterprise software economics (ARR, net revenue retention, consumption vs. seat-based pricing, sales cycles), or the ability to pick it up quickly.
* An understanding of the fundamental research workflow, from how funds source ideas and build conviction through primary research to how they size positions and manage risk, or an eagerness to learn it quickly.
* Real curiosity about how enterprises buy and adopt technology. You should enjoy following the full stack, from infrastructure to applications, and be able to reach a credible working knowledge of a new category quickly.
* Clear communication. Long-form and short-form writing skills are required. You must be able to synthesize data into digestible, forward-looking insights, and you should be comfortable presenting your work to investors and strategy clients.
* Heavy experimentation with AI. You test and refine AI tools and agents as they ship, build them into your daily workflows, automate pieces of your own job to raise your productivity, and share what you learn with your team. In this coverage area, that hands-on experience doubles as sector insight.

**What Sets You Apart**

* **You learn and iterate quickly.** For this role, this is the single most important thing. You’ll work alongside accomplished professionals across research, product, and engineering. Pick up what they know and put it to use, and teach them what you know that they don’t.
* **A strong sense of ownership.** This is not just a supporting seat. You’ll be handed more scope than your years of experience would suggest. We expect you to take work from question to published output rather than wait to be assigned the next step.
* **An analytical mind.** You get excited about diving into a large semi-structured dataset to find key inflections and generate new ideas. You’re proficient at managing and analyzing large datasets, and SQL experience is strongly preferred.
* **You use AI for both speed and rigor.** You use AI to get up to speed on a space faster and to go deeper than you otherwise could: pressure-testing ideas, automating the analyses you never had time for, and expanding what one analyst can rigorously cover. In a sector as broad and fast-moving as enterprise tech, that leverage is what makes real depth possible.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base salary: $130k–$170k+
* Bonus: Variable, based on goals achieved at the company, team, and individual levels
* Equity: Meaningful early-stage grant with upside tied to company growth
* Benefits: Health coverage, flexible PTO, paid holidays
* Location: Full-time, in-person in New York City

**What to expect working at Qualitate**

* **Excellence.** You’ll be held accountable to an exceptionally high bar for quality and impact.
* **High velocity.** A fast-paced environment for growth, decision-making, and time to impact.
* **High agency.** Ownership over how you work, not just what you work on. We hire people we trust to figure it out.
* **A builder’s mindset.** You’ll create the processes, playbooks, and systems that define how this company scales.
* **Shared ambition.** A small, earl
