jobs.description:
Who is StubWorld?

StubWorld is a leading ticket resale, distribution and analytics business serving pro sports teams and live entertainment partners nationwide. We manage ticket inventory in real time across multiple sales channels, using market data and pricing strategy to maximize value for every event — from regular season games to playoff runs. If you love sports and want a job where market movement, player news, and ticket demand actually matter to your paycheck, this is it.

What are we looking for?

We're expanding our pricing team and looking for a Pricing Analyst who will work closely with ownership, analyze marketplace data, implement pricing strategy, and own weekend event coverage. This is a long-term role with real growth potential — StubWorld is one of several growing businesses under our umbrella, and the right person will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility across other projects as they prove themselves, not just sit still in one lane.

What would you do?

Manage and price ticket inventory across multiple sales channels.

Analyze historical sales, secondary market data, and industry trends to set and adjust pricing in real time.

Track sales and market movement on both primary and secondary markets, and report findings to ownership.

Roll out price changes across channels as market conditions shift — sometimes hour to hour on game day.

Build and maintain pricing models and recommendations.

Own Friday evening and Saturday event-day pricing and inventory coverage (see schedule below) — this is core to the role, not overtime.

Use AI and modern data tools (not just spreadsheets) to speed up pricing analysis, trend-spotting, and reporting — we want someone who wants to build this skill, not just run static Excel models.

Grow into additional responsibilities across our other business ventures as you prove yourself.

Schedule:

Tuesday–Thursday: standard business hours, in office

Friday: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (covers Friday night event pricing)

Saturday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM (covers Saturday event pricing)

Sunday and Monday: permanent days off

Weekend coverage (Fri/Sat) is a fixed, ongoing part of this role tied to live event schedules — not occasional.

What do you bring?

Strong analytical skills and comfort interpreting large datasets.

Working knowledge of AI-assisted tools for data analysis and reporting (ChatGPT, Claude, Excel/Sheets with AI add-ins, etc.) — we'd rather train someone curious about this than someone stuck in pure-manual Excel habits.

Excellent communicator, able to report findings clearly to ownership.

Reliable, highly detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities under deadline.

Genuine enthusiasm for sports and live entertainment markets.

Comfortable working some night and weekend hours as a fixed part of the schedule above.

Required: High school diploma, GED, or equivalent

Desired: Bachelor's degree in Economics, Mathematics, Finance, or related field

Preferred experience:

Data analytics or pricing analysis

Ticketing, sports, or entertainment industry

Sales reporting/forecasting

Special Requirements:

Applicant should reside within a 40-mile radius of Pomona, NY 10970.

This is an in-person role.

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: $50,000 – $67,000/year, with room for fast advancement

Benefits: Paid time off

Schedule: Tuesday–Saturday (details above); Sunday & Monday off

Supplemental Pay: Bonus opportunities

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces - we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company's long-term success.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst who combines a strong foundation in Windows-based IT administration with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating modern information security tools, alongside a governance-focused mindset. This role is critical to the success of our security operations and will play a key part in evaluating, testing, and deploying emerging technologies and new procedures, ensuring JRM remains proactive in an ever-evolving cybersecurity landscape. The ideal candidate is not only technically proficient but also highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain detailed documentation, and uphold structured workflows. The Analyst also shares responsibility for incident response.

Reporting directly to the Manager of Information Security, this position offers an exciting opportunity for a security-minded technologist to thrive within a forward-thinking program that values agility, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

Governance & Risk Management:

* Assist in developing, documenting, and enforcing cybersecurity policies, standards, and control procedures.
* Support alignment with frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Maintain the security risk register and perform technical risk assessments and drive remediation to closure.

Windows IT Administration & Hardening:

* Leverage expertise in Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, and PowerShell to engineer, automate, and maintain secure system baselines.
* Work with the IT and infrastructure teams to ensure secure configurations and compliance enforcement across the environment.
* Deploy, configure, and tune endpoint management and compliance controls using modern UEM, MDM, and EDR tools.

Identity Security & Access Management:

* Implement identity governance practices, privileged access controls, phishing resistant MFA, and conditional access policy design across Microsoft Entra ID and other third-party IdPs.
* Automate and improve lifecycle management processes, including secure onboarding and offboarding.

Phishing Defense & Awareness:

* Operate a phishing simulation and security awareness platform, run phishing simulations, and report on campaign effectiveness.
* Triage user-reported phishing attempts and maintain IT communication templates and user education content.

Security Engineering & Tooling:

* Design, deploy, and maintain core security platforms, including EDR, SIEM, email security, and vulnerability management.
* Maintain configuration baselines and documentation for deployed security tools.
* Integrate security tools with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and the broader IT environment to improve visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Run vulnerability scanning, prioritize findings by risk, and coordinate remediation with IT and infrastructure teams.

Detection, Incident Response & Automation:

* Monitor SIEM alerts and dashboards, and tune detections to reduce noise.
* Act as a technical responder in security incidents: triage, investigate, contain, and document root cause and lessons learned.
* Support incident response playbooks and tabletop exercises.
* Automate repetitive security tasks and response workflows using PowerShell, Python, and SOAR or automation platforms.

Innovation & Emerging Technology Evaluation:

* Participate in research, testing, and proof-of-concept (PoC) efforts for new cybersecurity tools, technologies, and frameworks.
* Deploy new technologies and procedures that improve detection, prevention, and governance.
* Provide technical input and analysis for tool evaluations, pilots, and strategic initiatives.

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 3+ years of experience in IT administration, systems engineering, or information security, with a strong focus on Windows environments.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), third-party IDP providers, Intune, and modern endpoint security tools.
* Scripting and automation skills in PowerShell.
* Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and governance models (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS).
* Analytical, collaborative, and adaptable mindset with strong documentation skills.

Preferred:

* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and tuning security tools such as EDR, email security, and vulnerability management platforms, or evaluating emerging and cloud security solutions.
* Exposure to SIEM detection engineering and SOAR or automation platforms.
* Experience in risk assessments, audit preparation, or compliance reporting.
* Familiarity with Python, SQL, or Bash/Shell for automation and security analysis.

**Salary Information**  
To the extent this position is performed in New York City, the annual salary range for this role is $90,000 - $110,000.

Protos Security, a subsidiary of Security Services Holdings, is one of the nation’s leading providers of physical security services. The Junior Financial Analyst is a member of the Commercial & Sales Finance team, reporting to the Director of Commercial & Sales Finance. The role spans two functions, Commercial Finance and Sales Finance, supporting financial and sales reporting and analysis across Protos’ clients and service lines. Within Commercial Finance, the Junior Financial Analyst will prepare management reporting packages, maintain dashboards, support monthly revenue forecasting, and analyze performance through variance and trend analysis. Within Sales Finance, the role will monitor and report on sales activity, including pipeline, new business opportunities, and client wins and losses, and support opportunity review processes. Across both areas, the role will conduct ad hoc analysis and work closely with Sales, Operations, Accounting, and FP&A to deliver accurate reporting and analysis.

Commercial Finance

Sales Finance

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret financial and operational data and identify key trends, variances, and opportunities.
* Understanding of fundamental financial concepts, including revenue, gross profit, margins, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Strong proficiency in Excel (formulas, lookups, pivot tables) and PowerPoint.

We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. * Understands the process flow from end to end including the reasons for each step, the process controls, the risks within the process and the upstream/downstream impacts of their work based on an understanding the work affects other operational

* Demonstrated ability to apply judgment within established guidelines to resolve routine exceptions while maintaining risk awareness and escalating issues appropriately
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for effective phone and email interaction with internal partners
* Ability to be flexible within the hours of 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM Monday through Friday

jobs.title: Credit Analyst I
jobs.description:
At OceanFirst Bank, each one of our employees plays an important role in delivering value to our customers and executing daily tasks in accordance with our core values. We recognize that our employees are essential to our success, making OceanFirst a great place to work and do business.
  
**Great benefits include:** employee perks & discount programs, tuition assistance, incentive compensation program, professional development opportunities, and more! Apply today to #BecomeOceanFirst and make an impact in the local community!
  
ABOUT YOUR ROLE
  
Under guidance of the Credit management, perform analysis of commercial loan requests and borrower information including but not limited to financial analysis, operating performance, industry trends and economic conditions to make initial assessment of credit worthiness. Provide analysis detail and written summaries that facilitate and support the assignment of credit risk rating. Document any deviations from the Commercial Loan Policy as appropriate.
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO LIST
  
Under guidance and direction, perform detailed credit analysis of commercial loan requests and borrower information, including financial statements synopsis, management profiles, business and product cycles, cash flow and trends, operating analysis and debt service calculation. Loan relationships generally include single facility companies and basic collateral relationships within more common industries.
  
With direction, conduct preliminary assessment of credit worthiness of borrower; review historical operating performance and research economic and market conditions as they relate to the borrower's company and industry. Research industry specific information from outside sources, which may include industry publications, area libraries, references from other banks, credit agencies, and internet searches and information sites.
  
Perform preliminary analysis of collateral. Assess the quality and source of collateral being pledged. Under guidance of lending staff, apply an appropriate discount factor to determine an estimation of collateral.
  
Perform preliminary analysis of a guarantor's financial position and construct personal net cash flow through investigation of personal financial statements, personal tax returns and credit reporting documentation. Develop an understanding of any contingent liabilities and prepares summary.
  
Assist in the preparation of the initial assessment that summarizes key strengths and risks and includes identification of any deviations from the Bank's Commercial Loan policy.
  
Under guidance of senior commercial lending team, become familiar with alternative structures in order to reduce credit risk.
  
Under guidance and direction recommended a credit risk rating.
  
Assist in preparation of loan package for presentation and/or approval including the preparation of spreads, cash flows and other required attachments.
  
Partner with lending team to conduct thorough annual reviews of current portfolio clients including review of financials, site visits, assessment of general business information and other factors that would be indicators of risk.
  
Ensure that all work is in compliance with applicable laws, regulations and company guidelines as detailed in company policies. Seek guidance from senior credit staff as necessary and appropriate to resolve potential issues.
  
Develop knowledge of Company and department systems, practices, and policies. Actively participate in training programs and opportunities to expand knowledge and analytical abilities.
  
Participate in special projects and performs additional duties as required.
  
Understands compliance with all regulations governing the banking industry, as well as agency guidelines and organization policies.
  
Understands the compliance requirements to ensure files are maintained in accordance with regulations.
  
WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU
  
Basic knowledge of credit and financial analysis techniques. Understanding of business, finance, accounting, and economic factors affecting credit analysis and issuance of credit.
  
General knowledge of the lending process and ability to interpret the policies & procedures governing commercial credit.
  
Demonstrated written and verbal communication, and listening skills.
  
Demonstrated interpersonal skills, and proven ability to work in a team environment.
  
Strong organizational skills, ability to set priorities in a multi-task environment and meet deadlines.
  
Demonstrated proficiency with MS Office, specific capability in Word and Excel.
  
Ability to maintain the confidentiality of credit and customer information.
  
  
**Requirements:**  
YOUR QUALIFICATIONS
  
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or Economics, or equivalent related work experience.
  
Demonstrated work experience in an office environment; preferably in banking/financial services.
  
  
INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL CONTACTS
  
Internal contact with Lenders and Portfolio Manager.
  
External customer, prospect and referral source contacts.
  
WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  
Office environment. Ability to operate computer. Ability to communicate in order to exchange simple to complex information with individuals and groups. Ability to travel throughout Bank footprint.
  
**Salary Range:** $48,460.00 - $72,370.00

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

POSITION SUMMARY

  
  

Registered Client Relationship Analysts provide exceptional service to our clients and support Financial Advisor(s) (FAs)/ Private Wealth Advisor(s) (PWAs)/ teams on a daily basis. Through regular interactions with clients, individuals in this role build trusted relationships. Leading with a client first mindset, a successful candidate for this role will have strong interpersonal skills and will be able to assist clients with their everyday needs.

  
  

DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:

  
  

CLIENT SUPPORT

  
  

Provide service coverage for a FA/PWA/team including:

* Supporting the FA/PWA/team in cultivating and enhancing new and existing client relationships

* Executing money movement transactions at the request of the client and/or FA/PWA/team

* Answering general non-investment related questions concerning client accounts, including relaying stock positions and providing account balances (e.g., funds due and margin debit)

* Enter profile information or pre-fill account documentation on client accounts and/or documents in a clerical capacity at the direction of the client and/or FA/PWA/team

* Educating or enrolling clients in digital tools (e.g. MSOnline, eSign, eAuthorization)

* Onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation in a clerical capacity at the direction of the client and/or FA/PWA/team

* Provide existing clients with details around their account information (e.g., investment objectives, risk tolerance)

* Assists Financial Advisor(s) / team in delivering against their business plan and client service model

* Remaining current on all policies, procedures and new platforms

**WinCap Support Analyst - School Accounting & Financial Software**

**Harris School Solutions – Remote**

**Salary range:** **$55,000–$70,000 per year** , based on experience.

  

**Have an accounting background? Like solving problems? Put your experience to work for New York schools.**

  

School districts manage millions in public funds. Every purchase order, vendor payment, deposit and budget line has to be tracked and reported correctly. Our WinCap Support Analysts help make that happen. You’ll be the expert that school business offices and BOCES across New York State rely on when they need answers.

  

If you’ve worked in bookkeeping, accounts payable, purchasing, budgeting or a school business office, you already have the hardest part of this job. You bring the accounting know-how that helps our clients keep the books balanced and meet their deadlines with confidence.

  

**Why this role may be a great fit for accounting professionals**

* **Your experience counts from day one.** You’ll support the full financial cycle: purchasing, accounts payable, accounts receivable, budgeting and the general ledger.
* **Make a visible impact.** Your support helps New York schools manage public funds accurately and stay audit-ready.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Serve as a frontline, primary support contact for WinCap clients by responding to support tickets and phone inquiries
* Troubleshoot questions across the financial system, including **Purchasing, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Budgeting and General ledger**
* Handle escalated issues directly with customers
* Lead client training through webinars and user group sessions
* Spot bugs and enhancement ideas, then document them clearly for our development team
* Know when to escalate, and pass issues on with the details needed to fix them fast
* Build and improve user guides, support documentation and internal processes
Perform other related duties as assigned  

  

**What you bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or business, or equivalent work experience
* A solid understanding of accounting principles and day-to-day bookkeeping
* Hands-on experience with the following area: purchasing, AP, AR, budgeting and general ledger
* Excellent customer service and communication skills
* Sharp analytical and troubleshooting skills
* The ability to stay calm and organized when several priorities compete
A positive, professional and solutions-focused approach  

  

**Bonus points if you have**

* Knowledge of fund accounting, governmental accounting or public-sector budgeting
* Experience supporting accounting, ERP or financial software
* Familiarity with public-sector purchasing rules or NYS school financial reporting
Business office experience in a New York State school district or BOCES (strongly preferred)  

  

**Ready to bring your accounting expertise to a role where you’re the expert? Apply today.**

jobs.title: Analyst, Data Science - Burson
jobs.description:
### **Who we are:**

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

### **More about the role:**

We are seeking a hands-on **Analyst, Data Science** to join Burson's **Insights & Intelligence (I&I)** team.

The I&I team sits at the heart of Burson's work, turning data into strategic insights that drive storytelling, campaign performance, and business outcomes. With an expanding client roster and growing scopes of work, our best-in-class team supports some of the world's most recognizable global brands, including The Coca-Cola Company, Verizon, and Google.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their data science career who is excited to apply technical and analytical skills to real-world business, marketing, and communications challenges. Working alongside data scientists, analysts, engineers, and strategists, you'll support data science, dashboarding, and AI-driven initiatives that turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.

The ideal candidate has **1–2 years of relevant experience** and a strong foundation in Python, SQL, statistics, and data analysis. We're looking for someone who is intellectually curious, comfortable working with complex datasets, and eager to continue developing their technical and client-facing skills.

### **What you'll do:**

* Support the end-to-end delivery of data science and analytics projects, including data preparation, analysis, modeling, visualization, and documentation
* Assist with the development, testing, and refinement of predictive models, including time-series, forecasting, and machine learning solutions
* Write and maintain code in **Python, SQL, and/or R** to clean, transform, analyze, and model data
* Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities
* Support the development and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
* Work with structured and unstructured data from APIs, cloud platforms, databases, and other sources
* Integrate analytical and predictive outputs into client-ready dashboards, reports, and tools
* Build and maintain dashboards and data visualizations using platforms such as **Power BI, Tableau, or Looker**

jobs.title: Analyst, Physical (Early Careers)
jobs.description:
**About DESRI**

DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states.

At DESRI, our culture is grounded in rigorous analytics and thoughtful risk-taking, with a strong emphasis on creativity, intellectual curiosity, and continuous improvement. We operate with lean teams that prioritize efficiency and minimize unnecessary bureaucracy, enabling individuals to take ownership and move quickly. We value open, constructive dialogue and believe it leads to better outcomes. Above all, we are driven to go the extra mile and support one another, fostering a collaborative environment built on accountability, integrity, and care.

**About the role**

DESRI seeks talented, intellectually curious, and highly motivated individuals interested in launching their careers in renewable energy and infrastructure. We welcome applications from undergraduate and graduate students approaching graduation who are interested in exploring full-time opportunities across DESRI's Physical teams.

DESRI's Physical teams span Asset Management, Construction, Engineering, Development, Preconstruction, Project Management, and Project Delivery. Together, these teams support the development, design, construction, delivery, and operation of utility-scale solar, battery storage, and wind projects throughout the United States.

Analysts work alongside experienced professionals to evaluate opportunities, solve complex problems, and support projects across various stages of the renewable energy lifecycle. Depending on individual interests, academic background, and business needs, candidates may be considered for opportunities across one or more teams.

This posting is intended to identify emerging talent for potential full-time opportunities rather than recruit for a single team or immediate opening.

**What you'll do**

Responsibilities will vary by team and may include:

* **Asset Management:** Support the operational and commercial management of renewable energy assets through performance analysis, reporting, contract administration, and stakeholder coordination.
* **Construction:** Assist with the execution of projects under construction, including project schedules, budgets, contractor coordination, equipment procurement, and risk management.
* **Engineering:** Contribute to technical analyses, design reviews, and engineering evaluations across electrical, civil, structural, energy storage, and other disciplines.
* **Development:** Support the evaluation and advancement of renewable energy projects, including commercial, technical, permitting, interconnection, land, and environmental considerations.
* **Preconstruction:** Assist with project planning, cost estimation, constructability assessments, scheduling, and contracting strategies.
* **Project Management:** Support cross-functional coordination, planning, analysis, and execution of renewable energy projects across different stages of development and construction.
* **Project Delivery:** Help advance projects from development through financing, construction, and commercial operation by coordinating technical, commercial, legal, financial, and external stakeholder workstreams.

Across these areas, Analysts have opportunities to develop analytical, technical, commercial, and project execution skills while gaining exposure to the renewable energy industry.

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed an undergraduate or graduate degree, with a strong preference for candidates graduating in 2027.
* Demonstrated academic and/or professional achievement, intellectual curiosity, and an interest in renewable energy, infrastructure, engineering, construction, or related industries.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and well-developed written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to learn quickly, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively within lean, cross-functional teams.
* A proactive mindset, willingness to take ownership, and enthusiasm for tackling complex challenges.
* Candidates pursuing degrees in engineering, business, finance, economics, environmental studies, construction management, mathematics, or other relevant disciplines are encouraged to apply.
* Prior internship, research, or project experience is valued but not required.
* At DESRI, we consider a wide range of factors to determine your compensation. We rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, location, skills, and experience. The expected annual base salary for this position is $90,000 to $110,000.
* Our compensation and benefits package includes variable compensation in the form of a year-end bonus, guaranteed in the first year of hire, and benefits including medical and prescription drug coverage, 401(k) contribution matching, paid time off, wellness reimbursement, family building benefits, and a charitable gift match program.

*This posting is intended for students approaching graduation who are interested in exploring full-time opportunities with DESRI. Specific team placement, responsibilities, office location, and anticipated start dates will depend on business needs and candidate qualifications.*

*DESRI's Recruiting team will review applications and connect with candidates whose interests and experience align with current or anticipated opportunities.*

You’ll partner with leaders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams to improve how the business plans, makes decisions, and executes.

You’ll support high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end to end: framing ambiguous problems, developing analyses and recommendations, aligning stakeholders, establishing milestones and governance, and driving follow-through. You’ll help run planning and business review cadences, build KPI reporting and insights, improve processes and systems, and support change initiatives such as pricing and packaging, go-to-market readiness, product launches, and organizational or operating-model changes.

You will also:

Identify friction in cross-functional workflows and design scalable processes, tools, and operating mechanisms.
Prepare clear, data-informed recommendations and executive-ready materials.
Manage multiple work-streams and facilitate alignment across stakeholders, balancing speed, rigor, and effective change management.

We are looking for candidates who have/are:

3–6 years of experience in business operations, strategy and operations, management consulting, finance, program management, or a related field—ideally in a SaaS or technology environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into insights, recommendations, and decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create executive-ready narratives and materials.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation and measurable outcomes.
Strong project and program management skills, including prioritization, stakeholder management, and attention to detail.
Familiarity with business intelligence, data, and collaboration tools; experience with Jira, Confluence, Databricks, spreadsheets, SQL, and/or AI-powered tools is a plus.
Ability to drive clarity in ambiguity, influence without authority, and demonstrate resilience in a dynamic environment.
Curious, adaptable, and motivated to learn quickly, challenge assumptions, and make the company and team better.

Nice to have experience:

Business Operations or Strategy & Operations experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company.
Supporting annual or quarterly planning, operating cadences, business reviews, resource allocation, or strategic planning processes.
Establishing KPIs, building performance dashboards, and using data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Supporting pricing and packaging, go-to-market or commercialization initiatives, product launches, or broader change-management efforts.
Applying agile, lean, or other process-improvement methodologies to scale how teams work.
Interest in and general knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency, including key players and market dynamics.

AI at Chainalysis

AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here.

Director, Marketing Operations at Hearst Newspapers

About The Role

Hearst Newspapers is looking for a strategic and hands-on Director of Marketing Operations to lead the technology, processes, and team supporting our digital subscription marketing business.

Reporting to the VP of Digital Subscriptions, this role leads a team of four and serves as the operational bridge between Marketing, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, Editorial, Finance, and Customer Service.

A major focus of the role is email and newsletter optimization- ensuring our customer communications, lifecycle programs, audience segmentation, personalization, and marketing automation are effective, scalable, and continuously improving.

This person will also help manage and evolve the MarTech ecosystem supporting our digital subscriber journey, from audience and customer data through website experiences, offers, checkout, and ongoing subscriber communications.

This is not primarily a campaign execution, Sales Operations, Ad Operations, or project management role. We’re looking for someone who understands the technology behind modern marketing and can translate business needs into scalable solutions.

What You’ll Do

Lead and develop a team of four Marketing Operations professionals.
Own and continuously improve the technology and operational processes supporting email, newsletters, lifecycle marketing, CRM/CDP, and marketing automation.
Partner with Marketing and Editorial to improve the performance, personalization, segmentation, and effectiveness of email and newsletter programs.
Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into technical requirements and deliver new capabilities.
Help oversee the technology supporting the digital customer journey, including websites, audience data, personalization, subscription offers, and customer communications.
Diagnose and troubleshoot issues across platforms, data flows, integrations, campaigns, and customer experiences.
Establish effective intake, prioritization, QA, governance, and release processes across multiple Hearst newspaper markets.
Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve efficiency, and enable Marketing teams to do more.
Evaluate vendors and technology solutions and help ensure the MarTech ecosystem is scalable and well integrated.
Build strong relationships across Marketing, Product, Engineering, BI, Editorial, Finance, and Customer Service.
Create processes and capabilities that can scale consistently across Hearst Newspapers’ markets while still supporting local needs.

Significant experience in Marketing Operations, preferably leading a Marketing Operations function or team.
Deep, hands-on experience with email and/or newsletter operations, including segmentation, lifecycle communications, personalization, QA, testing, and optimization.
Strong knowledge of MarTech platforms, marketing automation, CRM/CDP, and customer data.
Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to build or improve marketing capabilities.
Strong understanding of how data moves across marketing systems and the ability to troubleshoot issues and identify root causes.

The mission of the New York City Police Department is to enhance the quality of life in New York City by working in partnership with the community to enforce the law, preserve peace, protect the people, reduce fear, and maintain order. The New York City Police Department strives to foster a safe and fair city through the strategic deployment of resources, focusing on both crime prevention and addressing quality-of-life concerns while building lasting community relationships.

The Contract Administration Section oversees the processing of all procurements for the NYPD to meet the needs of the Department. The purchases overseen by the Contract Administration Section include the following types of contracts: (1) Construction related procurements, such as renovations and repairs of NYPD facilities, as well as contracts for scaffolding, and parking lot and sidewalk resurfacing, (2) plant management, including various contracts for maintaining various building systems and equipment, (3) a variety of contracts to meet the Department's various Information Technology needs, including software, hardware, maintaining and enhancing various Department Systems, and special projects such as the implementation of a Gunshot Detection System and a Body Camera System; (4) various emergency contracts to take care of needs of the Department that come up on an emergency basis, and (5) contracts for specialized goods and services such as helicopters, firearms, horses, and bullet proof vests. The Procurement Analyst will report to the Assistant Deputy Agency Chief Contracting Officer of small purchasing. The analyst will review and process purchase requisitions, procurements, contract documents, checking descriptions and specifications to determine the accuracy and adequacy and consult with agency staff on possible discrepancies. The analyst will be tasked with processing GSA and OGS intergovernmental procurements. Expertise with identity access management platforms (Okta)

Ability to work hybrid onsite at Manhattan (10005) headquarters Tuesday through Thursday

Competencies

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

As a second line of defense (LOD2), the department provides independent risk control services for SG when SG is exposed to these types of counterparties. Translate analysis into clear recommendations and business actions

Sales Analytics

Analyze pipeline health, coverage, conversion, sales velocity, win/loss performance, quota attainment, and seller productivity
Evaluate lead sources, territories, customer segments, ICP performance, and sales motions
Support analysis of sales capacity, territory design, quotas, and resource allocation
Measure the downstream quality of customers acquired by Sales, including deployment, utilization, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion
Support deployment and revenue forecasting and analyze forecast accuracy over time

Customer Revenue & Retention Analytics

Analyze CSD, ingredient consumption, recurring revenue, account health, attrition, and expansion across the installed base
Identify leading indicators of customer growth and churn risk
Develop customer cohorts and account segmentation to identify which characteristics correlate with strong long-term performance
Analyze Account Management interventions to determine which activities actually improve customer revenue, retention, and expansion
Help develop data-driven account prioritization and opportunity/risk scoring
Quantify revenue at risk and potential revenue upside across the existing customer base

Customer Economics & Revenue Quality

Help develop a holistic view of customer value across the full lifecycle:

Sale → Deployment → Live → Productive → Recurring Revenue → Retention → Expansion

Evaluate customer economics across verticals, deal structures, sales channels, customer profiles, and other meaningful segments
Partner with Finance to incorporate margin, cost, and profitability considerations into commercial analysis
Identify customer and program characteristics associated with higher long-term economic value
Help the organization move beyond measuring success solely by sales or installations toward measuring the quality and durability of revenue created

Forecasting, Planning & Scenario Modeling

Support commercial revenue and deployment forecasting
Build and maintain analytical models for revenue growth, customer performance, capacity, retention, and other business drivers
Partner with Commercial Planning and Finance on operating plans, forecasts, and scenario analysis
Evaluate the expected impact of changes in headcount, productivity, pricing, customer mix, retention, CSD, deployment timing, and other key assumptions
Perform sensitivity analyses to help leadership understand the range of potential business outcomes

Reporting & Business Reviews

Build and maintain core Sales, Account Management, and revenue performance reporting
Support weekly and monthly business reviews with analysis of key trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities
Maintain consistent metric definitions and help establish a trusted source of truth across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance
Improve existing reporting by eliminating low-value metrics and introducing measures that better reflect business performance
Automate recurring analysis and reporting wherever practical

Strategic & Ad Hoc Analysis

Support leadership with analytical work on high-priority business questions, including:

Which customer segments and verticals generate the greatest long-term value?
What predicts high CSD, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion?
Where are we losing revenue and why?
Which sales motions and acquisition sources produce the highest-quality customers?
Where should we add or reduce Sales and Account Management resources?
Which programs and initiatives are generating measurable incremental value?
Where are operational bottlenecks limiting revenue?
Which parts of the business should we scale, improve, or reconsider?
What are we not currently measuring that could materially change how we operate?

Cross-Functional Operating Model

The Revenue Analyst will be a shared analytical resource across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance.

The role reports to the Revenue Operations Manager, who will help prioritize the analyst's overall workload and ensure analytical work translates into commercial action. However, the analyst will work directly and regularly with Commercial Planning and Finance and will support important analytical and planning needs across all three functions.

Success requires operating as part of one analytical ecosystem rather than three separate teams. The expectation is to create shared definitions, shared data, and a common understanding of business performance while bringing the appropriate functional perspective to each analysis.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Revenue Analyst will:

Surface insights leadership did not already know
Explain the drivers behind business performance rather than simply reporting results
Identify revenue opportunities and risks early enough for the organization to act
Improve confidence in the metrics used to run the business
Connect Sales and operational activity to actual customer and financial outcomes
Reduce manual reporting and increase time spent on higher-value analysis
Help Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance operate from a consistent view of the business
Develop a deep enough understanding of Botrista's business model to independently identify questions worth investigating
Consistently move from data → insight → recommendation

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, Finance, Strategy, Business Operations, or a related analytical role
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to work with large and complex datasets
Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills
Experience with Salesforce data and CRM reporting strongly preferred
Experience with BI and data visualization tools preferred
Experience building financial, operational, forecasting, or scenario models
Strong understanding of business metrics and ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes
Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the larger business question
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and business questions evolve quickly

What We're Looking For

We are particularly interested in someone who:

Is intellectually curious and naturally asks "why?"
Enjoys finding patterns and anomalies in data
Does not stop at producing a dashboard or spreadsheet
Can distinguish correlation from meaningful business drivers
Is comfortable challenging assumptions when the data suggests something different
Can take an ambiguous business question and independently determine how to analyze it
Understands that perfect data is rarely available and can make thoughtful recommendations while clearly communicating assumptions and limitations
Wants their analysis to influence how a business actually operates

Benefits

Flex PTO, 7 sick days, 14 holidays, Wellness Benefits, Cell Phone and Internet reimbursement, 401K

Plus commissions and stock options

jobs.title: Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.

For more information, visit WPP.com.

About WPP

WPP is the creative transformation company. Through One WPP and the Elevate28 transformation agenda, we are building a simpler, more integrated, agile and AI-powered enterprise. WPP’s Performance & Culture Center of Excellence brings together the capabilities that help our people, teams and organisation perform, grow and thrive. Within it, Enterprise Effectiveness aligns WPP’s organisation, workforce and teams around its strategic priorities and enables the change required to deliver them.

About The Role

The Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager is a contract role that will build the evidence base for the workforce and organisation decisions that matter most to WPP. This role will turn fragmented people, organisation and business data into clear insight, forward-looking scenarios and practical recommendations that help leaders decide where to invest, how to shape the workforce and how to organise for performance.

Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, you will support the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence while working closely with business, People & Culture, Finance, Data and Technology partners. You will establish a trusted workforce-intelligence capability that supports strategic workforce planning and informs priority organisation, workforce, team and people decisions across Enterprise Effectiveness and the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence. This is not a traditional reporting role. It combines strategic analytics, internal consulting and leadership of a four-person data and reporting team based in India. You will be expected to work through ambiguity, connect disparate data and systems, and progressively turn fragmented analytics into a more integrated, trusted and usable capability. As a contract appointment, the initial focus will be to establish the core workforce-intelligence approach, strengthen the India-based team and deliver insight against WPP’s highest-priority workforce and organisation questions.

Why This Role Matters

WPP’s transformation requires faster, better choices about work, skills, capacity, organisation and investment. Those choices cannot be made from disconnected dashboards or backward-looking metrics alone. In this role, you will create a more integrated view of the workforce, translate evidence into choices and trade-offs, and help leaders anticipate the implications of AI, changing client demand and new ways of working. The work will directly shape how WPP builds the capabilities, capacity and organisation required for Elevate28.

What You’ll Do

Build a trusted workforce intelligence capability

Working with the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, shape and build an enterprise workforce-intelligence approach that connects people, organisation and business data to the decisions leaders need to make.
Define a focused set of workforce and organisational measures, dashboards and decision-support tools, moving reporting from activity and headcount toward capacity, capability, cost, productivity, risk and value.
Partner with data owners and technology teams to map fragmented data and systems, define analytical requirements, and strengthen data definitions, quality, accessibility and responsible use, while being clear about limitations and the strength of the evidence.
Establish repeatable analytical standards, governance and quality controls so insight is trusted, comparable and usable across WPP.
Apply AI and automation to improve how workforce data is integrated, analysed and translated into decision support, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, transparency and responsible-use standards.

Enable strategic workforce planning

Help business and People & Culture leaders translate strategy, growth priorities and choices about how work is organised into workforce demand, capability and capacity requirements.
Build scenarios that show the implications of different choices, including developing, hiring, accessing external capability, automating, augmenting, redeploying and exiting work or roles.
Assess the current workforce and future talent supply, including critical skills, capacity, cost, location and role mix, highlighting gaps, risks and investment priorities.
Connect workforce planning to business and financial planning cycles so decisions are timely, owned and grounded in common assumptions.

Deliver forward-looking insight and decision support

Use statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario modelling to identify emerging workforce and organisational risks, opportunities and patterns.
Bring structure to ambiguous business questions, identify what can be answered with available data, test hypotheses and distinguish meaningful signals from correlation or noise.
Turn analysis into clear choices, trade-offs and recommendations for senior leaders, including the consequences of action and inaction.
Develop concise executive narratives and visualisations that make complex findings understandable without oversimplifying them.

Strengthen organisation and transformation decisions

Provide analytical support for organisation design, organisational health, inclusion and impact, talent development, team effectiveness and change priorities across Performance and Culture.
Create baselines and evaluate whether organisation and workforce interventions are improving the intended outcomes.
Combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight to explain not only what is happening, but why it matters and where targeted action is needed.
Identify enterprise patterns across businesses, markets and functions and convert them into practical recommendations for leaders and Enterprise Effectiveness partners.

Scale tools, capability and adoption

Build practical tools, templates and self-service products that improve the quality and consistency of workforce decisions.
Coach People & Culture and business partners to interpret workforce insight, challenge assumptions and use scenarios in decision-making.
Create a clear intake and prioritisation approach that focuses analytical capacity on the highest-value enterprise questions.
Continuously improve the offer through user feedback, adoption evidence and emerging practice in workforce analytics, AI and organisational science.
Lead and develop a four-person data and reporting team based in India, setting clear priorities, strengthening analytical and consulting capability, and shifting delivery from fragmented reporting toward higher-value workforce intelligence and decision support.

Minimum Qualifications

Relevant experience applying data and analytics in finance, commercial, operational or other business settings, together with experience in people analytics, workforce intelligence or strategic workforce planning.
Experience translating business questions into analytical approaches, workforce scenarios and decision-ready recommendations.
Strong capability in data analysis, forecasting, modelling and visualisation, using appropriate business intelligence or analytical tools.
Proven experience working through ambiguity and improving a fragmented data and analytics environment by connecting disparate sources and systems, strengthening definitions and quality, and establishing practical governance, privacy and ethical standards.
Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and influence senior stakeholders in a complex organisation.
AI fluency, including a practical understanding of how AI and automation can improve analytics, workforce planning and decision support, and how they may reshape work, skills, roles and workforce requirements.
Experience leading and developing an analytics or reporting team, including setting priorities, assuring quality and building capability across locations.
A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

Experience applying financial, commercial or operational analysis to workforce investment, capacity, productivity or organisation decisions.
Experience in a complex global, matrixed or multi-business organisation, ideally supporting enterprise transformation or significant workforce change.
Proficiency with relevant business intelligence, data-visualisation or analytical tools, which may include Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or R.
Postgraduate study or relevant professional qualifications in analytics, finance, strategic workforce planning or a related field.

What Success Looks Like

A clear enterprise workforce-intelligence proposition focused on the workforce and organisation decisions most critical to One WPP and Elevate28.
A more integrated and trusted data foundation, with common definitions, practical governance and decision-support tools that connect workforce, organisation, business and financial insight.
Workforce plans, scenarios and recommendations that materially improve decisions about skills, capacity, location, cost, AI and automation, technology and workforce shape.
Stronger adoption of workforce insight by business and People & Culture leaders, with greater confidence in what the data can and cannot support.
A focused, capable India-based team that delivers consistent reporting while building higher-value workforce intelligence and decision-support capability.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a Marketing Analytics Lead at Anthropic, you will own how we measure marketing. You'll build and run a single measurement framework that shows how marketing activity turns into pipeline, revenue, and product usage, and you'll make that framework something marketers and executives actually use to make decisions. As our marketing programs grow across enterprise and product-led motions, your work will determine whether we invest in what works.

In this role, you'll own the marketing measurement framework end to end: the metric definitions, the data models behind them, the dashboards that surface them, and the insights they produce. This is a hands-on individual contributor role; data science and data engineering will support you, but you'll do the core work yourself. You'll partner closely with field marketing, partner marketing, campaign marketing, finance, sales strategy, sales development, data science, and data engineering to align on definitions and keep the whole organization working from one view of the funnel.

Key responsibilities

Own the marketing measurement framework that connects marketing activity to pipeline, revenue, and product usage
Set the direction for the framework and extend it to programs it doesn't cover yet
Define marketing metrics clearly and get cross-functional teams to agree on definitions early
Build and maintain the data models that power marketing reporting
Develop dashboards that marketers and executives rely on in their weekly reviews
Teach marketers and executives how the metrics work, and keep teaching as the metrics evolve
Lead adoption of the framework so that both marketing and executive teams use it as their shared source of truth
Partner with finance, sales strategy, and sales development to connect marketing measurement to the broader revenue picture
Find and share the insights nobody asked for, turning analysis into recommendations that change what we do
Write analytical SQL on large datasets to answer questions about funnel performance and attribution
Track framework gaps and data quality issues, and work with data engineering to resolve them

jobs.title: Advisor Solution Analyst
jobs.description:
Advisors · RIAs · Portfolio Workflows

About the job

PortfolioFuture is an independent fund discovery and intelligence company. We use empirical research to discover, evaluate, and rank ETFs and mutual funds, and identify where they can credibly compete for allocations in portfolios.

Our research connects more than 10,000 funds with institutional investors, 23,000+ advisory firms, and 400,000+ financial advisors, supporting fund discovery, portfolio analytics, and asset-manager distribution intelligence.

As an Advisor Solution Analyst, you will study how financial advisors and wealth managers evaluate the funds PortfolioFuture identifies. The role covers advisor research, portfolio workflows, fund consideration, and the development of market intelligence used across PortfolioFuture.

You will speak with advisors, RIAs, and wealth-management professionals to understand what makes a fund worth investigating, what keeps it out of a portfolio, and how those judgments differ across firms and client types.

What you’ll work on

• Speak with financial advisors, RIAs, and wealth-management professionals about funds identified through PortfolioFuture’s research.
• Study how advisors compare competing ETFs and mutual funds and what makes a fund worth further consideration.
• Document the recurring questions, objections, and concerns that come up around specific funds and investment strategies.
• Research how advisors judge a fund’s strategy, positioning, fees, track record, and role in a portfolio.
• Compare how different advisors evaluate the same investment product.
• Turn qualitative conversations into structured market intelligence the rest of PortfolioFuture can act on.
• Identify gaps between how a fund manager describes a strategy and how the wealth-management market understands it.
• Study how a fund enters an advisor’s consideration set and what moves it from awareness to real due diligence.
• Work with PortfolioFuture’s substitution and decomposition research so advisor conversations stay grounded in evidence.
• Use large language models and other tools to organize, summarize, and analyze qualitative research at scale.
• Share what you learn with research, product, and distribution teams so findings reach the people who can use them.
• Test whether the patterns you observe hold across firm size, client type, and market environment.

What we’re looking for

• Background in finance, economics, business, wealth management, communications, or a related field.
• Strong interest in financial advisors, RIAs, wealth management, ETFs, and mutual funds.
• Ability to conduct thoughtful professional conversations and ask useful follow-up questions.
• Ability to understand an investment product well enough to discuss it with experienced advisors.
• Strong listening skills and the ability to identify patterns across many different conversations.
• Ability to turn qualitative feedback into clear, structured written findings.
• Comfort reaching out to and speaking with experienced wealth-management professionals.
• Ability to communicate what you learned clearly, including what you are not yet sure about.
• Experience in wealth management, financial advisory, investment product distribution, or practice management is useful but not required.
• Experience with research interviews, qualitative analysis, CRM data, or survey design is a plus.

PortfolioFuture research

Fund Substitution identifies ETFs and mutual funds that can serve similar portfolio roles, using return similarity, relative performance, tracking error, and fees.

Fund Decomposition separates returns explained by investable market exposures from residual performance, evaluating replication quality, residual alpha, and risk.

Fund Opportunity ranks ETFs and mutual funds across four dimensions: Similar Fund Ranking, Addressable Market, Pure Alpha, and Diversification Benefits.

PortfolioFuture’s research is independent. Commercial relationships do not affect which funds are surfaced, how they rank, or the conclusions reached.

jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology**

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

**1. Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

**2. Reach, Scale & Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.

**3. Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Product & Technology Analytics is responsible for the data analysis, measurement, and insight generation that inform product strategy and decision-making across Disney Entertainment’s streaming and digital portfolio. This includes experimentation analysis, KPI development, BI development, and cross-functional partnership with product management, engineering, and programming teams to drive data-informed outcomes across Disney+ and Hulu.

**Job Summary:**

The Product & Technology Analytics team is seeking a Lead Data Analyst who will be a key player in driving personalization strategy on Disney+ and Hulu.

Our ideal candidate is an excellent coder and communicator who crafts high-impact, data-informed stories to decode challenging and unstructured problems, and can responsibly manage complex projects that cross several silos. If you go beyond gathering data and you consistently transform it into knowledge and meaningful business action, this is a great role for you.

You’ll contribute the following to this critical squad:

* **Deep-Dive Research:** Lead large-scale analyses of product performance and user behavior. Apply statistical modeling, experimentation, and causal inference to identify opportunities and influence product strategy.
* **A/B Testing & Experimentation:** Lead the design, analysis, and interpretation of personalization experiments, including power analysis, metric selection, SQL/Python analysis, and stakeholder recommendations.
* **Analytics Foundations:** Partner with product and data engineering teams to improve data quality, build scalable datasets, and instrument new product features for reliable analysis and reporting.
* **AI-Enabled Analytics:** Use and help advance AI-assisted tools and workflows to improve the speed, scale, and quality of analysis.
* **Ad Hoc Analysis:** Investigate product issues, analyze user behavior, and rapidly answer complex business and product questions using large datasets.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or another technical field
* 7+ years of data analytics experience, including 3+ years in a senior or lead-level capacity.
* Advanced SQL and Python skills, including complex analysis of large datasets, notebook-based workflows, and scheduled analytical jobs.
* Advanced knowledge of experimentation and statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing, power analysis, metric selection, regression, causal inference, test design, and interpretation.
* Product analytics experience, including user behavior, funnels, engagement, and feature performance.
* Experience building analyses, dashboards, and visualizations in Looker, Tableau, or a comparable BI platform.
* Proven ability to lead end-to-end analytical projects, define requirements, manage timelines, partner with data engineering, and deliver strategic outcomes.
* Strategic communication skills, with the ability to translate complex findings into clear recommendations for technical, business, and executive audiences.
* Experience building or applying AI-assisted analytics tools and workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in streaming media or subscription-based products
* Advanced knowledge of Looker
* Proven ability to manage projects that require new datasets, collaborating with data engineering teams to improve data quality and build foundational datasets for scalable analysis
* Master’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or another technical field

jobs.description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

We are seeking an Analyst to join the Global Corporate & Investment Banking (GCIB) Business Unit Risk & Control team. This role is responsible for supporting the RCSA program for assigned business areas. This includes the effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of operational and non-financial risks across a diverse portfolio of corporate and investment banking products and services.

  

The successful candidate will partner with team members and with business, product, operations, compliance, and risk management stakeholders to help strengthen the overall risk and control environment. This individual will support the execution of the business unit's risk management framework, ensuring risks are proactively identified, appropriately assessed, and effectively controlled in alignment with regulatory expectations and organizational risk appetite.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Support the execution of the Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) program across Global Corporate & Investment Banking.

* RCSA activities include; Process and risk taxonomy alignment, Inherent-risk assessment, Control identification and mapping, Control design and operating-effectiveness evaluation, Residual-risk determination, Issue and action-plan linkage, Trigger-based and periodic reassessments, Documentation and evidence standards, System-of-record maintenance.

* Participate in RCSA meetings and working sessions and complete assigned deliverables throughout the RCSA execution lifecycle.

* Prepare process flows, risk and control assessment documentation, executive presentations, and other governance materials by using Microsoft Office and other tools.

* Identify opportunities to use approved automation, analytics, and artificial-intelligence tools to improve the efficiency, consistency, and quality of RCSA activities, in accordance with applicable information-security, data-privacy, records-management, and technology-risk requirements.

* Support the GCIB Risk and Control team by gathering information for requests, tracking deliverables, and preparing status reports.

* Proactively anticipate the needs of the team, offer recommendations and solutions, and prioritize efficiently to meet deliverable deadlines.

* Build subject matter expertise across covered banking products to better understand associated risk exposures and support informed decision-making.

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Compliance, Legal, Operational Risk, Audit, Technology, and Operations teams, to strengthen the overall control environment.  

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Risk Management, Accounting, or a related discipline.
* 1-3 years experience in risk management, operational risk, controls, audit, corporate banking, investment banking, or a related financial services function.
* Basic understanding of banking products, operational risk frameworks, and control management principles and
* Willingness to learn banking products and risk-management concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting or data visualization tools.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
* Ability to analyze data and identify trends or inconsistencies.
* Ability to maintain complete and accurate documentation.
* Ability to follow established methodologies and escalation protocols.
Ability to manage deadlines in a regulated environment.  

  

The typical base pay range for this role is between $80K to $100K depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and location. This role will be eligible for certain discretionary performance-based bonus and/or incentive compensation. jobs.description:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.  
  
**Work You'll Do**  
  
As an Analytics and Insights Engineer III on the Customer Strategy & Design team, you will be responsible for:  

* Translating customer experience program objectives into Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) solution designs that define survey architecture, data models, workflows, and integration requirements.
* Configuring and optimizing Qualtrics surveys, embedded data, dashboards, automations, and logic for enterprise feedback programs.
* Building secure integrations between Qualtrics and customer relationship management, human resources information systems, and data warehouse platforms using application programming interfaces, web services, or single sign-on.
* Deploying unmodified Qualtrics-provided Website/App Insights code in approved global headers or footers; avoiding multiple concurrent snippets; and testing data flow, intercepts, reporting, and workflow performance before production releases.
* Analyzing customer feedback data, building role-based dashboards, and training stakeholders on reporting and workflow use to support experience management adoption.

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The Team**  
  
Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.  
  
Our Customer Strategy & Design team discovers, designs, and prototypes customer growth strategies and innovation portfolios.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required**:**  

* Bachelor's degree preferably in computer science, information systems, data analytics, software engineering, or business analytics.
* 2+ years of experience advising clients on best-practices of configuration for data collection.
* 1+ years of experience delivering platform demos and technical walkthroughs to business stakeholders, translating data-driven findings into clear action.
* 2+ years of experience analyzing customer feedback data and creating dashboard-based reporting.
* 1+ years of experience using JavaScript or Python to create survey logic, automate platform workflows, or deploy website feedback code.
* Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
Preferred:
  

* Qualtrics certification.
* 2+ years of experience configuring Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) Platform surveys, workflows, embedded data, dashboards, and reporting.
* 2+ years of experience designing integrations between cloud platforms and customer relationship management (CRM), human resources information systems (HRIS), or data warehouse platforms using application programming interfaces (APIs), web services, or single sign-on (SSO).
