jobs.title: Qualtrics Analytics and Insights Engineer III (CX / XM)
jobs.description:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.  
  
**Work You'll Do**  
  
As an Analytics and Insights Engineer III on the Customer Strategy & Design team, you will be responsible for:  

* Translating customer experience program objectives into Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) solution designs that define survey architecture, data models, workflows, and integration requirements.
* Configuring and optimizing Qualtrics surveys, embedded data, dashboards, automations, and logic for enterprise feedback programs.
* Building secure integrations between Qualtrics and customer relationship management, human resources information systems, and data warehouse platforms using application programming interfaces, web services, or single sign-on.
* Deploying unmodified Qualtrics-provided Website/App Insights code in approved global headers or footers; avoiding multiple concurrent snippets; and testing data flow, intercepts, reporting, and workflow performance before production releases.
* Analyzing customer feedback data, building role-based dashboards, and training stakeholders on reporting and workflow use to support experience management adoption.

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The Team**  
  
Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.  
  
Our Customer Strategy & Design team discovers, designs, and prototypes customer growth strategies and innovation portfolios.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required**:**  

* Bachelor's degree preferably in computer science, information systems, data analytics, software engineering, or business analytics.
* 2+ years of experience advising clients on best-practices of configuration for data collection.
* 1+ years of experience delivering platform demos and technical walkthroughs to business stakeholders, translating data-driven findings into clear action.
* 2+ years of experience analyzing customer feedback data and creating dashboard-based reporting.
* 1+ years of experience using JavaScript or Python to create survey logic, automate platform workflows, or deploy website feedback code.
* Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
Preferred:
  

* Qualtrics certification.
* 2+ years of experience configuring Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) Platform surveys, workflows, embedded data, dashboards, and reporting.
* 2+ years of experience designing integrations between cloud platforms and customer relationship management (CRM), human resources information systems (HRIS), or data warehouse platforms using application programming interfaces (APIs), web services, or single sign-on (SSO).
* 1+ years of experience integrating Qualtrics with Salesforce, SAP, or Slack.
* 1+ years of experience supporting federal, state, or local government agencies or public higher education institutions.
* 1+ years of experience configuring solutions in environments subject to Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) requirements.

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst
jobs.description:
THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel Group is looking to add a Senior Product Analyst to join our Sports Product team.  You will be responsible for driving business results and empowering data-driven product decisions with timely insights and thought partnership.  You will be a champion of innovation, agility, and continuous improvement, ensuring we’re positioned to capitalize on opportunities as they arise. 

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN

Everyone on our team has a part to play

You will be an expert in analytics, lead experimentation initiatives, and contribute to product strategy decisions.   
Consistently deliver accurate, timely and high-quality analysis and insights to stakeholders. 
As one of the more senior analysts, even though this is not a managerial position, you will play a lead role in a high performing analytics team, providing mentorship and guidance to junior team members. 
Demonstrate analytics excellence, innovating how we access, analyze, and share insights.  
Partner with product leaders to leverage customer insights to drive product decisions.   
Be an authority for customer behavioral data; using data to reshape our understanding of customer behavior & business performance. 
Work alongside product, commercial and other teams to help define how to measure success. 
Design and lead complex cross-functional experimentation initiatives. 
Co-create experiment documentation, best practices and trainings 
Integrate AI tools into analytical workflows to accelerate delivery, reduce manual overhead, and enhance team output quality.
Partner with product teams to craft high-quality experiments and output insights. 
Drive experimentation velocity with product teams. 

THE STATS

What we're looking for in our next teammate

Minimum 4+ years of experience in an analytical position. 
Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or related field. 
Sophisticated SQL expertise is required. 
Experience with Amplitude Analytics is highly preferred. 
Experience with other languages such as R and Python is preferred.  
Experience in mentoring and coaching junior analysts is highly preferred. 
An excellent understanding of product metrics and the latest techniques in measuring customer experience and app performance. 
Experience with A/B testing & Experimentation methodologies and tools.   
Proven track record in the implementation of analytics and measurement solutions in a digital ecosystem
Significant experience building intuitive and impactful data visualizations that drive business decisions (e.g., with Tableau, Mode, Amplitude, Adobe, or similar). 
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills.  Able to influence decision makers at all levels with data-driven insights.  
Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate at all levels of management. 
Ability to work as part of a team in a very fast-paced and changing environment. 
Understanding of business priorities and ability to work to meet them. 
High level of personal initiative and motivation.

About Fanduel

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

Player Benefits

We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards
. *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. jobs.title: Structured Finance - Structured Credit & CLOs, Senior Analyst (New York)
jobs.description:
As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

At Fitch Ratings, credit analysts play a pivotal role in moving markets, as quality credit analysis is the lifeblood of our organization. With a legacy of over a century, our unique approach to credit ratings offers unmatched opportunities for professional growth. Embracing a “challenger mindset,” you'll join a team dedicated to innovating service to our clients. Our people-driven analysis thrives on collaboration across all levels and locations, surpassing traditional financial modeling. Lastly, as part of our global community, you'll find inspiration, challenge, and support, with ample opportunities for visibility and influence in the global financial marketplace.

Want to learn more about a career as a credit analyst at Fitch Ratings? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group

Fitch Ratings is seeking a Senior Analyst to join its Structured Credit & CLOs group in our New York office.

About The Team

A collaborative, team-oriented work environment where excellent communication skills are essential
An opportunity to be a lead coverage analyst at a global rating agency
A role that aids debt capital markets in making more informed decisions through timely, insightful, and forward-looking rating actions and research

How You’ll Make An Impact

Analyze ratings on Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLOs) using proprietary models
Prepare and present rating conclusions to a credit committee
Draft rating action commentary reports to communicate rating decisions to market participants
Contribute to recurring and special research publications

You May Be a Good Fit If

You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline (finance, accounting, economics, etc.)
You have at least three years of experience in the financial industry, with a preference for experience related to CLOs or Structured Finance
You possess strong analytical thinking, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail
You demonstrate a high level of personal responsibility, initiative, and self-management
You have the ability to communicate complex subjects accurately and succinctly
You have a deep interest in capital markets and structured finance
You are proficient with Microsoft Office suite; knowledge of programming languages is a plus but not required

What Would Make You Stand Out

Critical thinking and meticulous attention to detail
Strong sense of personal responsibility and initiative
Ability to convey complex subjects clearly and concisely
Open-mindedness and ability to understand alternative viewpoints
Keen interest in structured finance and CLOs

Why Choose Fitch

Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Private Credit Investment Analytics
jobs.description:
Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.

We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

About Us

NLG Capital, the investment management company of NLG, manages approximately $40+ billion in AUM. Our purpose is simple – to allow NLG to keep its promises. How we do this – an obsessive focus on delivering investment results. We drive results through a rigorous but collaborative investment process, and we hold ourselves to the highest of standards, both as investors and teammates. While our process is based on rigor, our culture is based on our guiding principles: Meritocracy, Uncompromising Transparency, Intellectual Honesty, Performance Driven Learning, Relentless Pursuit of Excellence. These principles serve as the foundation of our team. They govern the way we conduct ourselves, how we interact with teammates and how we approach every investment decision. We act with the integrity and humility required to make the investment decision that is right for the firm, and ultimately our policyholders. Our culture has been deliberately built to foster curiosity and provide opportunities to learn and grow, both as people and investors. The flat and collaborative nature of our team promotes an atmosphere where the best ideas are continually expressed and rewarded. Our pursuit of excellence is unwavering.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Supports NLG Capital’s private credit investment activities through investment analytics, portfolio monitoring, and reporting. **About Step Up Family Services:** At Step Up Family Services, we believe meaningful change begins with meeting individuals and families where they are. Our Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services support children and families through evidence-based interventions delivered in home, center-based, and community settings. This role is responsible for conducting assessments, developing and monitoring individualized treatment and Behavior Support Plans (BSPs), analyzing client progress, supervising and developing BTs/RBTs, and partnering with families to support meaningful and sustainable outcomes.

This job is responsible for moderately complex transaction and fulfillment processing, including the movement of assets into and out of accounts. Key responsibilities include reconciliation, settlement, and trade and transfer support, and providing quality service and operations support for internal business partners and external clients, in accordance with established guidelines and procedures. Job expectations include handling in operational processes which may carry medium to high levels of monetary risk and assisting in training less experienced team members.

  
  

**Line of Business Job Description:**

The Institutional Retirement Payroll, Benefits, and Disbursements (IRBPD) Team within Wealth Management Operations (WMO) is responsible for payroll and benefits processing, money movement, participant-level maintenance and tax reporting support for 401(k) Defined Contribution, Non-Qualified Deferred Compensation (NQDC), Institutional Trust and Custody, Defined Benefit and Health Benefits Solutions (HBS) products.

  
  

The 401(k) Benefits Processing team is responsible for administering 401(k) plans for a large number of employers, including many Fortune 500 companies. Products supported include 401(k) defined contribution.

The Benefits Processing Team facilitates the processing of 401(k) distribution transactions including Qualified Domestic Relations Orders (QDRO), hardship withdrawals, loans, and beneficiary support. The team assists internal partners to facilitate requests originated by 401(k) participants and by the plan sponsors of the companies we service.

  
  

This team is responsible for accurately creating and reviewing 401(k) financial transactions involving stock, money market, and mutual fund trading. Daily functions include processing withdrawals, funds transfers, QDRO & beneficiary transactions, contributions and loan repayments within the Service Level Agreement timeline for our clients.

The Transaction Management Analyst should expect to learn the 401(k) product as well as the skills needed to build a strong foundation for a career in financial services. The candidate must demonstrate a cooperative and professional work attitude, while displaying the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

The Analyst, Working Capital & Trade Finance (WCTF) role is a position focused on building the analytical, execution, risk management, and client-support capabilities needed to contribute across origination, structuring, implementation, and transaction monitoring. The Analyst supports senior team members in evaluating and executing new and existing WCTF transactions while developing a strong understanding of the Bank's working capital solutions, internal processes, and control framework.

The role requires accuracy, accountability, intellectual curiosity, and effective collaboration in a fast-paced environment. Analysts are expected to deliver high-quality work with appropriate guidance, manage assigned responsibilities and competing priorities, raise questions and issues promptly, and assume greater ownership as their product knowledge, judgment, and execution capabilities develop.

Responsibilities

Transaction Analysis, Structuring & Execution

Support the analysis, structuring, approval, implementation, and closing of new and existing WCTF transactions under the guidance of senior team members.
Prepare accurate financial analyses, working capital assessments, transaction economics, ROE/RORA simulations, pricing and obligor limit analyses, deal sheets, and screening materials.
Assess transaction risks, structural considerations, and key assumptions; identify inconsistencies and escalate questions with supporting analysis.
Prepare term sheets, approval materials, presentations, implementation submissions, documentation inputs, and closing deliverables.
Coordinate assigned workstreams, timelines, and follow-ups across internal stakeholders, promptly escalating risks, delays, or unresolved items.

Origination & Client Support

Support client pitches, product proposals, peer analyses, and other marketing materials in partnership with senior Originators and Structurers.
Research prospective clients, industries, and market developments to evaluate the applicability of WCTF solutions and inform transaction analysis.
Participate in internal and external calls, prepare meeting materials and follow-up items, and support timely responses to Relationship Manager and client inquiries.
Communicate pipeline and transaction updates for assigned opportunities clearly and accurately.
Develop an understanding of client objectives, constraints, and transaction requirements while operating within the Bank's risk appetite.

Risk Management, Controls & Professional Accountability

Perform responsibilities in accordance with applicable credit policies, regulatory requirements, KYC standards, internal controls, and the Bank's risk appetite.
Support monitoring and reporting for assigned WCTF assets, including performance, utilization, obligor exposure, and transaction requirements; escalate deterioration, operational issues, or control concerns promptly.
Apply disciplined quality control to all work products, ensuring information is accurate, complete, consistent, and appropriately supported.
Identify and escalate potential credit, operational, compliance, information security, data integrity, or conduct issues and support timely remediation.
Demonstrate accountability, reliability, sound judgment, and clear communication while managing multiple assignments and deadlines.

Collaboration, Development & Process Improvement

Collaborate effectively across WCTF, the broader Working Capital organization, and other functions throughout the Bank.
Build product, credit, industry, market, legal documentation, systems, and execution knowledge and apply that learning to assigned responsibilities.
Incorporate feedback, address knowledge gaps through training and self-study, and progressively assume greater ownership of assigned work.
Contribute to process improvement, standardization, automation, artificial intelligence, and special projects that enhance efficiency, reporting quality, or risk management.
Share knowledge and best practices to support team effectiveness and consistent execution.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from a four-year accredited institution, preferably with coursework in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field.
Foundational financial analysis and modeling skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to learn new products, industries, systems, and transaction structures.
Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments, follow through on commitments, and meet deadlines with appropriate oversight.
High attention to detail, commitment to data accuracy, and awareness of risk and control responsibilities.
Collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to seek guidance, incorporate feedback, and support team priorities.
Prior internship or experience in banking, working capital, trade finance, structured finance, credit, corporate finance, or a related field is beneficial but not required.

Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.

Energy related sector

This role will serve as a critical liaison between business stakeholders, cloud engineering teams, and product owners to drive the successful delivery and adoption of cloud-based services and platforms across the enterprise.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of cloud technologies (AWS, Azure), business process analysis, and enablement strategies. This role is pivotal in ensuring that cloud products are effectively integrated, adopted, and aligned with business objectives.

Collaborate with Product Owners, Cloud Engineers, and Delivery Leads to define and document business and technical requirements for cloud enablement initiatives.

Working with key stakeholders to identify areas for improvement and optimization

Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and cloud service lifecycle management.
Familiarity with Agile techniques and tools – Scrum, Kanban, JIRA, and ServiceNow, etc.
Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Analyst (VP) to join our Markets Quantitative Analysis team in New York City. This is a senior role for an individual with deep expertise in RMBS securitized products and whole loans quantitative modeling. Significant experience working directly with trading and F&S desks and providing analytical support for various trading activities.
Significant experience working with various mortgage databases such as LoanPerformance and Fannie/Freddie Credit Risk transfer, and the ability to develop data analysis tools and reports.
Expertise with cashflow analytics tools such as Intex, Bloomberg and Yield Book.
Significant, expert-level experience in programming including C++, SQL, and Python, machine learning frameworks (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Possesses excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative concepts to senior stakeholders.

Graduate degree (Masters or PhD) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or another quantitative field.

jobs.description:
The Programmatic Campaign Analyst is a skilled and diligent individual contributor responsible for the execution, optimization, and reporting of Citi's programmatic media investments within an in-house programmatic media team. This role requires 2-5 years of progressive experience, demonstrating strong hands-on proficiency in media activation platforms, coupled with analytical skills to support optimization efforts and assist in the analysis of performance and quality metrics. The incumbent will focus on day-to-day campaign management, safeguarding Citi’s brand while contributing to business outcomes, and supporting the Senior Programmatic Campaign Manager in ensuring operational excellence. Reporting into the Group Manager, Lead Programmatic Media Strategist, this role is essential in executing against Citi’s internal approach and contributing to the effective use of strategic technology partnerships.

Key Responsibilities:

Programmatic Campaign Execution & Optimization: Execute and optimize programmatic media campaigns across various platforms, ensuring adherence to strategic objectives. Maintain strong hands-on proficiency in leading programmatic buying platforms, including DV360, to implement campaign architecture, bid strategies, and optimization techniques.
Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Monitor campaign performance daily, identify trends, and assist in the analysis of programmatic metrics, including basic supply path optimization and media quality indicators. Generate regular performance reports and provide initial insights and recommendations.
Platform & Tool Utilization: Utilize various AdTech/MarTech tools for campaign setup, trafficking, tracking, and reporting. Assist in the evaluation of new media solutions and features.
Vendor Communication Support: Support the Senior Programmatic Campaign Manager in day-to-day communication with core programmatic vendors and technology partners, ensuring smooth campaign operations.
Agency & Internal Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with agency partners and internal teams (e.g., creative, analytics) to ensure seamless campaign execution and alignment with overall marketing objectives.
Operational Adherence & Quality Assurance: Adhere to established governance frameworks for programmatic media activities. Perform meticulous quality assurance (QA) checks on campaign setups, tracking, and reporting. Assist with documentation of campaign strategies and execution, and support billing reconciliation processes.
AdTech Support: Contribute to the understanding and application of programmatic technology, assisting in research and discussions related to new and emerging technology utilization.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

2-5 years of progressive hands-on experience within programmatic media, focusing on campaign execution and optimization, whether client-side, publisher-side, or agency-side.
2-5 years of experience in media, branding or advertising analytics
Strong hands-on experience running campaigns in DV360 is required.
Demonstrated hands-on experience with leading programmatic activation platforms (DSPs), with a proven track record of contributing to performance improvements through optimization techniques.
Experience with Amazon and Yahoo DSPs is a plus.
Foundational understanding of the AdTech and MarTech ecosystems (audience management tools, DSP/SSP, bid management, ad serving, web analytics, identity solutions).
Solid analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and contribute to strategic insights from programmatic datasets.
Proactive and eager to learn about the evolving media landscape, particularly concerning privacy-first advertising.
Good communication and organizational skills, with the ability to articulate campaign performance and collaborate effectively with team members and partners.
Detail-oriented, process-driven, and capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.description:
Overview of Citi:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

Overview of the Role:

The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst is a senior level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis and programming activities.

Responsibilities:

Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Finance Analyst
jobs.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are coming together with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together we're building the data infrastructure layer that moves, transforms, and adds context to data — from the moment it lands to the point where teams and AI systems depend on it.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products our customers know and trust. It's a good time to join a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work.

About the Role

Product Finance covers two things: how our products perform, and what they cost to build, run, and support. This role owns the cost and investment side, as the finance partner to the Product and Customer Support organizations.

You'll own the operating expense P&L for both organizations — headcount and hiring plans, vendor and program spend, annual planning, monthly close, and budget-vs-actuals — and work with those leaders on where to spend and what to trade off.

You'll also build our view of product investment at the portfolio level: what we spend behind each product line, what it returns, and what that means for how the roadmap gets funded. That includes bringing cost of revenue and unit economics into the picture, so we can talk about product margin rather than just product spend. This is how we'll decide where to invest and where to pull back.

You'll build our cost-to-serve view as well — support cost by account and segment, and the economics of deflection and AI-assisted support.

Expect close work with Product Managers, Support and Engineering leaders, Pricing, Corporate FP&A, and Accounting, and regular exposure to senior leadership as we scale toward public company readiness.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in our New York, NY office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

What You'll Do

Serve as the finance business partner to Product and Customer Support leadership — own their budgets, partner on spend decisions, and flag risks, trade-offs, and reallocation opportunities early.
Own the annual operating plan for both organizations, including headcount and hiring plans, vendor and program spend, and quarterly reforecasts.
Own monthly close, accruals, and variance analysis — budget vs. actuals with clear driver explanations and forward-looking implications.
Build the portfolio view of product investment: what we spend behind each product line, what it returns, and what that implies for roadmap funding and resource allocation.
Bring cost of revenue and product unit economics into that view, working with the teams that own the underlying cost data.
Build cost-to-serve analytics — support cost by account and segment, and the economics of deflection and AI-assisted support.
Build business cases for new product investments and major roadmap decisions, including the economics of retiring or consolidating products, and provide Pricing with the unit economics behind packaging and monetization changes.
Co-own the Product Monthly and Quarterly Financial Reviews with the product top-line lead, so cost and performance are presented together.
Improve how this work gets done — better data models, less manual assembly, and AI applied to recurring analysis.

What We're Looking For

4+ years in FP&A, strategic finance, product finance, investment banking, or consulting, including ownership of a model or forecast that others relied on.
Experience owning an operating expense budget, or partnering with a non-finance organization on its spend.
Strong modeling skills across both driver-based revenue forecasts and operating expense and headcount models.
Working knowledge of software and subscription economics — ARR, NRR, ARPA, expansion, gross margin — ideally in a usage-based business.
Comfort working directly with large and complex datasets. SQL proficiency strongly preferred.
Ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation and present it to Product, Support, and senior leadership.
Interest in how software gets built and what it costs to run.

Nice to Have

Product or Engineering finance partnership at a software, data infrastructure, or developer tools company.
Hands-on product margin, cost of revenue, or cost-to-serve analysis.
Experience supporting a Customer Support, Services, or other cost-to-serve organization.
Usage-based pricing, packaging, or monetization modeling.
Planning and BI tools (Pigment, Looker, Tableau, Sigma) and lightweight automation in Python or SQL.
Experience through a period of rapid scaling or IPO preparation.

About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

11

The Team

Credit Ratings is an integral part of S&P Global's Global Ratings Services, bringing together a diverse group of more than 1,400 analysts across key financial centers worldwide. The Corporates Ratings practice assesses the creditworthiness of companies across industries by analyzing business risk, strategy, competitive position, and financial performance to produce independent rating opinions that support transparent, comparable decision-making. Within this practice, the Media, Telecommunications, and Business Services team translates sector and company fundamentals into clear, forward-looking views on resilience across cycles — incorporating emerging themes such as AI-driven business change and shifting consumer and demand dynamics.

Responsibilities And Impact

Impact

This role plays a key part in delivering the independent, rigorous credit analysis that underpins S&P Global Ratings' trusted, decision-ready intelligence. The Senior Analyst leads analysis for an assigned portfolio of companies across the Media, Telecommunications, and Business Services sectors, synthesizing complex financial and market data into clear, committee-ready rating opinions. By integrating AI-enabled tools with deep analytical expertise, the role drives productivity, quality, and consistency across the credit process — contributing to analysis that informs investors, issuers, and market participants globally.

Responsibilities

Team Contribution & Capability Building

Provide day-to-day coaching and guidance to Research Assistants and Rating Analysts, building capability in credit analysis, data discipline, and analytical tooling while reinforcing values-driven behaviors.
Drive consistency and scalability by codifying standard work and promoting the disciplined adoption of shared analytical practices across the team.
Strengthen AI-enabled productivity by developing reusable assets and proposing lightweight automations that free capacity for higher-value human analysis and relationship work.
Partner with senior team members and Data and Engineering colleagues to identify, design, and scale AI and automation use cases with governance built in from the outset.

Core Analytical & Delivery

Lead end-to-end execution for assigned credits, ensuring high-quality analysis and timely delivery with clear accountability across priorities.
Own ongoing surveillance for an assigned portfolio, synthesizing performance data, market signals, and peer context into decision-useful insights with clear risk implications.
Support the embedding of AI and automation tools into analytical workflows, applying structured validation and analytical judgment to maintain the integrity and reliability of conclusions.
Prepare and review key analytical outputs — including model inputs, metrics, assumptions, and published reports — ensuring alignment with methodology, sector frameworks, and evidentiary standards.

Stakeholder & Market Engagement

Engage with external parties alongside senior team members, communicating complex analysis clearly and with credibility.
Craft client- and executive-ready narratives that translate data, research, and analysis into clear, actionable stories for diverse audiences.
Build trusted stakeholder relationships through collaborative, adaptable, and analytically confident delivery.

Risk Management and Operating

Ensure adherence to methodology, confidentiality requirements, and data governance standards; escalate issues early with clear options and recommendations to protect analytical integrity.
Embed responsible, governed AI use into day-to-day workflows, using only approved tools and data while protecting confidential information at all times.
Support the design, testing, and rollout of controlled automation and AI-assisted workflows, contributing to guardrail definitions that distinguish what can be automated from what must remain human-led.

Compensation/Benefits Information (US Candidates)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $97,000 to $154,000 USD. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.

What We're Looking For

Required Skills and Experience:

An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in corporate credit analysis, financial analysis, or a related field.
Demonstrated credit, financial, and risk analysis skills, with the ability to connect key drivers to forward-looking risk views and actionable credit opinions.
Practical experience embedding AI tools, large language models (LLMs), or automation into analytical workflows to improve productivity and analytical insight.
Proficiency in analytical tools, with a willingness to learn data and automation platforms that support AI-enabled workflows.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex analysis into concise, evidence-based narratives for senior stakeholders and rating committees.
High standards for quality, traceability, and governance, with sound judgment on the responsible use of AI in a controlled analytical environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple credits and competing priorities, delivering high-quality work with limited oversight.

Preferred Or Helpful Experience

Experience working within the Media, Telecommunications, or Business Services sectors, or a strong understanding of related corporate credit dynamics.
Coaching or mentoring experience that has contributed to improved team capability, consistency, or the adoption of shared analytical standards.
Experience contributing to process improvement, automation design, or the rollout of AI-assisted workflows.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain stakeholder relationships across teams and functions through collaborative, credible engagement.
Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent required. A master's degree or professional certification (such as CFA) is highly valued. We welcome candidates from traditional finance disciplines as well as diverse academic backgrounds that support innovative and critical thinking.

Additional Information

We require all candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global Ratings office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.
Employees are required to work from the office a minimum of two days per week.

Right To Work Requirements

This role is limited to persons with an indefinite right to work in the United States.

About S&P Global Ratings

At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions.

S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. Job Description

Unleash your expertise in product development and optimization by leveraging user research, analyzing metrics, and collaborating across one of the world's most innovative financial organizations. Data management and governance expertise is applied as domain knowledge that shapes what gets built the primary measure of success is agents in production that materially reduce manual effort. Act as the single accountable owner for data management and data governance across the Data & Analytics Agent.

As a Senior Product Associate in Data and Analytics Team, you contribute to the team by leveraging your expertise in product development and optimization to make a significant impact, supported by user research and customer feedback to fuel the creation of innovative products and continuously improve existing offerings. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and play a crucial role in shaping the future of our products and ongoing success.

Builder's instinct with a strong bias to shipping; pragmatic judgement on where agents add value and where deterministic automation is the better answer; clear technical writing for both engineering and control audiences; resilience in ambiguity as the technology and the platform evolve; collaborative influence without direct authority.

Success Measures (first 12 months), A defined portfolio of agentic workflows delivered to production, with measured reduction in manual governance effort. Reusable agent patterns and tool library adopted by at least one team beyond your own. New or extended platform APIs delivered jointly with platform teams, unblocking previously infeasible workflows. Evaluation and monitoring in place for every production agent, with published reliability baselines and trends. No material data, privacy, or access incidents attributable to agents you built; governance approvals obtained without extended remediation cycles.

Job Responsibilities

Partners with the Product Manager to identify new product opportunities that reflect the needs of our customers and the market through user research and discovery
Considers and plans for upstream and downstream implications of new product features on the overall product experience
Supports the collection of user research, journey mapping, and market analysis to inform the strategic product roadmap and provide insight on potential product features that provide value to customers
Analyzes, tracks, and evaluates product metrics including work to time, cost, and quality targets across the product development life cycle
Writes the requirements, epics, and user stories to support product development
Serve as the DMDG platform's primary person to work on the Data & Analytics Agentic Platform. Be part of the team to design, build, test, and ship agentic workflows that automate data management and governance activities metadata capture, classification, lineage reconstruction, access-request triage, data quality triage, issue routing, control evidence collection, and policy question answering.
Decompose multi-step governance processes into agent-executable task graphs: tool selection, prompt and instruction design, context and retrieval strategy, memory, deterministic versus LLM step boundaries, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and fallback behavior. Own the full agent lifecycle: prototype, evaluate, harden, release, monitor, and iterate. Define evaluation sets and quality baselines before scaling, and instrument agents for cost, latency, accuracy, and intervention rate. Build reusable patterns, tool libraries, and reference implementations so other teams can compose agents without re-solving the same problems.
Map existing platform APIs to target workflows; compose agents and tools over them, handling authentication, entitlements propagation, pagination, rate limits, idempotency, and error recovery. Identify capability gaps and partner with platform engineering to co-develop new APIs: write the use-case brief, propose contracts and schemas, specify payloads and semantics, agree SLAs, and validate against real agent workloads. Act as design partner and first consumer for new platform APIs pilot early versions, feedback on ergonomics and performance, and drive toward stable, agent-friendly interfaces. Where no API exists and none is near-term viable, define the interim path and the conditions for retiring it, avoiding durable workarounds.
Run an opportunity pipeline with data office and business stakeholders: identify candidate workflows, size effort and benefit, prioritize, and sequence delivery. Work in close partnership with Area Product Owners and engineering to land agent work in the platform roadmap and release cycles. Lead or coach a small team of engineers and solution builders; set technical direction and raise the bar on agent build quality. Report delivery and impact metrics to senior management: workflows automated, hours displaced, adoption, agent reliability, and cost to serve.
Apply working knowledge of data management and governance to ensure agents respect classification, entitlements, retention, cross-border constraints, and approved-use boundaries by design and never widen source-system permissions. Navigate the firm's AI/ML and data governance review requirements efficiently, preparing the artefacts needed to get agents approved and into production. Ensure agent actions, inputs, and outputs are logged and traceable to an acceptable standard for audit and control testing.

3+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
Proficient knowledge of the product development life cycle
Experience in product life cycle activities including discovery and requirements definition
Developing knowledge of data analytics and data literacy
3+ years in engineering, data platform, or technical solution delivery, with recent hands-on experience building LLM based or agentic applications in production, not solely prototypes or proofs of concept.
Demonstrated ability to build against and integrate with enterprise APIs; strong practical grasp of REST and event-driven patterns, authentication and authorization models, and integration failure modes.
Proficiency in Python (or equivalent) and current agent frameworks and orchestration tooling; comfortable with RAG patterns, vector stores, tool and function calling, and multi agent or multi-step orchestration.
Experience designing evaluation and monitoring for non-deterministic systems offline evals, regression testing, guardrails, and production observability.

Working knowledge of data management and data governance concepts, metadata, lineage, classification, data quality, entitlements, retention, sufficient to automate those processes credibly and engage governance stakeholders as a peer.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst of Data Strategy, ODP - 27263
jobs.description:
Position Summary:
The Office of District Planning (ODP) is responsible for the development and implementation of district and borough based plans that address local needs and priorities with the goal of increasing access for all families to high quality educational options. These plans, developed in close partnership with superintendents, Community Education Councils (CECs), and local stakeholders, may include the opening of new schools, reconfigurations or re-sitings of existing schools, zoning changes, or openings of specialized programs (e.g. District 75, Autism NEST, Horizon and AIMS programs, etc.), among other levers.

The Senior Analyst of Data Strategy is responsible for developing and implementing policies and plans to optimize the use of space in New York City Public Schools (NYCPS), providing the infrastructure to ensure that students have access to high quality options. This work will include overseeing structural changes to schools to maximize the use of school facilities; crafting proposals to reduce overutilization; and designing various strategies to improve the use of school space and implement the Chancellor’s priorities.

Reports to:
Senior Director, Citywide Planning

Direct Reports:
District Planner

Key Relationships:
Works closely with other members of the Borough Planning Team and Analytics Team in District Planning as well as cross functional groups, including the Office of New School Development & Design (ONS), the Office of Student Enrollment (OSE), the Office of Space Management (OSM), the School Construction Authority (SCA), Office of Legal Services (OLS), and the Office of the First Deputy Chancellor (OFDC). Also develops relationships with key external stakeholders across the borough, including Community Superintendents, CECs, Community Boards, elected officials, principals, School Leadership Teams (SLTs) and Parent Associations to gather input in the decision making process.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning

Leads the development and implementation of district, borough and citywide policies and plans for structural changes intended to positively impact school performance, families’ access, and choice, learning conditions, and promote school integration and diversity.
Leads the maintenance for the strategic planning, design, development, and enhancement of all management information systems utilized by ODP.
Manages the development and review of Educational Impact Statements for all significant changes to school utilization, including the analysis of how proposed structural changes will impact school and neighborhood communities.
Supports the development and implementation of rezoning plans and other changes to school structure specifically designed to integrate and diversify NYCPS.
Oversees community engagement efforts around planning initiatives.
Supports data analysis related to mayoral and chancellor led initiatives, such as increasing enrollment across City schools, and prepares briefings and data analyses for Superintendents around these focus areas.
Analyzes impact of new legislation such as the New York State class size law and models scenarios for NYCPS to reach compliance.
Prioritizes and defines school planning and implementation work in a meaningful and actionable manner.
Allocates space and resources to existing high potential district and charter schools to sustain growth and quality.
Facilitates process for changing school zoning lines to increase choice and address overcrowding.

Cross functional Collaboration

Supports the Senior Director and Chief Executive Officer with all planning related efforts, specifically managing key internal and external relationships with NYCPS partner offices and other city agencies to field requests and communicate time sensitive information.
Assists with managing ongoing assessment of where additional capacity is needed, including working with SCA to identify and assess viability of lease sites.
Manages cross functional planning efforts around District 75 and other specialized programming to ensure we can meet demand across the city. Consults with other offices on District 75 travel analysis and the time and cost of transportation.
Serves as point for press team in generating planning related data as well as for Community Education Councils requesting school and district-level data.
Serves as a resource for local and state government agencies with an interest in educational opportunities.
Collaborates with other relevant city agencies (e.g., City Planning) to share information and best practices, to streamline data and resources.
Collaborates with OSE and the Division of Early Childhood Education to oversee all needs analysis for Pre-Kindergarten, 3-K, and other specialized programs citywide, including working through district channels to identify schools where programs can be established.
Manages collaboration with the OFDC to prepare data briefings for Superintendents to facilitate structural changes and interventions to schools.

Qualification Requirements

Minimum

jobs.title: Service Desk Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Americas Enterprise Technology is shifting from a support model that reacts to problems to one that anticipates and prevents them — and the EUS Technician is where that shift meets the employee in person. This role provides front-line deskside and walk-up support across our Chicago and New York locations, working hands-on with the hardware, software, and access issues that stand between an employee and a productive day — including the high-visibility, time-sensitive support our executives and VIP users expect.

The EUS Technician serves as the L2 escalation tier for the Birlasoft-operated L1 service desk, taking ownership of tickets that L1 cannot resolve — deeper hardware and software troubleshooting, device staging, and onboarding/offboarding — and coordinating with the Asset Management team on device deployment. This is a hands-on, in-office-first role for someone who takes ownership of the problem in front of them and is equally comfortable resolving an L2 escalation, staffing the Tech Bar, or flagging a device issue before the employee even notices it.

The right person for this role brings technical competence, patience with end users at every skill level, and a proactive mindset — someone who sees monitoring data and walk-up patterns as signals to act on, not just tickets to close.

What You Will Do

Deskside Support & Troubleshooting

Serve as the L2 escalation point for tickets routed from the Birlasoft L1 service desk, providing deeper diagnosis and hands-on resolution.
Provide hands-on troubleshooting and break/fix support for laptops, peripherals, and mobile devices.
Recognize and prioritize VIP and executive tickets appropriately, delivering prompt, high-touch resolution without being asked — understanding who needs to be served first and acting accordingly.
Own the L2 queue's SLA performance, ensuring escalated tickets move quickly from L1 handoff to resolution.
Escalate to the Global End User Computing Team (EUC), engineering, or vendor partners only when an issue is genuinely beyond L2 scope, ensuring a warm, confirmed handoff and follow-through.
Document resolution steps clearly in ServiceNow for every ticket worked, including root cause where L1 lacked one.

Onboarding, Offboarding & Asset Coordination

Prepare, image, and configure devices for new hires ahead of start date.
Execute offboarding device retrieval and wipe/reissue processes in coordination with Asset Management.
Maintain accurate device assignment records and flag discrepancies to the Asset Management team.

Tech Bar & Walk-Up Support

Staff walk-up Tech Bar hours, providing same-day resolution for common hardware and software issues.
Deliver a consistently professional, patient support experience for employees at every technical skill level.

Event & Pitch Support

Support onsite and offsite events and client pitches, partnering with the AV team and the Facilities Workplace Experience team on setup, troubleshooting, and live technical support.
Support executive setups and conference room technology and A/V needs as they arise.
Serve as the on-the-ground technical point of contact during high-visibility events, ensuring issues are resolved quickly and discreetly.

Proactive Device Health

Monitor device health signals (e.g., via Nexthink) to identify and resolve issues before they generate a ticket.
Escalate recurring device or software patterns to the EUS Manager for broader remediation.

Documentation & Knowledge Base

Maintain and contribute to knowledge base articles and SOPs for common issues and fixes.
Keep ticket documentation current enough that any teammate could pick up a ticket mid-stream.

Who You Are

You take ownership of the problem in front of you rather than routing it along, and you treat every employee interaction — whether a VP or a new hire — with the same patience and professionalism. You're comfortable working independently, prioritizing a shifting queue — including knowing instinctively when a ticket needs white-glove handling for an executive — and using data and monitoring tools to get ahead of issues rather than just reacting to them.

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
3–5 years of experience in IT deskside support, service desk, or end user computing.

Required Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Windows and macOS device support, imaging, and troubleshooting.
Demonstrated experience operating as an L2 support tier — diagnosing issues L1 could not resolve and knowing when to escalate further.
Sound judgment in triaging support requests, including the ability to identify and prioritize VIP/executive tickets and deliver a consistently high-quality service experience for senior stakeholders.
Working knowledge of ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM ticketing platform.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and endpoint management tools including Intune and Entra ID.
Strong verbal communication skills — comfortable supporting employees at every level, including executives.
Ability to lift and move IT equipment and to be on-site full-time across supported locations.

What Will Set You Apart

Experience with DEX platforms such as Nexthink for proactive device health monitoring.
CompTIA A+, Network+, or equivalent certification.
Experience supporting a distributed, multi-site organization.
Familiarity with AV/conference room technology and executive support.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you know the tools, the ticket queue, the key stakeholders, and how work flows between L1, yourself, and Asset Management.

At 60 days, you're resolving deskside tickets independently, your documentation is clean, and the team trusts your follow-through on escalations.

At 90 days, you're a full contributor across Tech Bar, onboarding support, and proactive device health — not just keeping pace with the queue, but starting to get ahead of it.

At six months, you're a reliable presence at your site, known for turning a frustrating device issue into a fast, professional fix, and for catching problems before they reach the employee.

jobs.description:
Join a quantitative team supporting a large municipal bond market-making desk. We work alongside traders across electronic and voice trading, bond origination, specialized lending, and bespoke derivative products.

Our team uses mathematics, statistics, machine learning, and software to solve practical trading problems. We analyze trading strategies, build electronic trading algorithms, model the financial risks associated with the desk’s inventory, and conduct detailed analysis of trading profits and losses.

Municipal markets offer particularly interesting quantitative challenges. Many securities trade infrequently, bonds differ across numerous structural features, and available market data can be incomplete. We develop mathematical models that connect observable market variables to bond prices, helping the trading desk estimate value, identify relative-value opportunities, manage risk, and make better trading decisions.

The Role

As a Quantitative Strategist, you will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, and engineers. You will use data and statistical analysis to identify potential trading strategies, assist with complex trades and hedging decisions, and improve the models and systems used to price securities and monitor risk.

You will also help organize and maintain the team’s quantitative research environment, including its modeling software, research archive, Python packages, Linux environment, containers and testing. The role includes both immediate desk-facing analysis and longer-term research into trading strategies and market behavior.

Responsibilities

Research and test quantitative trading strategies.
Help traders evaluate complex transactions, hedge selection, position sizing, and execution timing.
Develop pricing and risk models for municipal bonds, bond derivatives, and related products.
Analyze inventory risk, trading activity, and profit-and-loss performance.
Apply statistics and machine learning to trading, pricing, and risk-management problems.
Help move machine-learning and AI models into production.
Organize and maintain quantitative models, research code, and development environments.
Communicate analytical findings clearly to traders and other stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in mathematics.
Masters degree in STEM, preferably Applied Math, MFE, Operations Research, Statistics, Physics, Engineering.
Strong knowledge of probability, statistics, numerical methods, and mathematical modeling.
Good programming skills, preferably in Python.
Familiarity with, or an interest in learning, Linux, Git, package management, containers, pandas, and NumPy.
Strong interest in trading and financial markets.
The ability to take ownership of software, models, and research processes.
Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
A collaborative personality and an interest in working closely with PEOPLE on trading desk.
Ability to stay calm under pressure
Positive, can do, extrovert personality
Experience with fixed income, derivatives, bond mathematics, JavaScript, kdb+/q, machine learning, or production model deployment is helpful but not required.
Recent graduates and candidates with up to three years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. Prior municipal bond experience is not required.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. Job Description

Internal Audit, Corporate Treasury, Analyst

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm that provides a wide range of financial services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals. Founded in 1869, the firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in all major financial centers around the world. We commit people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Our people are our greatest asset – we say it often and with good reason. It is only with the determination and dedication of our people that we can serve our clients, generate long-term value for our shareholders and contribute to the broader public. We take pride in supporting each colleague both professionally and personally. From collaborative workspaces and ergonomic services to wellbeing and resilience offerings, we offer our people the flexibility and support they need to reach their goals in and outside the office

INTERNAL AUDIT

In Internal Audit, we ensure that Goldman Sachs maintains effective controls by assessing the reliability of financial reports, monitoring the firm’s compliance with laws and regulations, and advising management on developing smart control solutions. Our group has unique insight on the financial industry and its products and operations. We’re looking for detail-oriented team players who have an interest in financial markets and want to gain insight into the firm’s operations and control processes.

What We Look For

Goldman Sachs Internal Auditors demonstrate strong risk and control mindsets, analytical, exercise professional skepticism and are able to challenge and discuss effectively with management on risks and control measures. We look for individuals who enjoy learning about audit, businesses and functions, have innovative and creative mindsets to adopt analytical techniques to enhance audit techniques, building relationships and are able to evolve and thrive in teamwork and in a fast-paced global environment.

YOUR IMPACT

As The Third Line Of Defense, Internal Audit’s Mission Is To Independently Assess The Firm’s Internal Control Structure, Including The Firm’s Governance Processes And Controls, And Risk Management And Capital And Anti-financial Crime Frameworks, Raise Awareness Of Control Risk And Monitor The Implementation Of Management’s Control Measures. In Doing So, Internal Audit

Communicates and reports on the effectiveness of the firm’s governance, risk management and controls that mitigate current and evolving risk
Raise awareness of control risk
Assesses the firm’s control culture and conduct risks
Monitors management’s implementation of control measures

Goldman Sachs Internal Audit comprises individuals from diverse backgrounds including chartered accountants, developers, risk management professionals, cybersecurity professionals, and data scientists. We are organized into global teams comprising business and technology auditors to cover all the firm’s businesses and functions, including securities, investment banking, consumer and investment management, risk management, finance, cyber-security and technology risk, and engineering.

Responsibilities

Lead audit execution, including planning, scoping, and reporting of risk-based and regulatory required audits of business areas
Perform risk assessments of related organization units and ongoing monitoring of covered areas by conducting discussions with senior management.
Define audit scope, perform detailed walkthroughs to evaluate the adequacy of the control designs and develop test plans and perform testing to assess control operating effectiveness.
Presenting the scope, progress, and results of the review to internal audit management, business stakeholders and assisting with negotiating finalization of issues with senior client management.
Perform in depth audits of controls supporting liquidity and funding risk management, coordinating with team members across multiple jurisdiction
Drive discussions with stakeholders on identified issues, identifying root causes, assessing appropriateness of remediation plans
Maintain ongoing discussions with senior stakeholders to understand any changes to their organizations, business processes and products, as well as any significant internal and external events, in order to formulate a point of view of the control environment
Develop annual audit coverage plan, including risk assess organization units, identifying high risk areas and fulfilling regulatory expectation and requirements

Skills And Relevant Experience

Bachelors Degree
0-3 years of prior work experience in a relevant field
Strong interpersonal, and relationship management skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Proficient to advanced skills with MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
Team player with positive attitude and strong work ethic
Highly motivated with the ability to multi-task and remain organized in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Experience

Effective audit mindset to be able to independently assesses the firm’s internal control structure in the areas of liquidity and funding risk management and its conformance with regulatory requirements
Experience in a treasury function, liquidity risk management function, liquidity risk independent validation function, or internal audit role covering liquidity risk or treasury within the financial services industry or Big 4 risk advisory

We are dedicated professionals, we work together as a team that has a strong sense of purpose, and take great pride in our collective success.

Research and a nalysis , which is a cornerstone for every analyst. This means you get to be curious and learn every day. Project management and work planning , which includes a broad range of responsibilities from developing hypotheses and figuring out how to explore them to applying effective time management skills to balance multiple efforts and consistently meet deadlines – all while ensuring the highest level of accuracy, organization, documentation, communication, and follow-through.
Emerging decision support , which starts with the presentation of findings through compelling and logical deliverables such as qualitative and quantitative exhibits, as well as discrete sections of written reports. This involves working closely and iteratively with teammates to create polished, client-ready deliverables.

Qualifications

You are the right person for the job if you
:

Are, first and foremost, adaptable and flexible given the dynamic nature of the strategy team’s work and evolving demands and priorities.
Have an aptitude for complex research and analytical work and demonstrated strengths and interest in problem solving.
Are able to work in a self-directed manner, take ownership of work, and contribute to the success of the team.
Are willing to receive and provide constructive feedback.
Are capable of multi-tasking, sometimes under time-sensitive conditions.
Possess strong communication skills including written, verbal, and listening.
Like to collaborate, build relationships, and contribute to a positive work environment.
Have advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and Word skills.
Have an undergraduate degree and a minimum of two years of relevant experience, ideally in a professional services environment.

By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly.
