The HR Compliance Analyst supports Related’s HR Compliance function across a multi-state workforce, helping ensure our policies, practices, and processes adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and internal standards and proactively identify and mitigate compliance risks. The role sits at the intersection of HR and Legal, with hands-on exposure to employment law, litigation support, background screening, and immigration compliance. This position is full-time, reports to the HR Compliance Manager, and will be based in our New York office three days a week. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Regulatory & Policy Compliance

* Monitor new and existing federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations, and summarize key changes and their impact for the team.
* Maintain compliance calendar and tracker (e.g., statutory deadlines and effective dates).
* Gather data and ensure accuracy for regulatory reports.
* Oversee labor law poster process (e.g., ordering posters, coordinating with business stakeholders, and processing invoices).
* Coordinate OSHA and workers’ compensation poster process with internal stakeholders.
* Support policy and handbook review, updates, and rollout, including state-specific supplements and translations.
* Draft guidance memos for internal stakeholders on new and changing state and local requirements
* Assist with vetting and onboarding third party vendors.
* Monitor and track third party vendor and outside counsel invoices against budgets.
* Support background check compliance across multiple jurisdictions, including preparing fair chance notices within required timelines.
* Assist with the development of clear and engaging training content on evolving regulations and policy refreshers for internal stakeholders.
* Provide general support for compliance-specific projects (e.g., self-audits, tracking deadlines and responses, organizing meetings, and initiating follow up).

Employee Agreements & Employment Litigation

* Prepare, distribute, and track litigation hold notices, acknowledgments, and releases.
* Draft severance agreements and separation letters using approved templates.
* Track severance and settlement payment deadlines, including signatures and revocation periods, and coordinate with Payroll.
* Pull and prepare employee files in response to subpoenas, agency requests, and employee requests to inspect personnel records.
* Gather documents and information to support responses to agency charges (e.g., EEOC and state and local human rights agencies) and pending litigation.

Immigration & Work Authorization

* Partner with HR Operations/Talent Acquisition teams on Form I-9, E-Verify, and visa-related work authorization compliance processes.
* Monitor and track regulatory changes affecting visa holders.

jobs.description:
Cataloging/Metadata Analyst

**Required Qualifications (as evidenced by an attached resume):**  
Master’s degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Three (3) years of full-time relevant professional experience. Experience in metadata creation, original cataloging, metadata management, or related content services work in an academic library, research library, archives, or comparable cultural heritage organization. Experience working with library/archives management systems, digital repository platforms, or related technologies.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  
Experience with Alma (Library Management System) and OCLC Connexion. Knowledge of archival/library standards including DACS, EAD, MODS, MARC21, Dublin Core, authority control and controlled vocabularies. Demonstrated interest in leveraging emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI). Participation in/contributions to the cataloging and metadata communities (national/international). Experience working with diverse formats and subject areas. Experience in creating authority records.  
  
**Brief Description of Duties:**  
The Cataloging/Metadata Analyst supports the acquisition, description, discovery, preservation, and accessibility of the Libraries' rare books, manuscripts, and other distinctive collections. Reporting to the Director of Special Collections and University Archives, the position contributes to archival processing, cataloging, metadata creation, public services, and departmental operations. Through high-quality archival practices and user-centered services, the Cataloging/Metadata Analyst enhances the discovery, preservation, and use of Special Collections materials.  
  
The incumbent must demonstrate the ability to learn new technologies, adapt to evolving archival and metadata standards, and work effectively in a collaborative environment with researchers, students, faculty, staff, and community members.

* Cataloging, Metadata & Archival Description:

  + Create, edit, and maintain original and enhanced catalog records (original and copy cataloging plus related authority work), archival descriptions, and metadata for rare books, manuscripts, university archives, audiovisual materials, photographs, maps, and digital collections.
  + Apply national and international cataloging, metadata, and archival description standards to ensure accurate discovery, long-term preservation, and access. Utilize AI-assisted tools, when appropriate, to enhance metadata creation, description, quality assurance, and workflow efficiency while ensuring professional review and adherence to archival/library standards.
* Archival Processing, Collections Management & Preservation

  + Arrange, describe, preserve, and rehouse archival collections in accordance with archival best practices. Prepare, maintain, and update finding aids to support collection discovery and accessibility. Perform the physical retrieval, transport, shelving, and re-shelving of archival and special collections materials. Collaborate with library departments on cataloging/metadata, preservation, digitization, interlibrary loan, and collection access initiatives to support the stewardship and accessibility of collections.
* Reference, Research & Public Services

  + Provide reference and research assistance to faculty, students, university administrators, community members, and visiting scholars through in-person, virtual, telephone, and email communications, including the identification, retrieval, and interpretation of archival and special collections materials. Supervise Special Collections reading rooms.
* Outreach, Instruction & Collection Engagement

  + Support public programming that promotes awareness and use of Special Collections and University Archives including participation in exhibitions, tours, class visits, instructional sessions, and community outreach activities.
* Student/Intern Supervision & Departmental Operations

  + Recruitment, training, supervision and evaluation of student assistants and interns; departmental operational support. Collaboration with other library departments on cataloging/metadata, preservation, digitization, ILL and collection-access initiatives; participation in cross-departmental collection projects.
* Assessment, Professional Development & Service

  + Collect and analyze departmental data for contribution to strategic planning, assessment, reporting, and documentation that supports departmental priorities and continuous improvement.
* Other duties or projects as assigned as appropriate to rank and department mission.

In addition to the employee's base salary, this position is eligible for $4,000 UUP annual location pay, paid biweekly.

Description:

**About Bankwell:**

Bankwell is a commercial bank with more than $3 billion in assets that serves the banking needs of businesses and individuals. At Bankwell, we pride ourselves on our unique ability to bring you high touch, high quality banking with the expertise and dedication of our experienced team of professionals. When it comes to business, our deep industry knowledge, flexibility and innovative treasury and financing services enable us to find the right solutions for our business and commercial clients. We’re passionate about giving back and are actively involved with many not-for-profit organizations that help shape and improve the lives of others. We’re dedicated to giving our time and talent to support the communities we serve. More about Bankwell can be found at www.mybankwell.com.

**Summary of Position:**

Bankwell is seeking a Business Application Analyst to support and expand the use of Jack Henry Enterprise Workflow (EWF) across the organization. This role serves as the liaison between business departments and technology teams, helping automate, standardize, and improve operational processes through workflow design, system integration, task automation, approvals, and reporting.

The successful candidate will work closely with department leaders and subject matter experts to understand existing processes, identify improvement opportunities, configure workflow solutions, support production workflows, and ensure workflows operate efficiently and consistently throughout the bank.

Enterprise Workflow is a configurable workflow platform that automates business processes through task management, approvals, notifications, document generation, audit tracking, and integration with Jack Henry and third-party applications. It is used across lending, deposits, treasury, operations, compliance, customer service, and human resources.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Workflow Design and Automation**

* Develop workflow routing rules, approval paths, notifications, escalations, and task assignments.
* Modify existing workflows as operational and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Leverage pre-built workflow templates and customize solutions to meet Bankwell requirements.

**Application Support**

* Provide day-to-day support for Enterprise Workflow users.
* Troubleshoot workflow issues, failed transactions, routing problems, and integration errors.
* Monitor workflow performance and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Coordinate with Jack Henry support and third-party vendors when necessary.
* Participate in software upgrades, release testing, and functionality reviews.

**Business Process Improvement**

* Work with business units to document current-state and future-state processes.
* Recommend workflow enhancements that improve consistency, efficiency, accountability, and customer experience.
* Assist departments in adopting workflow automation and best practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across banking operations.

**Workflow Administration**

* Maintain workflow configurations, queues, user assignments, business rules, and approval matrices.
* Support task assignment and workload routing across departments.
* Configure escalation rules, notifications, service-level tracking, and approval structures.
* Ensure workflows align with internal policies and operational controls.

**Integration and Data Management**

* Support integrations between Enterprise Workflow, Jack Henry applications, and other bank systems.
* Assist with workflow-triggered updates to customer records and bank applications.
* Validate workflow-related data exchange and automated maintenance functions.
* Support document generation, electronic communications, and workflow-based data updates.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Tag Management & Tracking
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Tag Management & Tracking to join the Customer Profile & Identity team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. You will own the tagging and tracking layer that every marketing measurement decision at McAfee depends on — the tag management system, the data layer, the campaign parameter framework, and the third-party vendor tags and conversion APIs that connect mcafee.com to our advertising, affiliate, and marketing platforms.

This is a hands-on technical role at the intersection of marketing, web engineering, and analytics. McAfee’s consumer web experience spans landing pages, cart, and checkout across 40+ locales, instrumented through a tag management system (Tealium iQ and EventStream), an Adobe standard digital Data layer, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics, and a growing set of server-side and client-side vendor integrations — Google (Floodlight, Offline Conversion Import), Meta Conversions API, Microsoft, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Snapchat, Amazon, Impact Radius, and more. You will be the person accountable for making sure all of it fires correctly, collects the right data, and stays governed.

You will own tag governance end to end: intake and requirements for new vendor tags, implementation and QA in the tag management system across dev/QA/production environments, validation that business-as-usual tags continue to fire and collect after every website release, and the campaign parameter and tracking specifications that make downstream measurement and attribution possible. When a metric looks wrong, you are the person who traces it from the ad click through the URL parameters, the data layer, the tag management extensions, and the analytics beacon to find where it broke.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Customer Profile & Identity and works in close partnership with Web Engineering, MarTech, Marketing, Data Engineering, Privacy/InfoSec, and external vendor and agency teams.

Location: This is a remote position based in the United States or Canada. We will only consider candidates currently authorized to work in the US or Canada and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.

Position Details

About The Role

Own third-party tag vendor governance and implementation — serving as the single point of accountability for how advertising, affiliate, and marketing vendor tags are requested, reviewed, approved, implemented, versioned, and retired across the consumer web estate
Maintain a governed tag inventory — documenting every active tag, its owner, its business purpose, the pages and locales it fires on, the data it collects, and its consent requirements; proactively identifying and removing tags that no longer serve a purpose
Ensure business-as-usual (BAU) tags are implemented and collecting as required — monitoring tag health continuously, validating collection after every website and template release, and driving rapid resolution when a tag stops firing or starts reporting incorrect values
Own campaign parameter and tracking requirements — defining and governing the URL parameter framework (campaign hierarchy, source and sub-channel codes, promo codes, price, affiliate IDs, ad platform click IDs) so that traffic, conversion, and revenue can be attributed accurately end to end
Translate marketing measurement requirements into technical tracking specifications — partnering with Marketing, Product, and Analytics to turn a campaign or experiment plan into a documented spec covering data layer fields, tag management variables, analytics dimensions and events, and vendor payloads
Ensure the data layer is firing and passing correct data to every tag — owning the digitalData contract between the CMS/content layer and the tag management system, defining required fields and value formats, and working with Web Engineering to fix gaps, timing issues, and value transformation defects
Enable destinations to required systems — configuring and validating the flow of events and audiences from the web collection layer to analytics, CDP, customer engagement, and advertising destinations, including server-side conversion APIs and first-party domain collection
Implement and QA tag management changes across environments — building load rules, extensions, and variable mappings; managing promotion from dev to QA to production; and following release governance including HAR/vendor validation, UAT sign-off, and go-live monitoring
Build and run tracking validation and QA processes — using browser debugging tools, network beacon inspection, and automated validation (headless browser scripting, parameter comparison, pre/post release checks) to confirm tracking integrity at scale rather than by spot-check
Lead root cause analysis on tracking and attribution defects — tracing a discrepancy from the source click through URL parameters, the data layer, tag management logic, and the vendor beacon; quantifying impact; and delivering a documented fix with a regression check
Support website migrations, redesigns, and A/B tests — producing pre/post tracking comparisons, running go/no-go validation on new URL structures and templates, and ensuring experiments are instrumented so results are measurable and trustworthy
Partner with Privacy, Legal, and InfoSec on consent and compliance — ensuring tags respect consent management and cookie banner behavior, that new vendor tags clear privacy review before launch, and that collected data stays within approved boundaries
Govern analytics variable allocation — maintaining a solution design reference for analytics dimensions and events, preventing redundant and duplicate variable use, and freeing capacity for new tracking needs
Manage vendor and agency relationships on the implementation side — running technical onboarding for new tag vendors, resolving integration issues with platform support teams, and holding vendors accountable to documented requirements
Document and communicate clearly — maintaining implementation guides, tracking specifications, release notes, and validation reports that Marketing, Engineering, and Analytics can all rely on as the source of truth

About You

You have 5+ years of hands-on experience in web analytics implementation, tag management, or marketing technology engineering
You have deep hands-on experience with an enterprise tag management system (Tealium iQ, Adobe Experience Platform Tags/Launch, or Google Tag Manager) — building load rules, extensions, variable mappings, and managing versioned promotion across dev/QA/production environments
You are fluent with data layers — you can read and debug a JavaScript data layer object, define what a page must expose, and explain precisely how a value travels from the data layer into a tag payload
You have strong working JavaScript and browser debugging skills — DevTools, network beacon inspection, HAR capture, tag debugger extensions — and can diagnose why a tag is not firing without waiting on an engineer
You have production experience implementing Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (eVars, props, events, AppMeasurement) or an equivalent enterprise analytics platform, including maintaining a solution design reference
You have implemented third-party advertising and affiliate tags and conversion APIs — Google Ads/Floodlight, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Snapchat, affiliate networks — and understand click ID capture, deduplication, and conversion payload requirements
You understand campaign tracking and attribution mechanics — UTM and custom parameter frameworks, click ID persistence, channel and sub-channel taxonomy, and how a broken parameter silently corrupts reporting
You are rigorous about validation — you build repeatable QA processes and pre/post release checks rather than relying on manual spot-checks, and you can automate them when volume demands it
You have strong SQL skills and can query event and clickstream data directly to confirm that what you implemented actually landed correctly downstream
You can operate as the governance owner — saying no to an ungoverned tag request, holding a vendor to a documented requirement, and running an intake process that Marketing stakeholders actually respect
You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences — writing tracking specifications engineers can build from and explaining measurement impact to marketers in business terms
You have experience working in agile environments with 2-week sprints, managing recurring release-validation work alongside project deliverables, and communicating progress proactively

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Tealium iQ and Tealium EventStream, including first-party domain collection and server-side event forwarding
Experience with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Adobe Experience Platform, Web SDK, and XDM schema design
Experience with a CDP or event-routing platform (Hightouch, Segment, mParticle) and configuring downstream destinations
Experience with Databricks or an equivalent lakehouse platform for validating clickstream and event data
Experience with Python or Node.js for test automation (headless browser validation, parameter comparison, tag monitoring)
Experience with consent management and privacy compliance for web tags (GDPR/CCPA, cookie banners, consent-gated tag firing)
Experience supporting a high-volume consumer eCommerce or subscription business across multiple locales
Experience with A/B testing and experimentation platforms and the instrumentation they require

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst
jobs.description:
PortfolioFuture is an independent fund discovery and intelligence company. We use empirical research to discover, evaluate, and rank ETFs and mutual funds, and identify where they can credibly compete for allocations in portfolios.

Our research connects more than 10,000 funds with institutional investors, 20,000+ advisory firms, and 400,000+ financial advisors, supporting fund discovery, portfolio analytics, and asset-manager distribution intelligence.

As a Quantitative Analyst, you will work with over 130 million fund relationships and 290+ million ownership opportunities, applying quantitative finance, machine learning, large language models (LLMs), and large-scale optimization methods to investment research and decision-making.

What you’ll work on
Develop quantitative models for ETF and mutual fund research, selection, ranking, and substitution.
Analyze fund performance, risk, fees, and holdings using statistical modeling, portfolio replication, and residual performance analysis.
Research performance persistence, return similarity, and out-of-sample investment outcomes.
Analyze SEC 13F filings, Form ADV/IAPD data, and institutional holdings to identify investment and distribution opportunities.
Develop portfolio construction and large-scale portfolio optimization methods.
Apply machine learning, LLMs, and AI to financial research, prediction, ranking, and reporting.
Explore quantum optimization and build Python-based research and data pipelines.

What we’re looking for
Background in quantitative finance, financial engineering, statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics, or a related field.
Strong Python skills and experience with large datasets, statistical modeling, and time-series analysis.
Knowledge of investment research, portfolio theory, financial econometrics, and optimization.
Familiarity with machine learning, AI, LLMs, or advanced computational methods.
Ability to evaluate model robustness, statistical significance, and out-of-sample performance, and communicate findings clearly.
Experience with ETFs, mutual funds, SEC filings, institutional holdings, or quantum optimization is a plus.

About PortfolioFuture
Fund Substitution identifies ETFs and mutual funds that can serve similar portfolio roles, using return similarity, relative performance, tracking error, and fees.

Fund Decomposition separates returns explained by investable market exposures from residual performance, evaluating replication quality, residual alpha, and risk.

Fund Opportunity ranks ETFs and mutual funds across four dimensions: Similar Fund Ranking, Addressable Market, Pure Alpha, and Diversification Benefits.

PortfolioFuture's research is independent. Commercial relationships do not affect which funds are surfaced, how they rank, or the conclusions reached.

**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Regional Engagement Analyst** to our **Wellbeing Engagement** team in the **US**!

Reporting directly to the Senior Engagement Manager, you will be a culture transformational agent, bringing clients closer to the Wellhub mission and advocating on behalf of Wellhub to clients, users, suppliers. This is a position inside the Global Revenue team responsible for executing Wellhub strategies locally and working closely with our clients.

  

**YOUR IMPACT**

* Deploy Wellhub' global Wellbeing Engagement strategy and best practices for the US market, assuring its correct execution.
* Facilitate webinars for launch clients and cross clients on a regular basis
* Record on-demand content introducing Wellhub to clients
* Localize content
* Attend on-site events
* Manage the organization of the Engagement team's brand folders and client requests
* Work with multiple internal and external stakeholders in order to enable initiatives and projects.
* Engage with multiple timelines of projects to ensure timely completion
* Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Client facing experience / Comfortable facilitating virtual webinars and in-person events
* Capacity to adapt and localize written materials for French Canadian audiences
* Excellent communication and adaptability to dynamic environments.
* Capacity to operate strategically and tactically, ensuring timely completion of tasks.
* Strong Results-oriented mindset
* Proficient skills in AI and Canva
* Strong organization skills and ability to successfully manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Team player and able to collaborate
* Ability to influence and work with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong proactiveness and can-do attitude
* French speaking is a plus

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

  

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

In New York, California, Colorado, Massachusetts, and Washington, the annual base salary range for this role is $64,160 - $71,289. The base salary range for other locations may vary. Actual base salary will be dependent on geographic location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications and/or other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in either our annual bonus plan or a sales incentive plan.

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold-level membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and vision insurance. Access to telehealth, care concierge, and an Employee Assistance Program.

**FINANCIAL WELLNESS:** Plan for your future with 401(k) match, short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

* Our US HQ is in New York City. We are currently set up to hire in California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, Missouri, North Carolina, New Jersey, New Hampshire, New York, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days PTO per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!)

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. jobs.title: Portfolio Analyst & Reporter — CNBC
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

 **Job Description**

The Investing Club is CNBC's successful digital subscription product launched in 2022 with Jim Cramer. The Investing Club – which includes Jim and a team of analysts, reporters, and editors – reports and writes about stocks, investing, and the markets through the lens of educating investors and helping them build long-term wealth.

CNBC is looking for a financial analyst with strong writing and analytical skills to join this fast-growing, profitable business at the global leader in business news. Our ideal candidate can provide the deep insights of a Wall Street pro and explain complex subjects in plain English for regular investors. We're also looking for a good communicator who can collaborate with Jim Cramer and the editorial team to create the smartest content for our paying members. In addition, you have a competitive drive and love the entrepreneurial challenge of helping build the Investing Club during an exciting period of expansion at CNBC.

**What you'll do:**

* Pitch, report, and write stories on stocks and investing that will help our members become better investors
* Conduct research for and contribute to broader projects
* Produce articles for the Investing Club and CNBC
* Coordinate visuals for digital stories, including charts and data visualizations

**At CNBC Headquarters in Englewood Cliffs, NJ, you’ll have access to great perks and amenities:**

Sweat it out

* - Free onsite fitness center with state-of-the-art equipment, plus daily group classes
Eat up* - Gourmet cafeteria with daily specials plus soup and salad bars
Extras* - Dry cleaning

Don’t have a car? No problem! We offer free shuttle transportation to and from multiple locations in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Hoboken and Jersey City.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Salary range: $110,000 - $140,000

 **Qualifications**  

* 3+ years of writing similar content at another major publication or as a sell-side or buy-side research analyst.
* Strong writing and research skills
* The ability to work effectively in a high-intensity environment, often under tight deadline pressures
* A collaborative approach that welcomes teamwork
* Good news judgment and ability to spot smart story angles

**You'll stand out with:**

* Clips of well-researched investment ideas that went on to be successful
* A passion for investing and uncovering new trends on Wall Street
* Established relationships with Wall Street investors and analysts
* Deep understanding of company fundamentals
* Past experience analyzing companies
* MBA and/or CFA credential
* Experience working in a fast-paced digital newsroom and/or experience working on Wall Street or at a financial firm

**Additional Requirements:**

* Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through versantmedia.com be considered
* Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
* **Hybrid:** This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week.

  
**Additional Information**

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com.

VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We include a good faith pay range for each position to comply with applicable state and local pay transparency laws and to promote equity across our organization. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location and may include additional forms of compensation and benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, etc.

*VERSANT Media is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Analyst, MarketingWho is Mastercard?  
We are the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.  
  

* Integrated Campaigns & Thought Leadership: Collaborate with product, sales, regional marketing, and research teams to identify market insights and thought leadership opportunities, translating them into compelling content and integrated B2B marketing campaigns that engage target audiences across digital, social, web, and sales enablement channels.
* Content Development & Asset Creation: Develop marketing assets that support Digital Payments (including Click to Pay, Tokenization, and Passkeys). Create customer videos, playbooks, research, B2B and B2C toolkits to drive market education and adoption.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders across product, marketing operations, media, digital, communications, legal, and agency partners to ensure seamless execution of marketing initiatives and compliance with brand and business requirements.
* Performance Measurement & Optimization: Monitor, analyze, and report on campaign performance, leveraging data, insights, and AI-enabled tools to optimize marketing effectiveness and inform future strategies.

  
All About You – Key Qualifications & Skills  

* Experience in B2B marketing, with a focus on campaign management or content strategy.
* Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts into compelling content and customer value propositions for business audiences.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Experience working effectively in highly cross-functional, global organizations.
* Familiarity using AI-enabled tools to improve content creation, research, campaign execution, and marketing efficiency.

  
Beneficial
  

* Background in payment technologies and products, experience in a B2B sales organization, and familiarity with marketing, analytics, and social media platforms that support digital engagement and demand generation.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.  
  
THIS POSTING RELECTS ONE OR MORE CURRENT VACANCIES ON OUR TEAM, AND MASTERCARD INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 01/12/2027. If the fill date has passed, Mastercard intends to fill this position as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Kearfott Corporation**

Founded in 1918, Kearfott Corporation, a global Aerospace and Defense supplier for over 100 years, is a leader in the design and manufacture of precision motion control products and inertial navigation components. Kearfott has a very long history of innovation, excellence, and is the go-to brand for many of our global clients. Kearfott is trusted, respected and plays a vital role in the success of America's aerospace and defense industries. With over a century of expertise & experience, Kearfott provides quality, reliability, and cutting-edge technology to customers worldwide to meet their sea, land, air, and space navigation and guidance requirements.

We are looking for talented individuals who want to be part of a world-class workforce. Join Kearfott and become part of a company that is recognized for technical expertise and respected world-wide as a ‘full service' provider.

For more information visit our website at www.kearfott.com

**Mechanical Engineering Analyst**

**Overview**

The Mechanical Engineering Analyst is responsible for performing preliminary and detailed level analysis. These include structural, vibration & thermal analysis such that components, subassemblies and assemblies for Kearfott GND products meet internal and customer technical requirements. The Mechanical Engineering Analyst will work & interface with the other disciplines of the Engineering Department (Systems, Electrical, Test, Software) as well as Project Engineers, Program Managers, QA, Production and Supply Chain.

**Responsibilities**

Supports project team in the:

* Performance of FEA on complex electromechanical systems including thermal and stress analysis
* Documentation of and recommendations from FEA results to support peer and customer reviews
* Present analysis data to engineering teams, customer technical representatives, and Program Managers at design reviews
* Selection of materials with adequate structural margins of safety, optimal load paths, low weight, and high producibility
* Development of 3D and 2D mechanical components using SolidWorks CAD
* Development of 3D and 2D electromechanical assemblies using SolidWorks CAD
* Development of 3D and 2D electronic enclosures and electronics packaging
* Configuration management in SolidWorks PDM environment
* Works with cross-functional engineering team to ensure mechanical requirements are fully understood and implemented

**Required Skills:**

* BS in Mechanical Engineering required
* Requires 4+ years of post-graduation experience in FEA
* Stress and thermal analysis using FEA techniques
* Experience using ANSYS for FEA strongly preferred
* Aerospace – Defense background preferred
* Proficiency in SolidWorks CAD and Microsoft Office
* Knowledge of configuration management of engineering documentation
* Knowledge of GD&T
* Familiarity with PDM document management environment preferred
* Strong communication abilities and interpersonal skills
* Team player
* Must be a US Citizen and have the ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Security Clearance

All work to be performed on site in our Pine Brook, NJ facilities.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in New Jersey is **$113,000 - $136,000 Annually.** This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to job-related knowledge and skills, experience level, and internal consistency.

Additionally, we offer a medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, tuition assistance, paid vacation and sick days, paid holidays, and a 9/80 work week with every other Friday off. Our work environment embraces our people as we enjoy monthly employee events that celebrates our workplace culture.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/including Disabled/Veterans**

  
Shift: 1st Shift

First Citizens Maritime Finance offers customized solutions for secured loans to vessel owners and operators. Key areas of focus include the freight, bulker and container shipping sectors.

The Maritime Finance group within First Citizens Bank is hiring an Underwriting Analyst to participate in the Commercial Bank Analyst Development Program.

About the Analyst Development Program

As an Analyst you will participate in the Commercial Bank Analyst Development Program which is designed to build a broad and deep technical skillset through formal classes, online coursework, and on the job training.

Program begins July 2027 on-site at our New York City Office with a 6-week intensive curriculum where participants learn about:

  

* Credit Policies and Procedures
* Underwriting fundamentals
* Financial Analysis and Excel Modeling
* First Citizens Bank Core Values
* Application-specific training on systems
* Business unit overviews with team leaders
* Strategic priorities of the Bank

Following the 6-weeks, Analysts join their teams and stay connected with colleagues through trainings and professional development sessions. We provide a superior foundation and launchpad for continued success for our Analysts as they begin their careers.

About the Maritime Finance Team  
The Maritime team partners with Private Equity firms, Mezzanine funds and Private Credit funds to offer senior secured loans, sale-leasebacks and bareboat charters to owners and operators of oceangoing cargo vessels, including oil tankers, bulkers, container ships and LNG tankers. experienced sponsors in the top 35 MSAs in the US. They focus primarily on bridge, construction and repositioning loans across all property sectors.

Responsibilities & Qualifications:

* Prepare historical financial analysis, projection models and assist in the underwriting of loans.
* Conduct independent industry research.
* Assist in the management and reporting of loans post close.
* Participate in the creation of credit committee documents.
* Attend and contribute to credit committee meetings.
* Develop understanding and maintain awareness of trends and conditions in their respective business unit.
* Maintain credit files in preparation for internal or external audits.
* Develop a firm understanding of FCB systems and resources.

**Position Specific Skills:**

* Partnerships and Collaboration
* Communication (Written and Verbal)
* Critical thinking skills

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree and 0 years of experience OR High School Diploma and 4 years experience in in commercial lending or credit analysis, financial statement analysis, and finance fundamentals

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Major or concentration in finance or accounting
* Strong financial analyst skills and writing ability
* Previous financial internship experience in an analytical role within a financial services institution
* Previous financial internship experience in an analytical role within a financial services institution
* GPA of 3.0 or higher
* Maritime sector experience a plus

Additional Information:

If hired in NY the base pay for this position is generally between $36.06 - $43.27/hr. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment.

Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits

jobs.title: Quantitative Investment Analyst – SAA
jobs.description:
Talcott Financial Group\* is an international life insurance company committed to providing comprehensive risk solutions to its customers. Whether it’s providing peace of mind for policyholders approaching retirement, or helping insurers solve complex risk and capital challenges, Talcott delivers practical solutions that support long-term stability for policyholders and clients.
  
  
Talcott offers the strength of an established organization with the mindset and approach of a modern platform. The enterprise is supported by a proven track record of well-executed transactions, investment-grade financial strength ratings, and strong financial position, with over $136 billion in assets under management. Talcott also benefits from a strategic partnership with Sixth Street, a leading global investment firm managing over $135 billion in assets.
  
  
Talcott’s approach to business is disciplined, transparent, and multi-channel, spanning retail annuities, block and flow reinsurance, and legal entity acquisitions. We have offices in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, Connecticut, New York, and North Carolina.
  
  
Position Overview
  
We are seeking an Investment Analyst to join our Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) Design team in a new role. The successful candidate will design and build the analytical tools that power our SAA process in developing asset allocation strategies and supporting the asset deployment planning. We are looking for a candidate who can use AI-assisted tools to deliver well-validated working models that can be put into production to support dynamic business needs. The role suits a technically strong, fast learner who is excited by the intersection of quantitative finance, insurance asset management and AI.
  
  
Primary Responsibilities
  

* Scope of $50bn+ of general account assets: Include legal entities in US, Bermuda and Cayman
* Portfolio Design & Optimization: Build best in class SAA tools and analytics that support portfolio optimization, scenario analysis to evaluate trade-offs between risk, return, and capital efficiency and asset deployment planning in support of new business, deal pricing and the onboarding of new mandates.
* Model Understanding & Validation: Develop a working understanding of the underlying SAA, optimization and ALM models to integrate into new model builds.
* AI-Assisted Development: Using AI as a core part of the build process while ensuring every tool is robust, validated and technically sound.
* Partnership with Investment Analytics: Work closely with the Investment Analytics team on model design and ensure integration into broader investment platform.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate within Investments and with Corporate Development, ERM, and Actuarial teams to ensure that the solutions developed accurately incorporate capital market assumptions, liability characteristics, and enterprise objectives.
* Governance & Reporting: Assist in preparing materials for investment committees and senior leadership, articulating SAA rationale, tool methodology and relevant insights.

Qualifications
  

* Experience: 2-7 years of experience in a quantitative finance role within investment management; a graduate degree in quantitative finance, computer science, mathematics or a related field may be considered in place of experience. Progression towards CFA and/or ASA/FSA is a plus. Familiarity with insurance asset management, ALM and various regulatory capital frameworks strongly preferred.
* Investments & Capital Markets Knowledge: Strong quantitative and analytical skills with an understanding of portfolio theory, optimization, capital markets and risk modeling and knowledge of insurance products, ALM, liability-driven investing and fixed income.
* Technical Skills: Programming expertise in MS SQL, Python or another programming language required.. Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills. Familiarity with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric is a plus.
* AI Proficiency: Demonstrated hands-on use of AI or agentic AI tools to build working prototypes, or clear evidence of the ability to adopt them rapidly. Understands the limits of AI-generated output and how to specify, test and validate it.
* Learning Agility: Strong aptitude and genuine interest in learning new domains quickly – including SAA, ALM and insurance investment concepts.
* Communication Skills: Strong general and technical communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial and mathematical concepts to a wide range of stakeholders, and to document models and tools clearly for users and validators.
* Problem-Solving & Creativity: Demonstrated creativity and excellent problem-solving abilities in analytical environments.
* Teamwork & Independence: Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative team setting.

**Compensation:**  
This range represents the minimum and maximum annual base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range. The base pay is based on factors including but not limited to experience, competence, and demonstration of proficiencies essential for the role. The base pay is just one component of Talcott’s total annual compensation for employees. Other compensation may include annual bonuses, long-term incentives and recognition.
  
  

* This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without current or future visa sponsorship.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, sex, religion, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, ancestry or citizenship status, genetic information, pregnancy status or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Metergy Solutions, LLC. (“Metergy”)**

Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. The business model allows for long-term recurring revenue through an innovative Submetering as a Service (SaaS) model. Submetering is proven to reduce in-suite energy consumption by 40%, driving decarbonization efforts for Metergy’s clients. This performance has enabled Metergy to issue green bonds and obtain green financing.

Positioned as the #1 submeter provider in the New York and Canadian markets, and one of the largest in North America, Metergy has more than 900,000 contracted meters, issues over 4M utility bills annually and has over 500 team members. Metergy is a portfolio company of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Brookfield is one of the world’s largest investors, owners and operators of infrastructure assets across the utilities, transport, energy, data and sustainable resources sectors. This sponsorship provides Metergy with access to large-scale capital, infrastructure investment expertise and global reach.

**Our Mission**

Provide building owners and occupants with accurate and reliable utility consumption data through market-leading expertise in turnkey submetering and billing, while fostering a workplace with inspired team members empowered to do more good.

At Metergy, we don’t just believe in our people; we champion them. When individuals feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow, incredible things happen. That’s why we’re thrilled to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work** for the **third** **consecutive year**! This achievement reflects our unwavering commitment to building a workplace that’s respectful, inclusive, and high-performing.

Come be part of a team that leads with **passion**, thrives on **positivity**, and delivers with **precision**. We’re proud of who we are and even prouder of where we’re headed.

**The Opportunity:**

The Business Intelligence Analyst will support the Strategy and Analytics team with the execution of detailed analysis and creation of reports, dashboards and visualizations that provide the business with critical information to make informed decisions. The individual will use various tools and techniques to identify trends, patterns, and insights, working with data from various sources, ensuring data quality and integrity, and collaborating with various groups and stakeholders across the business to understand information requirements as well as maintain data integrity/perform audits in our data platform.

Utilize business intelligence and reporting software, database tools, Microsoft Excel, and Office automation to design, build, assess, maintain, improve, and distribute dashboards and reports, combine data, and present accurate information.

  

### **Responsibilities**

* Distill complex data and relationships into clear, concise charts and visualizations, support ad hoc data requests and analysis.

* Design data models to extract data from operational databases and transform the data to easily understood business views.

* Gather and process raw data at scale (including writing scripts, web scraping, calling API’s, writing SQL queries, etc.)

* Process unstructured data into a form suitable for analysis- then do the analysis.

* Automate manual processes.

* Navigate CRM and other systems to build reporting, ensure consistency and compliance across the departments.

* Develop management monthly KPI’s/reports and BI dashboards for stakeholders across all business functions: technology, operations, field, billing etc

* Perform in-depth analysis to identify key business risks and opportunities and make recommendations to improve overall profitability

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Comp Sci/ MIS/ Data Analytics/ Math or Statistics (or any analytical/data driven discipline)

* 0-2 years of experience working within business intelligence (Co-op/Internships included)

* High Proficiency in data modelling and analysis with demonstrated acumen using the following tools Excel, PowerBI, Python & SQL

* Strong SQL experience is a must with knowledge of relational databases, and ability to build and maintain views

* Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

* Data driven analytical skills, knowledge and/or experience related to financial analysis

* Excellent problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges

* Ability to prioritize and adapt to changing demands and deadlines, are essential

* Ability to conduct basic statistical and correlation analysis to identify patterns and trends.

* Excellent skills in Excel, R/Python, SQL

* Experienced with BI Tools such as Power BI / Tableau / SAP (Power BI Preferred)

* Creativity, relationship building skills and dedication are all highly desirable

jobs.title: Quantitative Business Analyst - Equity Factor Models
jobs.description:
Quantitative Business Analyst - Equity Factor Models

**About Millennium**  
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**  
Core to the health and growth of Millennium’s business, the firm’s active, multi-manager model relies on flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including next-generation analytical and trading capabilities. The Equity Factor Model team partners across portfolio risk research, equity risk modeling, and technology to advance risk and performance platforms supporting quantitative research and investment decision-making.

**What You'll Do**  

* Serve as the primary liaison between quantitative research and software engineering teams, translating model specifications and investment strategies into clear, testable technical requirements.
* Manage the end-to-end requirements lifecycle for equity risk modeling and trading tools, from discovery and functional specifications through acceptance criteria and delivery.
* Design and oversee the integration of quantitative models and datasets into the firm’s trading and risk infrastructure.
* Analyze and prototype against market, portfolio, and model data to validate inputs and outputs, strengthen data integrity, and support the quantitative research pipeline.
* Lead end-user testing and feature validation to ensure delivered solutions reflect the mathematical and business intent of investment professionals and portfolio research teams.
* Create and maintain clear documentation for quantitative tools and data feeds, including functional specifications, model logic descriptions, and data dictionaries.

**What You Bring**  

* Advanced degree (PhD or Masters) in finance, financial engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics, physics, computer science, or another quantitative discipline. CFA is a plus.

* At least 2 years of professional work experience (post-PhD) as a business analyst or project manager within a hedge fund, asset management firm, or investment bank. 5+ years for Masters.
* At least 2 years of professional work experience working with software development lifecycles and Agile delivery methodologies. 5+ years for Masters.
* Strong knowledge of asset pricing, quantitative factor risk modeling, portfolio optimization and construction, and core risk management concepts.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, validation, and prototyping.
* Experience partnering directly with portfolio researchers and software engineers to translate complex quantitative needs into actionable technical specifications.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain mathematical concepts accurately to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience with equity factor risk models, performance measurement and attribution, data quality controls, reproducible pipelines, model governance, or market data technologies is preferred.

Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000, which is specific to New York City and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

**Job Profile Summary**

The energy of a newsroom, the pace of a trading floor, the buzz of a recent tech breakthrough; we work hard, and we work fast - while keeping up the quality and accuracy we're known for. It's what keeps us inventing and reinventing, all the time. Our culture is wide open, just like our spaces. We bring out the best in each other through collaboration. Through our countless volunteer projects, we also help network with the communities around us, too. You can do outstanding work here. Work you couldn't do anywhere else. It's up to you to make it happen.

At Bloomberg Finance we are committed to providing world-class support to our business partners by providing insight into business performance, financial oversight and thought leadership. You will join the Bloomberg Media Financial Planning & Analysis team, supporting senior leadership through consolidated financial reporting and analysis, forecasting and planning, and strategic decision support. You’ll play a key role in developing a holistic view of Bloomberg Media’s revenue performance and outlook, while partnering across the business on financial and strategic analyses that inform senior management decisions.

  
  

**We’ll trust you to**

* Develop a strong understanding of Bloomberg Media’s businesses, revenue models, products, strategic priorities, and key financial and operating drivers.

* Lead consolidated revenue reporting and analysis, partnering with business Finance teams to understand performance and outlook and identify key drivers, trends, risks and opportunities.

* Produce concise, executive-ready reporting, analysis and visualizations that synthesize performance, outlook and key takeaways for senior leadership.

* Support periodic forecasts and annual planning by consolidating business inputs, reviewing and challenging assumptions, and developing an independent perspective on the revenue outlook.

* Apply critical thinking and rigorous analysis to internal and external data to evaluate business performance, identify trends, and answer complex financial and strategic questions.

* Partner closely with Media Strategy on strategic analyses and cross-functional projects, including market and opportunity sizing, business case development, benchmarking, and other analyses supporting senior management decisions.

* Develop and maintain high-quality Excel-based models and analyses to evaluate financial performance, key KPIs, business opportunities, and strategic scenarios.

* Develop recurring competitive and market analysis, monitoring industry trends and competitor financial performance to identify relevant insights and implications for Bloomberg Media.

* Proactively identify opportunities to improve and automate reporting, planning and analytical processes to increase efficiency, consistency and accessibility.

  
  

**You’ll need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field of study.

* Minimum 5 years of experience in FP&A, business analytics, or corporate or strategic finance.

* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to structure complex problems, analyze financial and operational data, and draw actionable conclusions.

* Ability to synthesize complex information into concise insights and effectively communicate findings to senior stakeholders.

* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience using enterprise financial systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms.

  
  

**We’d love to see:**

* Proficiency in SQL, Power BI, Alteryx, or similar data and analytics tools, a plus.

* Experience in Media or a business with multiple commercial models, a plus.

jobs.title: Trade CRM Specialist
jobs.description:
### **Position**

**Are you ready for a world of possibilities?**

You embark on a career journey with the leaders of luxury wines, champagnes, and spirits, within the prestigious LVMH Group. From nature to communities, you’ll craft unforgettable experiences that drive the collective success of our 26 Maisons – each one with a unique heritage and set within the most remarkable terroirs the world has to offer. **You enter a world of possibility** where career development opportunities across our Maisons, our 5 global regions, and the entire LVMH Group, are unmatched. You **join a passionate community of talents** that spans four generations and combines a wealth of roles and skillsets from the roots of the vine to the glass and everything in between **. You discover our essential** **relationship** with our terroirs, and how we nurture and preserve the soils which are the source of our singular products. Our global Living Soils Living Together program has four key commitments for 2030: regenerating soils, mitigating our climate impact, engaging society, and empowering our people **. You will share in our passion** for hosting, for art-de-vivre as well as our pride in creating products that celebrate life’s most memorable milestones, while always experienced through measured, responsible tasting.

**Moët Hennessy** is proud to promote a diverse, equitable and inclusive working environment for all. As an employer, Moët Hennessy offers unique journeys throughout its global ecosystem, opportunities to develop new skills and grow professionally. If you want to inspire and be inspired, to craft experiences and experience the best in craftsmanship, this is where you’ll flourish.

The Trade CRM Specialist is a change enablement role that combines strategic, analytical, and operational responsibilities, with a strong focus on user support, training, and adoption of MHUSA’s Trade CRM ecosystem, known internally as ASPIRE, which combines Salesforce for customer relationship management and sales execution with Power BI for reporting, analytics, and data visualization. The role helps Commercial teams effectively leverage these platforms to streamline day-to-day activities, improve customer engagement, and drive more informed, data-driven decision-making.

Working cross-functionally with internal stakeholders, the Trade CRM Specialist serves as a key resource for end users, providing ongoing training, troubleshooting, and guidance to maximize platform adoption and business value. The role also supports the development of actionable dashboards, reporting capabilities, and analytics aligned with MHUSA’s commercial priorities, while promoting best practices and continuous improvement across the organization.

***Office/Location: Hybrid 3x a week based out of*** ***NYC Office***

Compensation: $67,000-$80,000/ Annually + Bonus

### **Job responsibilities**

**Role and Responsibilities**

**1.** **User Training, Support & Adoption**

Serve as a primary resource for day-to-day user support across ASPIRE, Power BI, and related reporting tools. Lead new-user onboarding, deliver ongoing training, troubleshoot functional issues, and develop practical learning materials, including presentations, videos, and quick-reference guides. The VP, Enterprise Risk Analytics will provide enterprise-wide analytical leadership, support, and capabilities across the Risk organization. * Lead a global organization of Risk Analytics professionals and support the planning and execution of oversight activities while providing mentorship, guidance, engagement, career pathing and development opportunities

* Proactively look for and identify opportunities across Synchrony to construct and implement integrated risk analytics solutions

jobs.description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

PayPal's Corporate Development team is looking for a Senior Analyst to help identify, evaluate, and execute acquisitions that advance the strategic and financial objectives of the company and its business divisions. This role is for someone who has built a strong foundation in investment banking and wants to move from advising on transactions to owning them, seeing a deal through from first idea to signed agreement to integration.
  
  
You will work directly with senior leaders across PayPal's businesses and support functions to understand each division's strategic priorities and identify where M&A can accelerate growth or strengthen the business. * Prepare investment memos and support in financial model analysis

* Support the development of business cases and evaluate investment opportunities

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

* 2-4 years of experience in investment banking, corporate development, private equity, or a similar transaction-focused role
* Background in fintech, consumer technology, or consumer financial services, whether through banking coverage, investing, corporate strategy, or an operating role
* Strong financial modeling and valuation skills, including DCF, trading comparables, precedent transactions, and accretion/dilution analysis
* Experience supporting transactions through multiple phases, including target screening, due diligence, negotiation, signing, close, and post-close integration
