jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Business Development
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Analyst, Business DevelopmentOverview  
The Global Partnerships team is responsible for cultivating and managing Mastercard’s most strategic relationships with key players across the payments ecosystem. The team works with global leaders in technology, e-commerce and financial services to build and scale solutions across acceptance, issuing and co-brand partnerships, payments services and emerging commerce capabilities.  
  
Join an agile, high-performing team within Mastercard’s Global Acceptance vertical, focused on growing the Global Acquiring business with leading centralized global acquirers and commerce enablers.  
  
These customers are central to Mastercard’s acceptance strategy and operate across multiple markets, channels and business models. The team works closely with regional stakeholders, product teams and customer partners to defend and grow revenue, deepen relationships and execute priority strategic initiatives.  
  
Reporting to the Vice President, Business Development, this Sr. Analyst role will provide hands-on support across a portfolio of key strategic accounts. The role will work closely with senior account leads to help manage day-to-day customer engagement, coordinate internal stakeholders, progress commercial opportunities and ensure strong execution of strategic account priorities.  
  
The role offers the opportunity to build deep expertise in global account management, business development, acquiring, commerce platforms and emerging payments, while gaining exposure to complex global customers and cross-functional initiatives across Mastercard.  
  
Role  
Strategic Account Support  

* Support Global enablers lead in the day-to-day management of selected key global strategic accounts.
* Develop a strong understanding of each customer’s business, priorities, operating model and strategic agenda to help identify where Mastercard can add value.
* Help prepare for customer meetings, executive engagements, business reviews and strategic workshops, including agendas, briefing materials, presentations and follow-up actions.
* Maintain clear account plans, priorities, actions and deliverables to ensure commitments are progressed and key initiatives remain on track.

  
Client Engagement & Relationship Management  

* Support regular engagement with customers across business, product and commercial topics.
* Coordinate customer requests and ensure the right Mastercard teams are engaged to provide timely and high-quality responses.
* Support the preparation and delivery of QBRs, strategic reviews and other key customer touchpoints.

  
Commercial & Business Development Support  

* Assist with customer proposals, RFP responses, commercial discussions, business cases and internal approval processes.
* Coordinate inputs from product, services, legal, finance, regional and other cross-functional teams to support deal development and execution.
* Support senior team members on strategic deals, negotiations and new partnership initiatives.

  
Cross-Functional Execution  

* Act as a connector across Mastercard teams and markets to support the execution of global account priorities..
* Follow up on actions and dependencies arising from customer and internal meetings and help drive them through to completion.
* Help ensure relevant internal stakeholders remain aligned on account priorities, customer commitments and upcoming milestones.

  
All About You  

* You are proactive, organised and commercially minded, with a strong interest in customers and relationship management.
* You have experience or exposure to account management, business development, partnerships, sales, or another client-facing commercial role.
* You are comfortable supporting complex strategic customers and managing multiple priorities, stakeholders and workstreams at the same time.
* You communicate clearly and confidently and can prepare high-quality customer and executive-level materials.
* You have strong relationship-building skills and enjoy working collaboratively across functions, markets and seniority levels.
* You demonstrate ownership, attention to detail and a strong bias toward execution and follow-through.
* Familiarity with the payments ecosystem, digital commerce, acquiring, commerce platforms or emerging payments trends is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree required.

  
What Success Looks Like  
Success in this role means becoming a trusted and highly effective partner to the global enablers team and the customers they manage, helping the team deliver a consistently strong customer experience and execute strategic priorities with pace and discipline.  
You will help the team:  

* Deepen relationships with key strategic customers.
* Improve the quality and consistency of customer engagement and account management.
* Progress commercial opportunities and strategic initiatives from discussion through execution.
* Ensure customer commitments, actions and cross-functional workstreams are well coordinated and delivered.

Job Description

**The Role**

As a Cyber Incident Response Analyst, you will be part of the Cyber Defence team that develops and oversees the company's security program, ensuring S&P Global is protected from existing and emerging threats. In close partnership with Security Operations and Threat Intelligence, you will detect, analyze, and decisively respond to security incidents, enrich investigations with timely intelligence, and help drive proactive defences. While based in the UK, you will support response and intelligence needs globally.

Candidates should have a genuine interest in cyber security and a strong grasp of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). This role requires a detail-oriented, critical thinker who understands how adversaries exploit systems, networks, and people—and how to respond. Experience applying threat intelligence to investigations and to improve detections is highly desirable.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and triage response to cybersecurity events and conduct forensic analysis across endpoints, networks, cloud, and SaaS.
* Integrate threat intelligence into investigations (e.g., enrich IOCs, map activity to MITRE ATT&CK, identify likely threat actors/TTPs, and assess potential impact).
* Understand the threat landscape through collaboration with industry peers, FS-ISAC, trust groups, and commercial/open-source intelligence, translating insights into actionable recommendations.
* Develop, maintain, and operationalize Incident Response playbooks and SOPs; include PIRs (Priority Intelligence Requirements), collection plans, and feedback loops to refine detections.
* Work closely with the SOC to investigate incidents and deliver containment, remediation, and root cause analysis; produce high-quality intel-informed incident reports.
* Create and tune detections (e.g., SIEM/SOAR, EDR) using intelligence signals (TTPs, behaviors, YARA/Sigma where applicable).
* Produce and present consumable intelligence outputs (e.g., flash alerts, threat overviews, executive briefs) tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to vulnerability/threat surfacing (e.g., emerging CVEs, exploit trends) and advise on risk-based prioritization.
* Deliver actionable incident and hunting metrics to management; assess detection coverage and recommend improvements.
* Follow the end-to-end incident response lifecycle and support post-incident lessons learned with intelligence-driven enhancements.
* Build an understanding of key S&P technology, systems, and business practices to contextualize threats and drive pragmatic defenses.
* Participate in information-sharing activities (e.g., FS-ISAC submissions) in line with TLP and legal/compliance requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of common cyber attacks, tools, and attacker tradecraft; ability to map activity to MITRE ATT&CK and articulate likely TTPs.
* Demonstrated experience handling security events in critical environments and applying intelligence to accelerate triage and response.
* Experience analyzing system, application, and cloud/SaaS logs to investigate security and operational issues; comfort enriching with IOCs and behaviours.
* Hands-on experience with a SIEM (Splunk preferred) for investigations, alert creation, reporting, and threat hunting.
* Ability to produce clear, actionable intel and incident reports, including executive-ready summaries and visuals.
* Familiarity with threat intel workflows: collection planning, source evaluation, indicator lifecycle, PIRs, TLP, and feedback loops to detections.
* Experience with one or more TIPs or intel data sources (e.g., MISP, OpenCTI, Recorded Future) and STIX/TAXII concepts.
* 3+ years of information security experience with a focus on incident response, threat hunting, or threat intelligence.
* Excellent communication skills for varied business and technical audiences; strong presentation skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment; passion for cyber security.
* Advanced knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and operating systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the financial services industry.
* Familiarity with threat hunting techniques (hypothesis-driven, ATT&CK-aligned, behavior-based).
* Windows and Linux administration tools and concepts.
* Understanding of threat actors and the cybercrime ecosystem, including initial access vectors, monetization paths, and supply-chain/SaaS attack patterns.
* Exposure to malware/TTP analysis at a functional level (family identification, persistence/discovery behaviors) and creation of detections (e.g., Sigma/YARA) is a plus.
* Experience producing finished intelligence products (tactical through executive) and briefing senior stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA/GCFR, GCIH, FOR578) or equivalent experience.
* Familiarity with information-sharing standards and practices (FS-ISAC, TLP) and legal/compliance considerations.
* Knowledge of cloud provider threat models and telemetry (AWS, Azure, GCP, M365/SaaS).
* Second language and/or geopolitical awareness for actor context is a plus.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every defect whether damaged, defective, missorted package or item has a cost story behind it, and you'll be the one uncovering it and quantifying it so you can drive the fix. Amazon's Central Operations Finance team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to serve as a trusted finance partner for Defect Cost Controllership (DCC), supporting operational and functional leaders across the network.  
  
The NACF DCC finance team provides cost controllership and project return on investment alongside financial insights for end-to-end defect reduction processes and initiatives across the supply chain. This role will directly influence controllership over defect costs spanning damages, concessions, and missorts, driving measurable cost reduction across fulfillment centers. Our team translates operational KPIs into financial impact so stakeholders have the most current and reliable information to make the best possible decisions for Amazon.  
  
As DCC expands its scope and takes on end-to-end defect reduction workstreams, we need a Senior Financial Analyst to help scale our controllership and cost insights capabilities. The team is investing in automated defect cost attribution and expanded reporting coverage while building new financial models to support warehouse damages initiatives.  
  
You'll work with SQL, Excel, and financial systems like SAP to build models and mine large-scale data while automating reporting. This role sits within the NACF Finance organization and partners closely with operations, Retail & FBA business partners, and customer service finance teams. Your time will be split between deep analytical work, building forecasts, cost bridges, and ROI models, and collaborative sessions with cross-functional stakeholders to align on strategy and present findings to senior leadership.  
  
There is significant room to grow in this role. You'll gain exposure to senior leaders and deep expertise across multiple cost domains, plus the opportunity to shape how DCC approaches financial controllership as the team scales.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own end-to-end financial planning cycles including forecast modeling, variance bridging, network partnership, and presentations to senior leadership.
* Analyze large-scale quantitative data to build meaningful reports that drive defect cost reduction strategy and business improvement.
* Validate project financials to ensure accurate return-on-investment insights and track financial impact against budget baselines.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to align on cost strategy, challenge assumptions with data, and communicate financial insights clearly across audiences.
* Build and automate scalable processes that improve efficiency across finance workflows related to defect costs.

  
A day in the life  
The DCC team focuses on finance controllership, cost savings, and end-to-end defect cost reduction across North America Customer Fulfillment. Your primary focus will be on workstreams that identify opportunities leading to cost reduction and process improvement that strengthen financial controllership. You'll also own project financial validations and return-on-investment analyses while tracking financial impact on budget baselines. The team plays a key role in decision making and developing financial insights as part of monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading cost business reviews, and providing ad-hoc analysis on large or ambiguous deliverables. Recent projects have ranged from building automated cost bridges for monthly business reviews to quantifying the financial impact of new defect reduction pilots across the network.  
  
About the team  
The DCC team supports multiple teams across North America Customer Fulfillment and collaborates with NA Quality, Customer Service, and end-to-end financial controllership. In cases of worldwide workstreams, the team collaborates with business partners across the globe. What sets this team apart is the breadth of exposure. You'll work across every major defect category in the fulfillment network, partnering with operators and finance leaders alike to turn cost data into action.

* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

Whether it’s understanding why one marketing message is more effective than another or what consumers think we could be using AI for in the future, you can always find something interesting to sink your teeth into. Simply put, you love to learn.
Clear and Proactive Communicator – You have excellent written and verbal communication skills and are able to communicate clearly and succinctly. You’re comfortable asking questions and sharing your point of view.
Data Driven – You’re comfortable working with data to identify trends and insights, including both structured (i.e. data and hard numbers) and unstructured (i.e. interviews and qualitative) data. Experience visualizing data with tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Google Docs and Slides is preferred.
Data analysis techniques and software – Familiarity with any of the following data analysis techniques would be awesome: statistical significance testing, correlation analysis, multivariate analysis techniques (such as cluster/segmentation analysis) and conjoint and discrete choice analysis. Experience with statistical packages, like SPSS or Q, are a plus.
Problem Solver – You are a natural problem solver. When something doesn’t go as planned, your first instinct is to look for a solution, rather than viewing it as a roadblock. You’re always on the lookout for new ways to accomplish tasks and have the ability to address issues using creative and collaborative tactics.
Self-starter – Internally-motivated who continuously strives to get things done well, regardless of challenges encountered. You are proactive and always keep an eye on the next step.
Hawk-eyed attention to detail – You notice when font sizes change unexpectedly or a proper noun isn’t capitalized. Errors don’t get past you and you are always focused on ensuring high levels of quality control and reporting.
Expert multitasker – Successfully manages time and multiple competing priorities to ensure deadlines are always met. Staying organized is a must for managing projects!
Great Team Member – T eam player who works collaboratively and harmoniously within a team and across teams. You are comfortable forming connections with colleagues remotely whether that be jumping on a quick video meeting, picking up the phone for a call or chatting with them through IMs. You welcome feedback because you have a zest for learning and growing. You will roll up your sleeves to help get the job done and no task is beneath you.
Your degree(s) – You have a B.A./B.S. degree in areas such as Social Sciences, Psychology, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Economics or a r elated field. Additional degrees are welcome!
Passion – A passion or desire to learn about entertainment, technology, gaming, sports and/or lifestyle sectors. You enjoy or are excited by the prospect of staying up to date on industry trends and developments.

Sompo has a unique opportunity for a Senior Finance Business Analyst
in our Finance Change
team.

As the Senior Finance Business Analyst, you will drive Finance transformation by identifying opportunities to improve processes and technology and translating business needs into practical, scalable solutions. You will partner with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver initiatives that improve efficiency, standardization, quality, and effectiveness. By aligning business needs with Finance’s strategic priorities, you will help shape and implement capabilities that strengthen Finance’s operating model and support its continued evolution.

Location
: This position will be based out of our New York City
or Morristown, NJ

Our Business, Your Impact, Our Opportunity

What you’ll be doing:

Lead business analysis and process improvement initiatives, from requirements gathering and process design through implementation.
Partner with Finance, IT, and cross-functional stakeholders to design and implement end-to-end solutions that improve efficiency, standardization, controls, and quality while meeting accounting and regulatory requirements.
Facilitate process walkthroughs, identify improvement opportunities, and drive stakeholder alignment and adoption.

Collaborate with Change Management and other delivery teams to ensure clear communication and successful implementation.

3–7 years of experience in business analysis, finance transformation, process improvement, or a related field, with strong knowledge of Finance and Accounting processes and best practices.
Proven ability to translate business needs into practical solutions and lead initiatives from requirements gathering and process design through implementation.
Experience partnering with Finance, IT, and cross-functional stakeholders to drive process optimization, standardization, automation, and technology-enabled solutions.
Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and engage senior leaders and build consensus across teams.
Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities, identify risks, and deliver results in a matrixed environment.
Experience with P&C insurance and/or reinsurance preferred; SAP and Power BI experience a plus.

Salary Range:
$120,000 – $140,000 Actual compensation for this role will depend on several factors including the cost of living associated with your work location, your qualifications, skills, competencies, and relevant experience.

Curious -
A deep curiosity compels us to go beyond the brief to deliver exceptional outcomes.

Open -
We value diverse perspectives and new ways of working.

Driven -
We are ambitious, rigorous, self-disciplined, and resilient in our pursuit of excellence.

If you're a collaborative and enterprising practitioner with a passion for media and a desire to make a real impact, we want to hear from you.

Let's shape the future together.

Overview

The Senior Analyst, Paid Search
executes paid search campaigns and has a strong hand in the strategic approach for the campaigns. The goal for this role is to “bridge” the campaign execution and client objectives, deeply understanding client needs and ensuring our paid search and social execution and management delivers against these goals.

Responsibilities

Responsible for ongoing management, execution, and monitoring of paid search campaigns.
Oversee day-to-day management of approved budgets and pacing progress, supporting Analysts in financial system updates and changes in publisher mix.
Manage internal status doc, keeping team organized and providing guidance on task approach and timing expectations.
Partner with Analysts to train and mentor on search campaign management and executional best practices.
Set direction, provide feedback and finalize campaign builds; including keyword research, ad copy creation and overarching campaign architecture.
Steward submissions through review process and accurately launch new campaigns in alignment with approved assets.
Partner with Manager to drive campaign testing and optimization objectives and initiatives, ensuring campaign performance is regularly reviewed.
Lead reporting work stream by providing insights; giving meaning and next steps to performance data.
Vocal role in defining our approach and response to client asks or questions, linking client needs to Search solutions and ensuring timely follow-up.
Support development of search and social plans, including budget forecasts, relevant industry trends, competitive insights, lessons learned and/or opportunities to evolve approach to accomplish brand objectives.
Develop strong understanding of condition, therapeutic area and competitive set, key deliverables and business objectives.
Become power user of Google and Microsoft Ads platform AI capabilities for performance optimization. Understand nuances on how to use each one for what purpose, and what levers are available to optimize in each AI-enhanced capability.

Qualifications

Minimum 1-2+ years of hands-on paid search campaign management experience
Ability to multi-task, manage one’s time and demonstrate personal organization
Proficiency in computer skills needed to manage day-to-day workflow (particularly Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint)
Strong understanding of search campaign management toolkit including Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Bing Ads, etc., able to navigate, establish settings, pull reports, and implement changes across platforms
Experience providing clear direction and training others on search tasks and concepts
Strong communication and listening skills, deeply understanding the needs of others and articulate their needs
Understanding of paid search metrics and how they are connected
Exhibits integrity, trust, and investment in self-development
Well versed in the industry and vendor landscape, proactively reading and sharing potential impact with broader team

Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. It means we honor and celebrate all identities, across all facets of intersectionality, and it underpins all that we do as an organization. We are focused on fostering belonging and creating equitable & inclusive experiences for all talent.

Publicis Groupe provides robust and inclusive benefit programs and policies to support the evolving and diverse needs of our talent and enable every person to grow and thrive. Our benefits package includes medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401K, as well as parental and family care leave, family forming assistance, tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off.

If you require accommodation or assistance with the application or onboarding process specifically, please contact USMSTACompliance@publicis.com. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Payroll Analyst
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

About The Role

The Senior Payroll Analyst leads the execution, audit, and continuous improvement of multi-state payroll operations for a complex, diverse workforce. Positioned as a technical lead working alongside payroll associates and reporting into HR and Finance leadership, this senior role serves as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for both ADP Workforce Now and Workday Payroll platforms. By maintaining rigorous alignment with multi-state tax regulations, driving automated system optimizations, and leading complex cross-functional initiatives, this role safeguards organizational compliance and financial integrity at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Lead multi-state payroll operations: Oversee the end-to-end processing, validation, and execution of complex bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly payrolls across all employment types using ADP Workforce Now and Workday Payroll.
Drive financial integrity & reconciliations: Direct advanced pre- and post-payroll audits, monthly general ledger account reconciliations, and journal entry preparations to ensure complete data accuracy and compliance with internal controls.
Architect & optimize system configurations: Serve as the lead SME for ADP and Workday Payroll, driving platform setup, workflow automations, third-party integrations, and system updates to maximize operational efficiency.
Manage regulatory compliance & audits: Direct multi-state tax compliance, manage quarterly/year-end government filings (including 941s and W-2s), and serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external payroll audits.
Partner cross-functionally on strategic projects: Collaborate with HR, Finance, IT, and external vendors to manage high-level escalations and lead initiatives such as M&A integrations and policy rollouts.
Mentor team members & establish SOPs: Develop comprehensive standard operating procedures (SOPs), maintain functional documentation, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior payroll team members.

Qualifications

7 to 10+ years of progressive multi-state payroll processing and administration experience in complex organizations.
Advanced hands-on proficiency and administrative experience with ADP Workforce Now.
Deep functional and technical expertise in Workday Payroll, including system configuration, custom reporting, and integration management.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation strongly preferred.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field required.

Competencies

Strategic System Ownership: Leverages deep expertise in ADP and Workday to streamline technical workflows, automate manual processes, and architect scalable payroll rules.
Analytical & Audit Leadership: Applies rigorous detail and systematic problem-solving to uncover complex payroll discrepancies, audit general ledger activity, and ensure financial accuracy.
Regulatory & Tax Mastery: Maintains authoritative knowledge of federal, state, and local labor laws and tax regulations, keeping organizational operations continuously audit-ready.
Cross-Functional Influence & Mentorship: Builds collaborative relationships with leaders across HR, Finance, and IT while serving as a trusted technical mentor to team members.

Compensation, Benefits, & Perks

At Success Academy, we invest boldly in our Network team with a comprehensive package designed to support your health, financial future, and overall well-being:

Day-One Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting your first day (SA covers 82% of our core medical plan), plus a free One Medical membership and confidential mental health support via EAP/Talkspace.
Financial Security: 403(b) retirement plan with a 3% employer match, up to $2,400/year in employer HSA contributions, employer-paid life/disability insurance, and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligibility.
Time to Recharge: Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
Perks & Stipends: A $50/month cellphone stipend ($600/year), pre-tax commuter benefits, backup family care, and performance-based earning incentives.

This is a hybrid position based in our NYC Financial District office, requiring on-site work Tuesday through Thursday and remote work on Monday and Friday.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience. This position is not bonus eligible.

$100,000 - $125,000 USD

Are you an operational catalyst and strategic orchestrator energized by transforming how organizations run?

The SVP – Business Manager & Marketing Operations Lead (C14) serves as the strategic chief of staff, financial steward, operational anchor, and culture carrier for Citi’s Retail Banking & Citigold Marketing organization. Reporting directly to the Managing Director (C16), this high-impact individual contributor role leads end-to-end business management, governance frameworks, financial planning, culture-building initiatives, and operational execution across a rapidly transforming wealth marketing ecosystem.

This role provides centralized oversight and tracking for significant strategic funding, growth initiatives, dedicated marketing technology investments, and broader retail marketing transformation programs. As a vital leadership partner to the MD, you will establish robust controls, lead cross-functional capacity planning, optimize campaign delivery workflows, champion team engagement by partnering to action on Voice of the Employee (VOE) feedback, and partner across executive leadership to ensure every marketing dollar is governed, deployed, and tracked against strategic growth milestones and measurable ROI.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Investment Tracking & Financial Governance

Portfolio & Investment Oversight: Direct the tracking, allocation, and performance measurement of Retail Banking & Citigold Marketing budgets and dedicated Marketing Technology funding, ensuring incremental capital is deployed against core market-building, customer deepening/engagement, and acquisition initiatives.
Budgeting & Financial Reporting: Lead strategic financial planning, monthly variance reporting, multi-year forecasting, and expense management in close partnership with Finance and other Business Managers, driving strict cost discipline, agility, and fiscal transparency.
ROI & Performance Analytics: Partner with product and analytics leads to institute rigorous financial attribution models, transformation milestone scorecards, and executive-ready dashboards that quantify commercial value creation.

Governance, Risk & Controls

Control Framework Execution: Establish and enforce comprehensive operational risk and governance frameworks across all retail & wealth marketing workflows, ensuring steadfast alignment with Citi policies, regulatory standards, and internal control requirements.
Risk & Control Champion Leadership: Oversee and empower the day-to-day activities of Risk & Control Champions across the Retail Banking & Citigold Marketing organization, ensuring consistent execution of control requirements, proactive issue management, adherence to regulatory and policy standards, and effective coordination with Risk, Compliance, and Audit partners.
Audit & Compliance Readiness: Serve as the primary, trusted point of contact for internal audit, risk assessments, and compliance reviews; proactively identify operational vulnerabilities and drive prompt, sustainable issue remediation.
Policy & Vendor Oversight: Oversee third-party governance, agency engagement protocols, contracting approvals, and procurement compliance in close coordination with Sourcing, Legal, and Compliance.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Campaign Operations & Resource Optimization

Capacity & Resource Planning: In partnership with functional operations leads, architect and manage resource capacity models, headcount allocations, and project intake pipelines to balance workload demands dynamically against strategic priorities.
Workflow & Process Engineering: Streamline the end-to-end campaign delivery lifecycle—from initial strategy briefing through creative development to in-market deployment—eliminating operational friction, reducing cycle times, and establishing single-point operational accountability.
Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement methodologies, agile operational cadences, and standard operating procedures across creative, media, branch merchandising, and digital activation teams to maximize delivery speed and craft quality.

Executive Stakeholder Engagement & Strategic Coordination

Chief of Staff Support for C16 MD: Act as an executive proxy and trusted advisor to the Managing Director, driving leadership team agendas, Monthly Operating Reviews (MORs), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), strategic executive presentations, and town halls.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Interface seamlessly across Retail Banking Lines of Business, Shared Services, Wealth and Brand Marketing, Analytics, Finance, Risk and Technology to eliminate functional silos and drive enterprise-wide excellence.

Team Culture, Engagement & Voice of the Employee (VOE)

Culture Carrier & Community Catalyst: Act as a central culture carrier for the Retail Marketing organization, championing team-building rituals, recognition programs, and connectivity forums that bring the team together and unify distributed and cross-functional partners.
VOE Action Planning & Accountability: In close partnership with HR and functional leads, analyze Voice of the Employee (VOE) survey findings, lead the development of concrete action plans, and track progress against tangible employee engagement, professional development, and retention goals.
Communication & Morale Advocacy: Foster an inclusive, transparent, and high-performance team environment, ensuring ongoing feedback channels and clear two-way communication between senior leadership and the broader marketing team.

Qualifications & Competencies

Education & Experience

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, Operations, or related discipline; Master’s/MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred.
Experience: 10–12+ years of progressive experience in Business Management, Marketing Operations, Management Consulting, or Chief of Staff roles within a large, highly matrixed financial services institution or Fortune 100 enterprise.

Leadership & Behavioral Capabilities

Executive Presence & Gravitas: High-impact communicator and influencer capable of engaging senior executives, driving alignment, and commanding accountability across cross-functional teams without direct line authority.
Self-Directed Execution: Exceptional ability to operate autonomously as a high-output individual contributor, navigating ambiguous problem spaces and translating broad strategic visions into structured, actionable execution plans.
Change Leadership & Culture Building: Proven track record in orchestrating operational transformations, organizational change management, driving cultural cohesion, and building high-efficiency, highly engaged operational teams.

jobs.description:
The role will reside within the Market Risk Capital team, which is responsible for producing Market Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) and capital results for the Firm Risk Management Department (FRM). These results are key inputs into regulatory reporting, capital management, and internal business decision-making.

We are seeking a highly motivated Analyst with 1-3 years of experience to report directly to the Global Head of Market Risk Capital. The successful candidate will support US Market Risk Capital production and related controls, while also contributing to the governance framework and strategic priorities of the global Market Risk Capital organization.

This highly visible role offers broad exposure to stakeholders across Risk, Finance, Capital, Technology, and business units. It is well suited for an early-career candidate who combines strong analytical, organizational, communication, and project coordination skills with an interest in market risk, regulatory capital, and capital production processes.

Primary Responsibilities

> Support the Global Head of Market Risk Capital and work closely with US and regional Market Risk Capital teams to execute production, governance, regulatory, and organizational priorities.

> Support project management for priority initiatives across the global Market Risk Capital organization, including regulatory change programs, operating model enhancements, process transformation efforts, and other strategic projects.

> Help maintain and enhance the Market Risk Capital governance framework, including governance standards, policies and procedures, review and challenge processes, attestations, committee governance, management reporting, and escalation protocols.

> Work with Market Risk teams in the US and EMEA, and support coordination across Risk Analytics, Model Risk Management, Firm Capital, Finance, Technology, and business units to manage production dependencies and deliver against agreed objectives.

> Prepare clear, concise materials for senior management, governance committees, regulators, internal audit, and validation teams, including production updates, presentations, briefing documents, status reports, and decision papers.

> Track production and project milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and action items; identify exceptions or obstacles, escalate concerns, and support timely resolution.

> Support the recurring US Market Risk Capital production cycle, including data collection, result generation, completeness and reasonableness checks, variance analysis, issue tracking, and management reporting.

> Perform review and reconciliation of US Market Risk Capital results across relevant reporting views; investigate material movements and data or calculation exceptions in partnership with Risk Analytics, Finance, Technology, and business stakeholders.

> Maintain production documentation, control evidence, process procedures, issue logs, and audit trails to support a well-controlled and transparent capital production process.

> Perform analytical reviews of US Market Risk Capital results and support efforts to strengthen controls, data quality, transparency, reporting, automation, and operational efficiency across capital production processes.

> Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, process validation reviews, and other production- and governance-related activities.

> Perform ad hoc capital analyses and contribute to special projects in support of management decision-making and the broader objectives of the Market Risk Capital organization.

You Have

> Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

> 1-3 years of experience in financial services, risk management, finance, regulatory reporting, capital, consulting, project management, or a related field. Relevant internship or rotational-program experience may also be considered.

> Experience supporting analytical, production, reporting, or project workstreams involving multiple stakeholders.

> Strong organizational and execution skills, with the ability to manage recurring production deliverables and project priorities in a fast-paced environment.

> Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear and concise materials for senior management audiences.

> Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.

> Ability to build effective working relationships and engage stakeholders across functions and levels of seniority, with appropriate guidance.

> Exposure to capital production, regulatory reporting, governance frameworks, regulatory initiatives, operating model development, or process improvement is preferred.

> Experience or coursework in market risk, regulatory capital, financial products, or broader risk management concepts is preferred. Familiarity with Basel capital frameworks and Market Risk RWA is a plus.

> Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Experience working with large datasets or reporting and visualization tools is a plus.

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Analyst, Business Development

Overview

The Global Partnerships team is responsible for cultivating and managing Mastercard’s most strategic relationships with key players across the payments ecosystem. The team works with global leaders in technology, e-commerce and financial services to build and scale solutions across acceptance, issuing and co-brand partnerships, payments services and emerging commerce capabilities.

Join an agile, high-performing team within Mastercard’s Global Acceptance vertical, focused on growing the Global Acquiring business with leading centralized global acquirers and commerce enablers.

These customers are central to Mastercard’s acceptance strategy and operate across multiple markets, channels and business models. The team works closely with regional stakeholders, product teams and customer partners to defend and grow revenue, deepen relationships and execute priority strategic initiatives.

Reporting to the Vice President, Business Development, this Sr. Analyst role will provide hands-on support across a portfolio of key strategic accounts. The role will work closely with senior account leads to help manage day-to-day customer engagement, coordinate internal stakeholders, progress commercial opportunities and ensure strong execution of strategic account priorities.

The role offers the opportunity to build deep expertise in global account management, business development, acquiring, commerce platforms and emerging payments, while gaining exposure to complex global customers and cross-functional initiatives across Mastercard.

Role

Strategic Account Support

Support Global enablers lead in the day-to-day management of selected key global strategic accounts.
Develop a strong understanding of each customer’s business, priorities, operating model and strategic agenda to help identify where Mastercard can add value.
Help prepare for customer meetings, executive engagements, business reviews and strategic workshops, including agendas, briefing materials, presentations and follow-up actions.
Maintain clear account plans, priorities, actions and deliverables to ensure commitments are progressed and key initiatives remain on track.

Client Engagement & Relationship Management

Coordinate customer requests and ensure the right Mastercard teams are engaged to provide timely and high-quality responses.
Support the preparation and delivery of QBRs, strategic reviews and other key customer touchpoints.

Assist with customer proposals, RFP responses, commercial discussions, business cases and internal approval processes.

You are proactive, organised and commercially minded, with a strong interest in customers and relationship management.

You demonstrate ownership, attention to detail and a strong bias toward execution and follow-through.

Bachelor’s degree required.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted and highly effective partner to the global enablers team and the customers they manage, helping the team deliver a consistently strong customer experience and execute strategic priorities with pace and discipline.

Improve the quality and consistency of customer engagement and account management.
Progress commercial opportunities and strategic initiatives from discussion through execution.
Ensure customer commitments, actions and cross-functional workstreams are well coordinated and delivered.
Strengthen internal alignment around account priorities and upcoming milestones.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Portfolio Manager - Real Estate Specialty Finance
jobs.description:
At Customers Bank, we believe in working hard, working smart, working together to deliver memorable customer experiences and having fun. Our vision, mission, and values guide us along our path to achieve excellence. Passion, attitude, creativity, integrity, alignment, and execution are cornerstones of our behaviors. They define who we are as an organization and as individuals. Everyone is encouraged to have personal development plans. By doing so, our team members are on their way to achieve their highest potential and be successful in their personal and professional lives.

Salary range:
An annual salary range of $115,000 - $130,000, is what we expect to pay for this position based on overall skills and experience.

Must be legally eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship, now or in the future, to be considered.

Who is Customers Bank?

Founded in 2009, Customers Bank is a super-community bank with over $22 billion in assets. We believe in dedicated personal service for the businesses, professionals, individuals, and families we work with.

We get you further, faster.

Focused on you:
We provide every customer with a single point of contact. A dedicated team member who’s committed to meeting your needs today and tomorrow.

On the leading edge:
We’re innovating with the latest tools and technology so we can react to market conditions quicker and help you get ahead.

Proven reliability:
We always ground our innovation in our deep experience and strong financial foundation, so we’re a partner you can trust.

What You’ll Do

Customers Bank is seeking an experienced Real Estate Specialty Finance – Senior Analyst / Portfolio Manager to support the growth and ongoing management of the Bank’s national Real Estate Specialty Finance Lending platform.

This position will be responsible for underwriting new note-on-note lending opportunities, analyzing the underlying commercial real estate loan collateral, assisting with transaction structuring and closing, and providing ongoing administration and monitoring of existing note-on-note facilities.

The successful candidate will have a strong commercial real estate credit background and the ability to analyze both the underlying commercial real estate loans and the financial strength, experience, and performance of the lending platform serving as Customers Bank’s borrower.

The role will work closely with the Head of Specialty Lending, Relationship Managers, CRE Credit, Loan Administration, Legal, and other internal partners throughout the entire transaction lifecycle—from initial underwriting and approval through closing, funding, ongoing collateral administration, and portfolio monitoring.

Credit Underwriting & Analysis

Underwrite new commercial real estate note-on-note and lender finance transactions in accordance with Customers Bank’s credit policies and risk standards.
Perform detailed analysis of the underlying commercial real estate loans securing each facility.
Review and analyze property-level operating performance, rent rolls, borrower financial statements, appraisals, market information, and other relevant due diligence.
Evaluate key CRE credit metrics, including LTV/LTC, debt yield, DSCR, occupancy, cash flow, sponsorship, liquidity, loan maturity, and exit strategy.
Analyze the structure and terms of the underlying CRE loans, including interest rates, maturity dates, extension options, reserves, cash management provisions, guarantees, and other structural protections.
Evaluate the experience, financial strength, capitalization, liquidity, track record, and lending strategy of the note-on-note borrower.
Review borrower portfolio performance, historical losses, delinquencies, modifications, defaults, and realized loan performance, where applicable.
Identify key transaction risks and recommend appropriate structural mitigants.
Assist in establishing advance rates, borrowing base requirements, concentration limits, eligibility criteria, covenants, reserves, and other facility-level protections.
Prepare comprehensive credit approval memoranda and supporting financial analysis.
Present underwriting conclusions and respond to questions from Relationship Managers, senior management, and credit approval authorities.
Assist with annual reviews, renewals, modifications, extensions, and increases to existing credit facilities.

Note-on-Note Facility Administration

Provide ongoing administration and monitoring of the Bank’s Real Estate Specialty Finance lending facilities.
Review borrower funding and advance requests and confirm compliance with approved advance rates and facility requirements.
Review and validate borrowing base certificates and supporting collateral schedules.
Confirm that loans submitted for funding satisfy established collateral eligibility requirements.
Calculate or verify availability under borrowing base facilities prior to funding.
Maintain detailed collateral tracking for each note-on-note facility.
Monitor underlying loan balances, paydowns, repayments, maturities, extensions, modifications, and other material changes.
Track facility-level and loan-level concentration limits, including property type, geography, borrower/sponsor, loan size, leverage, and other applicable limitations.
Monitor required collateral documentation and ensure appropriate assignments, control agreements, original loan documents, and other required items are received and maintained.
Coordinate with Loan Administration and Operations regarding advances, paydowns, interest payments, principal payments, and other facility activity.
Review collateral releases and payoffs and confirm compliance with applicable loan documentation.
Maintain accurate internal records and reporting for all assigned facilities.

Portfolio Monitoring & Risk Management

Monitor the ongoing credit performance of both the note-on-note borrower and the underlying commercial real estate collateral.
Review periodic borrower financial statements, compliance certificates, borrowing base reports, collateral reports, and other required reporting.
Monitor underlying loans for changes in occupancy, cash flow, DSCR, debt yield, valuation, sponsorship, maturity, and business plan execution.
Identify and escalate deteriorating credit trends, covenant violations, collateral deficiencies, documentation exceptions, and other emerging risks.
Monitor watchlist loans and other criticized or higher-risk underlying collateral.
Assist with internal risk ratings and changes to risk ratings as appropriate.
Prepare periodic portfolio reports summarizing facility utilization, collateral composition, concentrations, upcoming maturities, credit trends, and identified risks.
Assist with stress testing and portfolio-level analysis as required.
Support internal and external audits, regulatory examinations, loan reviews, and other portfolio reviews.
Ensure assigned facilities remain in compliance with approved credit terms, Bank policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Transaction Closing & Documentation

Work closely with Relationship Managers, Credit, Legal, Loan Administration, and outside counsel throughout the closing process.
Review approved credit terms against final loan documentation to ensure consistency with credit approval.
Assist with review of loan agreements, borrowing base provisions, collateral assignments, control agreements, guarantees, and other transaction documents.
Track closing conditions and outstanding documentation requirements.
Coordinate receipt and review of required third-party reports and due diligence.
Ensure all required credit and collateral documentation is received prior to funding or appropriately documented as an approved exception.
Assist with post-closing documentation and exception tracking.

Relationship & Internal Support

Work closely with the Relationship Managers to evaluate new opportunities and efficiently move transactions through the underwriting and approval process.
Participate in calls and meetings with existing and prospective borrowers as appropriate.
Develop an understanding of each client’s lending strategy, underwriting standards, portfolio composition, funding requirements, and business plan.
Provide credit and portfolio insights to Relationship Managers to assist with structuring new transactions and expanding existing relationships.
Serve as a key liaison among Relationship Management, Credit, Loan Administration, Legal, Operations, and other internal stakeholders.
Support the continued development of processes, procedures, reporting, and controls for Customers Bank’s national Note-on-Note Lending platform.

Role Objective

The primary objective of the Real Estate Specialty Finance – Senior Analyst / Portfolio Manager is to provide the credit underwriting, transaction execution, collateral administration, and ongoing portfolio monitoring necessary to support the safe and efficient growth of Customers Bank’s national Note-on-Note Lending platform.

The individual will play an important role in maintaining strong credit quality while helping the Bank provide responsive and efficient execution for its institutional commercial real estate lending clients.

What Do You Need?

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Real Estate, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 2–5 years of commercial real estate underwriting, credit analysis, portfolio management, or loan administration experience.
Strong commercial real estate underwriting and financial analysis skills.
Experience with note-on-note lending, loan-on-loan financing, lender finance, warehouse lending, debt funds, private credit, or commercial real estate bridge lending preferred.
Strong understanding of CRE credit metrics, including LTV, LTC, DSCR, debt yield, occupancy, cash flow, and sponsor financial analysis.
Experience underwriting multiple commercial real estate property types, including multifamily, industrial, retail, office, hospitality, and other CRE assets.
Ability to understand and analyze complex commercial real estate loan structures.
Familiarity with borrowing base facilities, advance rates, eligibility criteria, concentration limits, and collateral administration preferred.
Experience reviewing commercial real estate loan documentation and third-party reports.
Strong financial modeling and Microsoft Excel skills.
Strong written credit analysis and communication skills.
Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines simultaneously.
Ability to identify credit and operational issues and escalate matters appropriately.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with Relationship Management, Credit, Legal, Loan Administration, and Operations.

Key Attributes for Success

Strong CRE Credit Foundation – Demonstrates sound commercial real estate underwriting skills and credit judgment.
Detail Oriented – Maintains accurate collateral, borrowing base, covenant, and facility-level information.
Analytical – Able to evaluate both individual underlying loans and overall portfolio-level risk.
Risk Focused – Proactively identifies emerging credit issues and understands their potential impact on the Bank’s position.
Execution Oriented – Effectively manages underwriting, closing, funding, and ongoing administrative responsibilities.
Organized – Able to manage multiple facilities, funding requests, deadlines, and reporting requirements.
Collaborative – Works effectively across Relationship Management, Credit, Legal, Loan Administration, Operations, and other areas of the Bank.
Growth Mindset – Interested in helping develop the infrastructure, processes, and controls necessary to support the continued expansion of a national note-on-note lending platform.

Hi, we're Brigit! A holistic financial health company helping everyday Americans build a brighter financial future. With a business model that is aligned with our customers, we create transparent, fair, and simple financial products that put money back in the hands of our members, help them spend wisely, avoid unfair fees and build their credit quickly. If autonomy, ownership, and having meaningful input at the company you work for is important to you, come join our growing team!

Brigit is doing innovative and exciting work, but don’t just take our word for it, our work is being recognized by others:

Built In's 2026 Best Midsize Companies to Work For in New York City
Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work For In New York City

Built In’s 2023 - 2025 Best Startups to Work For In New York City

Role overview

We're looking for a CRM Lifecycle Manager to shape how Brigit talks to its customers across email, push, SMS, and in-app. You'll own our campaign calendar and build and deploy both ad-hoc campaigns and triggered lifecycle communications. You will use thoughtful, personalized messaging to meet customers at the right moments in their journey and deliver incremental engagement and retention. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Data, and our business teams, and you'll have the room to test new ideas and see their impact on our customers.

What you’ll be doing

You'll own the CRM calendar from end to end, shaping the strategy, planning what goes out, balancing business requests and customer fatigue across segments to deliver the optimal cadence. Own the marketplace lifecycle programs, building email, push, SMS, and in-app journeys that connect customers with offers that help them. Define the friction points and design messaging that turns them into moments of progress. You'll also help new users get started and bring lapsed ones back.
You'll manage campaigns end to end by building email push and SMS launches hands-on in our ESP tool. You'll also write briefs, coordinate creative, and manage approvals, build/deploy campaigns and deliver results and recommendations on each program.
Keep a pulse on performance. You'll check in on results daily, dig into what's working across channels, and use it to decide what to test next.
Share the story behind the numbers, presenting campaign performance to business stakeholders along with what you learned and where you're headed next.
Team up with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, and Brand to deliver an integrated experience that is aligned across timelines and priorities.
You will ensure campaigns (including tests, segmentation and complex personalization logic) are set up, deployed, and QA-ed accurately in a timely manner. You will also troubleshoot and fix issues when they come up.

What you have

4-6+ years in email marketing, CRM, or lifecycle marketing, ideally at a DTC or consumer app company.
Hands-on experience with a marketing automation platform like Iterable. You know how to build automated lifecycle flows, and when something breaks, you troubleshoot it and suggest a fix.
A track record of running a full CRM calendar across multiple user segments without dropping the ball.
A sharp eye for detail and strong follow-through. Your campaigns go out right and on time.
A love of testing. You always have an experiment running, and you know how to read the results.
Strong analytical skills. You set your own roadmap and KPIs and turn results into action.
Exceptional organization and project management skills, experience managing multiple competing projects/deadlines, and strong attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills
Basic Figma skills are a plus.
A creative mind and a real care for customers. You want every touchpoint to feel helpful, delightful, and on brand.
A proactive teammate and clear communicator who's curious about new tools and ways of working.
Comfort with basic HTML and CSS. You won't be coding emails from scratch, but you can fix a padding issue or a broken link. Handlebars experience is a plus.

This range does not include any other compensation components or other benefits for which an individual may be eligible (other benefits listed below). The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Treasury Analyst
New York, NY
Our Culture at Orion
At Orion, we are builders. We want to be the gold standard for people in the Commercial Services trades. We are building a 100+ year business with an A+ team, driven, excited about the future, and looking for people who want to build with us. We believe in hiring people with a growth mindset who are committed to building something bigger than themselves. Our culture is grounded in four core values: Coach, Compete, Collaborate, and Commit. We strive to be low ego, high performance, and deeply committed to our people, our Operating Companies, and our long-term vision.
Orion Services Group is a growing network of commercial services businesses across the United States, spanning HVAC, electrical, plumbing, building automation, and related trades. We are highly acquisitive, integrating 10-15 operating companies per year, and converting each acquisition into a stable, growth-ready business within the first 90 days of ownership.
Orion is a roll-up-your-sleeves culture. At all levels, we expect people to prioritize, act quickly and effectively, demonstrate agility in their thinking, and get the job done every day. This is not a sit-back-and-direct environment. We value doers, problem-solvers, and people who are hands-on and decisive.
The Role
The Treasury Analyst keeps cash moving across Orion's network of operating companies, from the weekly forecasting cycle through banking, payments, and lender reporting. This role sits on the Platform Treasury team and reports to the VP, Finance, Platform Treasury.
You will serve two groups of clients. Our operating companies rely on you to run a predictable forecasting cycle, get newly acquired companies up to speed, and help them improve how they manage working capital. Platform leadership relies on you for a clear group-level view of cash, a secure and well-administered banking platform, and accurate support for acquisition funding and lender reporting.
This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one. It blends recurring weekly and monthly cycles with project work, and a big part of the job is continuous improvement: finding ways to make each process faster, cleaner, and more automated over time. You will partner every week with OpCo finance leaders, Controllership, FP&A, Capital Markets, the deal team, and our banking partners.
What We Are Looking For
Core Competencies
Attention to detail - you check your own work before anyone else sees it, and you treat every wire, entitlement change, and forecast number as something that has to be right.
Follow-through - you keep the forecasting calendar on track and follow up with OpCo finance leaders until submissions are complete, without needing to be chased yourself.
Analytical curiosity - when a forecast misses or working capital moves, you dig in to understand why and help the OpCo fix the root cause, not just explain the variance.
Continuous improvement mindset - you look for ways to make each cycle faster, cleaner, and more automated, and you document the process so it runs the same way every time.
Sound judgment - you handle bank access, payments, and confidential financial information with care, and you know when to escalate.
Clear communication - you write and speak directly, and you can explain cash results to OpCo controllers and platform leaders alike.
Comfort with a fast pace - you balance recurring deadlines with project work and new acquisitions, and stay organized as priorities shift.
Low ego, high collaboration - you build strong working relationships across Treasury, Controllership, FP&A, the deal team, and the operating companies.
Experience and Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in treasury, corporate finance, FP&A, or public accounting, including relevant internships.
Solid Excel and data skills and a desire to grow them, including learning to build models others can follow, plus comfort using AI tools to automate and speed up routine work.
Exposure to J.P. Morgan Access or another commercial banking platform is a plus.
Familiarity with Workday Adaptive Planning or another planning tool, and a multi-entity ERP such as Sage Intacct, is a plus.
Background in a multi-entity, acquisitive, or private equity-backed company is a plus.
Interest in or exposure to leveraged finance, credit agreements, lender reporting, or foreign currency cash management is a plus.
CTP or CPA, or progress toward either, is a plus, not a requirement.
Key Responsibilities
Cash Forecasting and Reporting
Help run the weekly and monthly cash forecasting cycle with our operating companies, and help newly acquired companies get up to speed on reporting cadences and treasury platforms.
Help build the group-level cash forecast and weekly cash report in partnership with FP&A, and track forecast accuracy over time.
Monitor OpCo cash balances against targets and support the weekly cash sweep.
Banking and Payments
Support administration of our banking platform, including user access requests and bank account updates, in line with our policies.
Prepare wires for review and approval, and support acquisition funding and post-close payments, including tracking earnouts, deferred payments, and holdbacks.
Debt, Working Capital, and Governance
Help prepare quarterly lender reporting packages, track liquidity and leverage, and help forecast interest and other debt payments.
Partner with OpCos to investigate net working capital shortfalls, help roll out order-to-cash best practices, and support continuous improvement.
Help maintain legal entity and bank account records, entity compliance, and treasury procedures, and take on ad hoc analysis as priorities come up.
Reporting Structure
This position reports directly to the VP, Finance, Platform Treasury, and partners closely with OpCo finance leaders, Controllership, FP&A, Capital Markets, and the Execution team.
Work Location and Schedule
This is a full-time role based at Orion's headquarters in New York, NY.
Compensation
The salary for this role will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and alignment with organizational needs. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus and benefits. 100,000-12,000 plus bonus
Our Values
Own It
Take responsibility for your results and empower others to own theirs.
Act With Care
Strive to do work you can be proud of today and in 100 years. Lead with humility, curiosity, and transparency.
Be Agile
Have a growth mindset, embrace continuous improvement, and keep reinventing yourself.
Win Together
Serve the team, learn from each other, and collectively raise the bar.
Orion Services Group is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Paralegal Analyst
jobs.description:
Balestriere Law Firm is seeking a paralegal-legal analyst for immediate hire who wants the best training you can get before law school if you want to be a trial lawyer.

We seek recent college graduates to make a commitment of at least a year and a half through at least May 2028. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to this time period.

This is a full time, business hours, in-office position. There is overtime. There can be weekend work; there will be weekend work if you're on trial, have a major filing, or must address a significant client emergency.

We want those who interested in increasing responsibility during their time at the firm, doing work that actually matters, growing and learning as our firm grows, ready to be on teams and take direction, but also able to take initiative and get through the day without being told every task to perform.

You will have a huge amount of freedom and autonomy to do your work, but at the same time will have to be ready to have your schedule during work hours taken over by having to jump in, without notice, on work at the direction of lawyers -- from straightforward tasks such as being on a previously unplanned call, to shifting gears entirely and throwing yourself into a new case.

No education beyond college is needed. Prior writing experience helps, but if you're a good writer we'll make you a great one. Being careful is essential. Being organized and liking rules means this job and this profession may be for you. Flexibility is key. You will learn a ton, but you have to be ready to take the initiative to do all you can to teach yourself under the supervision of highly experienced trial lawyers, besides whom you'll work on complicated cases that matter.

If you want this position be ready to work hard, grow, have fun, do justice, and serve clients.

KEY FEATURES OF THIS ATYPICAL POST-COLLEGE, PRE-LAW SCHOOL POSITION
Analysts work very closely with one another as well as our lawyers on all aspects of our very diverse array of disputes and investigations, and in all parts of running our firm as a business.

This is not a typical paralegal position. It is not for everyone. You will not be coddled. You will have real responsibility. We handle highly complex, very sensitive matters at our small practice, in courts and arbitrations in New York and around the country, for clients from all around the world. We cannot do what we do for our clients without great, committed analysts who own their work and want to do a great job with their colleagues, both on cases, and ensuring our success as a business.

There are regular touch-base meetings and other protocols we follow, but it is hard to describe a typical week or day. We do what is needed working together to win for clients.

You will matter at this firm - to your colleagues and to firm clients - so we require at least two full months' notice (absent exigent circumstances) before you move on which we will help you to do however we can.

To that end, please keep in mind that we do not favor those leaving any employment position less than 12 months after working in such position so if you do apply please be prepared to explain why you are leaving your present position within a year of starting work.

TRAINING
Development of analysts in the law is baked in to the job.

There is some organized training including weekly meetings on the first day of the week when junior staff share what they have learned with senior staff commenting, generally weekly training lunches regarding a topic of present concern, and a few times a year when we have day long training sessions to tighten our practices.

However, most training is done by the constant back and forth of working with senior lawyers on all kinds of trial matters. This includes discussion after key events (such as a hearing or a large filing) of what we did well and how we can improve, but also near daily revision of documents, and frequent discussion at daily case meetings of the work we do.

START DATE IS WITHIN WEEKS
Please note: we do mean "immediate hire" -- we would like someone to begin with us in the next few weeks. Please keep this in mind if you do not live locally.

NOT FOR LAWYERS
Please further note: if you have a law degree of any kind, whether from the United States or overseas you are not a good fit for this position. Please do not apply if you are in law school, have a J.D., or have an LL.M
.

__________________________________________________
ABOUT OUR FIRM AND THE POSITION
Balestriere is a trials and investigations law firm.

Our firm serves businesses, institutions, and individuals involved in disputes around the world. Our team represents our clients at all stages of a dispute including at trial, in arbitration hearings, and in appellate courts, in intense negotiations, in investigations, and when dealing with the government. We drive cases to win.

Some (but not all) Responsibilities of an Analyst

Assist lawyers and any firm staff, including co-counsel of the Firm, in any work of any kind needed to serve clients and run the firm as a business.
Manage case calendars and dockets.
Conduct factual and legal research.
Prepare and file and otherwise address legal documents under supervision of lawyers.
Coordinate and participate in case events.
Communicate with clients and assist in managing client relationships.
Conduct client and witness interviews.
Serve as a liaison between attorneys and the courts.
Serve an essential role in all aspects of evidence development and discovery including exchange of evidence and in depositions, as well as all manner of court and arbitration appearances, including arguments, evidentiary hearings, and trials.
Run and follow up on invoices.
Assist in marketing and client development.
Perform any administrative, business, or executive assistant tasks of any kind which are needed to run the Firm as an efficient, client focused, winning, profitable, justice oriented business.

Required Degree and Skills

Bachelor's degree (further degrees not needed nor preferred; do not apply if you have an advanced degree - but please do not apply if you do not yet have a college degree unless you are graduating within the month).
Superior writing and editing skills (which we will hone and develop).
General proficiency in general office programs, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Adobe Acrobat.
Ability to work quickly and efficiently under strict deadlines.
Flexibility to pivot from one task to another, including addressing unexpected tasks on a routine basis.
Excellent communication skills.
Strong attention to detail, adherence to the rules of courts and practices of our firm, and a commitment to accuracy.
Desire to grow and learn, particularly in working in teams, in writing, and in tactical thinking.
Initiative, resourcefulness, and an ability to work independently as well as closely with others; in particular certain tasks will often be done alone, and after given direction, without constant supervision.
An ability to multitask and prioritize and trust your judgment and to make decisions on your own.
Authorized to work in the United States.

We have a particular interest in hiring those who are first generation college graduates in their family.
Note : no prior paralegal training or experience is required or even expected.
Highly Desired (but not required) : One to three years of prior work experience in any work environment.

Salary and Benefits

The starting salary is $60,000 per year. Employees participate in the firm's health, vision, and dental insurance plans, and the firm pays for most costs associated with insurance. The firm is developing (but does not yet have) a retirement or pension program. Raises are given after six months of successful employment and twelve months of successful employment along with a reaffirmation by the paralegal analyst to her time commitment.

Application Process

Please apply initially through LinkedIn. If we are interested in an interview we shall message you to set up a video meeting and at that time ask you to email your resume (even if you have sent it previously), writing samples, and a list of references. We shall not immediately contact references.

If we proceed through the process we shall then ask you to come into our office space (please note we do not provide reimbursement for any travel) to meet with multiple staff.

After an initial in office meeting, and perhaps a second office meeting with further staff, we will ask to speak with your three references (and we prefer employer, rather than school, references) whom we will contact.

Finally, after that we may ask you to return to the office for a final in person interview.

Marketing operations at Micato sit at the centre of how we present ourselves to luxury travel advisors and ultra-high-net-worth travellers. From beautifully produced brochures and direct mail to trade shows, campaign coordination, vendor management, and digital asset organisation, this role is central to keeping our marketing polished, effective, and scalable.

You will report to our Marketing Operations Manager and work closely with our Director of Marketing, while partnering across Sales, PR, Creative, and external vendors. You will also have meaningful exposure to leadership in New York and, at times, colleagues in Africa and India.

Micato also embraces AI thoughtfully for its ability to automate repetitive work, improve efficiency, and free talented people to focus more on their unique abilities, judgement, and creativity.

Oversee projects from brief through final delivery, including timelines, budgets, and logistics
Coordinate multiple campaigns and marketing initiatives simultaneously
Maintain and improve digital asset management, including photo rights, naming conventions, metadata, and usage tracking

Who You Are

You likely have a Bachelors/Masters degree and 4+ years of relevant marketing experience, ideally in luxury hospitality, travel, or another high-touch client environment.
