jobs.description:
Description

Duties Description

The SIGNAL System Unit Coordinator (Business Systems Analyst 1 Health) serves as a full-performance business systems analyst for the Strategic Incident & Geospatial Notification, Analytics, and Logistics system, known as SIGNAL, the Division’s statewide emergency management information environment. SIGNAL includes Juvare WebEOC, EMResource, EMTrack, and related applications, dashboards, data exchanges, and integrations used to support health and medical preparedness, facility incident reporting, statewide situational awareness, incident notifications and information exchange, resource coordination, patient and asset tracking, planned-event operations, and emergency response.

Working under the general direction of the SIGNAL System Unit Manager, the coordinator conducts business systems analysis and supports the design, configuration, testing, implementation, reporting, training, and continuous improvement of SIGNAL capabilities. The position works with the State Medical Operations Coordination Center, State EMS Task Force, Division emergency management programs, Department partners, health care facilities, EMS providers, local health departments, emergency management organizations, information technology staff, vendors, and other authorized system users. Work involving regulatory programs is limited to emergency management functions or information needed for preparedness and response and does not include administration of routine licensing, certification, investigation, or enforcement systems.

The position performs the full range of business systems analysis activities for multiple interrelated emergency management applications, workflows, data sets, reports, integrations, and user groups. Assignments require the coordinator to select and apply appropriate analytical techniques; evaluate current and proposed business processes; elicit and reconcile differing stakeholder requirements; translate emergency management needs into functional requirements, data specifications, workflows, reports, and acceptance criteria; and assess how proposed changes may affect downstream processes, notifications, data quality, access permissions, reporting, and system integrations. The coordinator independently completes assigned analyses and implementations within approved SIGNAL governance, configuration, security, documentation, and change-management standards and refers significant policy, system architecture, cybersecurity, contractual, or enterprise-priority matters to the SIGNAL System Unit Manager.

Errors in requirements, configuration, testing, data definitions, reporting, or implementation may result in incomplete or misleading situational awareness, delayed incident reporting or notifications, inaccurate facility, patient, or resource information, disrupted emergency management workflows, inappropriate access to sensitive information, or reduced system effectiveness during an incident. The work requires sound judgment to balance operational urgency, stakeholder needs, data quality, usability, information protection, continuity, technical feasibility, and long-term system sustainability, including during emergency activations when requirements and priorities may change rapidly. The coordinator exercises ownership and accountability for assigned business systems analysis activities and for the accuracy, quality, completeness, and timely delivery of associated work products.

Major Functions And Associated Duties

Emergency Management Business Process Analysis and Requirements Development

Conducts full-range business systems analysis for assigned SIGNAL initiatives and enhancements supporting statewide health and medical emergency management; Elicits business, functional, data, reporting, access, and user requirements through interviews, facilitated work sessions, observation, surveys, document review, analysis of exercises and actual incidents, and review of existing system use; Maps and documents current or “as-is” processes and develops proposed future or “to-be” process models for facility incident reporting, status reporting, situational awareness, incident notifications, resource requests, patient and asset tracking, deployment coordination, planned-event support, and related emergency management functions; Identifies business-process deficiencies, duplicated activities, data gaps, inconsistent practices, control weaknesses, and opportunities for standardization, automation, or improved information exchange; Develops business cases, business requirements documents, functional specifications, use cases, process diagrams, data definitions, validation rules, notification requirements, report specifications, role requirements, and acceptance criteria; Analyzes requested changes to determine the underlying business need, affected users, operational impact, dependencies, constraints, risks, and alignment with approved SIGNAL governance and emergency management objectives; Reconciles differing stakeholder requirements and recommends process, configuration, reporting, training, or procedural solutions to the SIGNAL System Unit Manager; Maintains requirements traceability, decision records, and controlled documentation throughout the system development and implementation life cycle.

SIGNAL Solution Configuration, Validation, and Implementation

Configures approved business-facing components of Juvare WebEOC, EMResource, EMTrack, and related SIGNAL applications within delegated functional authority, including boards, forms, data views, fields, status options, resource elements, workflows, business rules, alerts, notifications, dashboards, and reports; Develops prototypes, mock-ups, and configuration models to demonstrate proposed solutions and obtain validation from program subject-matter experts and affected users; Translates approved requirements into functional configuration instructions for vendors, information technology staff, or other technical personnel when a change requires programming, infrastructure modification, technical security administration, or integration development outside the position’s assigned authority; Develops test plans, test data, scenarios, expected results, and acceptance measures addressing normal operations, emergency conditions, exception handling, data validation, role-based functions, and system dependencies; Performs functional, regression, integration, usability, role-based access, and user-acceptance testing to determine whether solutions satisfy approved requirements and operate as intended; Documents defects, unmet requirements, configuration errors, workflow failures, and implementation risks; Coordinates corrective action with appropriate program, vendor, or technical personnel and verifies completed corrections through retesting; Assesses the effects of vendor releases, upgrades, configuration changes, and system modifications on established workflows, reports, data exchanges, permissions, and user functions; Coordinates assigned implementation activities, including readiness reviews, configuration migration, documentation updates, user communications, training preparation, deployment support, and post-implementation monitoring; Maintains configuration inventories, change records, test results, implementation documentation, and version histories.

Emergency Management Data Quality, Reporting, and Performance Analysis

Develops, configures, or specifies routine and ad hoc reports, dashboards, maps, data visualizations, alerts, extracts, and performance measures supporting statewide situational awareness, health care preparedness, incident management, resource coordination, patient tracking, response operations, and executive decision support; Applies approved data definitions, reporting conventions, validation rules, source-system responsibilities, and quality-control procedures to information collected, processed, displayed, or exchanged through SIGNAL; Monitors data completeness, consistency, accuracy, timeliness, workflow completion, and system utilization to identify configuration, process, integration, training, or user-support needs; Investigates data discrepancies by tracing information through forms, workflows, reports, dashboards, interfaces, and source systems and coordinates corrective action with the appropriate business owner, system administrator, vendor, or technical staff; Analyzes system use, reporting participation, data-quality trends, workflow performance, and recurring deficiencies and prepares findings and recommendations for the SIGNAL System Unit Manager; Supports the development and modification of approved data exchanges and system integrations by documenting business rules, source and destination fields, mappings, triggers, validation requirements, error conditions, and expected outputs; Validates integration results and automated data flows to verify that exchanged information satisfies the approved emergency management purpose and maintains data integrity; Maintains data dictionaries, metadata, report specifications, dashboard documentation, recurring reporting schedules, and quality-assurance records; Handles sensitive facility, operational, resource, and patient-tracking information in accordance with Department policies and approved access and information-handling standards.

User Readiness, Functional Support, and Emergency Operations Support

Provides functional assistance to authorized internal and external SIGNAL users by analyzing reported issues and determining whether they arise from business processes, application configuration, data, functional access, training, system use, or technical conditions; Resolves functional issues within assigned authority and coordinates infrastructure, account, cybersecurity, programming, integration, or vendor-product issues with the appropriate technical administrator, information technology staff, or vendor support resource; Defines business requirements for user roles and permissions and validates that proposed access supports approved emergency management functions, separation of duties, and information-protection requirements; Develops and maintains user guides, standard operating procedures, job aids, frequently asked questions, training presentations, exercises, demonstrations, and other instructional materials; Conducts training for Division staff, Department partners, health care facilities, EMS agencies, local health departments, emergency management organizations, and other authorized users; Coordinates user-readiness and change-management activities for new workflows, system enhancements, upgrades, reports, and data requirements; Collects and analyzes user feedback, support requests, system-use patterns, and recurring questions to identify enhancement, communication, documentation, or training needs; Supports exercises, planned events, emergency activations, and continuity operations by implementing approved incident-specific forms, boards, workflows, displays, notifications, reports, dashboards, and user-access requirements; Monitors SIGNAL functionality, workflow completion, and data flow during assigned emergency-support periods and promptly escalates issues that may affect situational awareness, incident notifications, patient or resource tracking, or response coordination; Documents system-related observations and lessons learned and develops recommendations for configuration, workflow, reporting, documentation, training, or procedural improvements following exercises and activations.

Permanent Transfer Candidates

Our team is growing, and we are seeking someone with technology risk acumen. Are you interested in driving improvements in risk management, controls, and governance processes? Senior Consumer Insights Researcher — Packaging & Design Testing

Role overview

We are seeking a hands-on consumer insights researcher to help a global consumer packaged goods team make evidence-based packaging decisions.

The initial focus is evaluating toothpaste-cap designs to understand consumer preference and whether different options communicate premium quality or luxury. Working with existing images and mock-ups supplied by packaging and design teams, this person will own the research process from study design through analysis and recommendations.

The role will also help establish a repeatable approach for recurring packaging research needs.

Responsibilities

Partner with packaging, design, and marketing stakeholders to define research questions and decision criteria.
Design quantitative consumer studies to compare packaging alternatives and assess preference, perceived quality, premium positioning, and brand fit.
Develop questionnaires, screening criteria, sampling plans, and approaches for presenting design concepts fairly.
Coordinate consumer recruitment and research fieldwork through available survey platforms and participant-panel providers.
Manage study execution, timelines, and response-quality checks.
Analyze findings, assess meaningful differences between designs, and explain limitations.
Present clear data-backed recommendations that help stakeholders select or refine packaging concepts.
Develop reusable research templates and processes to support future studies efficiently.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience independently leading quantitative consumer research from initial brief through final recommendations.
Relevant CPG research experience, including packaging evaluation, design testing, or closely related product-concept research.
Strong questionnaire design, sampling, and statistical analysis skills.
Experience recruiting target consumers or managing consumer-panel providers.
Ability to distinguish personal preference, perceived premium quality, and purchase intent as separate research measures.
Ability to translate findings into practical decisions for packaging, design, and marketing teams.
Comfort working independently with stakeholders across functions.

Preferred Experience

Oral care, personal care, beauty, skincare, or other premium consumer-product categories.
Studies exploring packaging aesthetics, luxury perceptions, and brand positioning.
Research across multiple countries or consumer segments.
Building repeatable research processes within a business.
Qualitative follow-up research to explain the reasons behind quantitative findings.
Physical-product or sensory research, if the scope expands beyond visual evaluation.

Ideal candidate profile

A senior individual contributor or hands-on research manager who has personally delivered packaging studies for a CPG brand or research agency. The candidate should be comfortable both executing the work and advising stakeholders on what the evidence supports.

Success in this role means stakeholders receive timely, credible consumer feedback, understand which packaging designs best meet the research objectives, and have a repeatable process for future evaluations.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Who We Are

Horizon Next
is one of the industry's most innovative and data-driven marketing organizations and sits at the intersection of three constantly changing landscapes: people, data, and media. Our business provides strategic leadership to accelerate growth for our clients through brand strategy, media planning and investment, and best in class analytics across all channels. As the leader in innovative business solutions, we are always pushing ourselves to understand what’s next: our next innovation, our next advancement in analytics, the market’s next media evolution, and your next breakthrough idea. Horizon Next operates with the single goal that tomorrow must outperform today.

At Horizon, we understand the value that different perspectives can bring to our clients and culture, so we strive for an environment where our employees feel welcomed, safe and empowered. We value YOU and believe that your authentic voice and unique perspective allows us to create a more rewarding culture, and experience, together.

Our simple recipe for success? We hire talented people (thinkers, doers, dreamers, makers), challenge them and give them every opportunity to grow.

Job Summary

Data and Analytics are core components of Horizon Next. They are used to drive and inform decision making at all levels of the company. The Horizon Next Analytics team offers a suite of analytical models to help our strategy and client teams plan and optimize media campaigns.

The Analyst, Business Intelligence (Product Management)
will assist in the implementation and maintenance of these models across our clients. They will become a trusted resource on the data and processes involved in powering the models offered by Next Analytics and work closely with Horizon Next strategy and client teams as they use the various models. The Analyst will be responsible for day-to-day handling of data-related and modeling requests from Horizon Next Strategy and client teams. In addition, the analyst will help with QA of data pipelines and building reporting files for model output.

This is a hands-on role in which the Analyst will be supportive in managing data inputs for models, develop familiarity with the code that runs them, and understand the reporting out of the models.

What You’ll Do

60% - Deploy and maintain Next Analytics models for Horizon Next clients

Ensure existing model pipelines run smoothly and produce high-quality data
Help strategy and client teams interpret model outputs
Assist with onboarding new clients by gathering the required data inputs needed for their models
Update models for existing clients to add new features or KPIs
Identify opportunities to automate model onboarding and deployment
Investigate any bugs or model output issues that may arise

30% - Assist with QA of model input and output

Build processes to provide data to client teams for transparency and reporting
Work with client teams to maintain QA files

jobs.title: Penetration Testing Analyst, Vice President
jobs.description:
Who we are looking fo
r

We are seeking a Vice President, Penetration Testing Analyst, to join State Street's Threat Intelligence and Assurance organization. This is a senior, hands-on technical role and serves as the team's in-house technical authority for complex penetration testing engagements and for validating remediation.

Why this role is important to us

You will lead the technical execution of scenario-based testing against high-value systems and services, and you will own the validation of fixes for the resulting findings. Working with finding owners, offensive security partners, external testing providers, security operations, and risk and regulatory partners, you will make sure testing is realistic, findings are technically sound, and every fix holds up under real-world attack conditions. You will be accountable for the technical defensibility of closure decisions presented to senior leadership and the Lines of Defense. You will also help mature a repeatable, high-quality internal testing capability.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Vice President, Penetration Testing Analyst, you will:

Serve as the senior technical lead across the engagement lifecycle, including scoping, test planning, rules of engagement, execution oversight, and post-test remediation planning.
Provide real-time technical guidance during engagements by assessing tester activity, judging operational risk, and guiding escalation decisions with appropriate discretion.
Hold external testing providers to a high technical standard by challenging their attack paths, evidence quality, severity ratings, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping, so that results are accurate, actionable, and defensible.
Lead coordination with finding owners and engineering teams to turn findings into clear technical remediation requirements and measurable validation criteria, so fixes address root causes rather than narrow point issues.
Lead the strategy for validating remediation. This includes grouping related findings, defining test criteria and expected outcomes, and personally retesting fixes against the original attack path and other ways of reaching the same objective.
Assess remediation across the wider estate, including variant attack paths, implementation consistency, and any new exposure the fix itself introduces.
Make the final technical call on closure recommendations, backed by evidence-based reporting that confirms each finding as closed, open, or partially closed, with executive summaries for senior and non-technical audiences.
Present testing and validation outcomes to senior leadership and governance forums, and defend the technical basis for findings, residual risk, and closure decisions.
Design and lead targeted TTP assessments and collaborative purple team exercises, so that detection, response, and preventive controls are validated against relevant attacker behavior.
Feed detection and control gaps found during testing to Detection Engineering, Assurance, and Security Operations, and track the resulting improvements through validation.
Provide offensive security support to partner teams, including risk and regulatory functions, and help set the methods, test plans, evidence standards, and lessons-learned practices that mature the internal capability. You will also mentor team members and partners.

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

Extensive hands-on experience in offensive security, such as advanced penetration testing, red teaming, or adversary simulation, ideally in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
Expert-level practical knowledge of Active Directory and Entra ID attack paths, privilege escalation, lateral movement, credential abuse, EDR evasion, and cloud attack techniques across Azure and AWS.
Advanced proficiency with offensive tooling and C2 frameworks, such as Cobalt Strike, BloodHound, Mimikatz, Metasploit, and Kali Linux, plus scripting for custom tooling and automation (Python, PowerShell, or similar).
A proven record of leading remediation validation for complex findings, including defining closure criteria and deciding whether controls work in practice rather than just on paper.
Deep working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, scenario-based test design, and how detection and response capabilities are measured during testing.
Experience directing and challenging third-party testing providers, with the judgment to separate exploitable risk from theoretical findings.
Executive-level written and verbal communication, with the ability to defend technical conclusions to senior leadership, governance bodies, and independent reviewers.
Discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive, confidential engagement information.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
10 or more years of related experience
Industry-recognized offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSCE3, CRTO, GXPN, or equivalent.
Experience supporting large-scale remediation validation programs is strongly preferred.

Salary Range

$120,000 - $202,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

jobs.title: Actuarial Analyst - Commercial P&C Insurance
jobs.description:
Come join our team!

There are many reasons why EPIC Insurance Brokers & Consultants has become one of the fastest-growing firms in the insurance industry. Fueled and driven by capable, committed people who share common beliefs and values and "bring it" every day, EPIC is always looking for people who have "the right stuff" – people who know what they want and aren't afraid to make it happen.

Headquartered in New York City and founded in 2007, our company has over 4,000 employees nationwide. With locations spread out across the U.S., our local market knowledge and industry expertise helps support our clients' regional and global needs. We have grown very quickly since our founding, and we continue to see growth and success thanks to our hard-working and growth-minded employees.

Our core values are: Owner mindset, Inspire trust, Think big, and Drive results. If these values and growth align with what you're looking for in your next career? Then consider joining our amazing team!

  

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

We're hiring an **Actuary** to build the pricing models behind our property insurance work, as well as working on casualty lines. You'll build, validate, and maintain actuarial and CAT models that tell us what property insurance should cost for our clients, and you'll turn that output into recommendations our brokers can use with risk managers and CFOs. **Current Property experience is preferred but not required; however must have property pricing & modeling experience at some point in career.**

This is a hands-on modeling job. Most of your week will be spent in the data (policy info, exposures, loss runs) building and refining models that help brokers benchmark risk, sanity-check pricing, and advise clients heading into renewal. ACAS is preferred but not required. If you're a non-credentialed actuary with real property modeling chops, we want to talk to you.  
If you like building property pricing models and want to see your work change how clients buy insurance, this one is for you.  
  
**LOCATION:** Hybrid - open to 3 to 5 days a week in any of the following EPIC Office locations: New York City; San Francisco; Seattle.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**  

* Build, validate, and maintain the actuarial and statistical models we use to price property risk, both CAT and non-CAT.
* Work with a collaborative group of 10+ actuaries, geographically dispersed, with a core group located in NYC.
* Use those models to produce indicated rates, layer pricing, limit adequacy reads, retention analysis, and TCOR views that feed real placement decisions.
* Get hands-on with the data. That means cleaning up SOVs, loss runs, and policy schedules, and setting up workflows so the next analysis is faster than the last one.
* Turn model output into something a client can read. Think slides, benchmarks, and short written narratives our brokers can put in front of a CFO without translating.
* Sit with producers, property practice leaders, and clients to walk through the numbers, take the hard questions, and help shape program structure.
* Pitch in on new business. Request for Proposals, prospect meetings, and any deliverable where the actuarial story matters.
* Use AI to move faster and to push back on your own work. We expect you to lean on AI tools for the grunt work (data cleanup, first-pass code, drafting client narratives) and to stress-test your models with it: poke holes in assumptions, run sanity checks, and pressure-test results before they go out the door.
* Keep your models documented and auditable so anyone on the team can pick them up.

**TOOLS YOU'LL USE:**  

* Modeling & Simulation: @RISK, ModelRisk
* CAT Platforms: Moody's RMS, Verisk AIR, Archipelago
* Data & Programming: Excel, VBA, Python, R
* Visualization & Mapping: Power BI, Tableau, ArcGIS
* Market Intelligence: S&P Capital IQ
* Presentations: PowerPoint
* AI: Copilot, Claude

You won't necessarily use all of these on day one. But if you've touched most of them, you'll ramp up fast.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**  
Credentials & Technical Skills  

* ACAS is preferred. If you're not credentialed, we'll still seriously consider you with at least 2 years of dedicated commercial insurance pricing or modeling work.
* Real property modeling experience. You've worked on loss development, trend, frequency/severity, CAT load integration, and layer pricing, not just read about them.
* Comfort with big, messy datasets. Strong Excel is table stakes. You also work in at least one of Python, R, or SQL.
* You use AI in your day-to-day. Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, whatever fits the job. You know where it saves you hours, and you know when not to trust it.
* You can explain your work without jargon. If you can't get a broker or a client to follow the logic, the model doesn't matter.

Experience & Education  

* 2+ years of actuarial work, with meaningful time spent on property pricing or modeling.
* Bachelors in actuarial science, math, stats, or another quantitative field.
* Brokerage, reinsurance, or carrier-side property pricing experience is a big plus. Bonus points if you've seen how actuarial work actually moves a placement.
* Self-starter mindset. Our property analytics practice is growing fast, and we need people who want to help build it, not just slot into a process.

Domain  

* You understand commercial property: how programs are structured, what a tower looks like, what TIV values actually represent, and the actuarial logic underneath it all.
* You know the major CAT models (AIR, RMS) and how vendor output gets folded into pricing. Hands-on experience is great but not required.
* You've seen benchmarking, limit adequacy work, and TCOR modeling used in real renewal conversations.
* You're comfortable with complex programs: layered placements, quota shares, deductibles, self-insured retentions, and captives.
* You can work across a lot of stakeholders at once: brokers, practice leaders, clients, and the technical team.

**Job Summary**

Precision ABA Therapy is seeking an experienced and motivated **Clinical Director (BCBA)** to oversee clinical assessment and insurance authorization processes for our Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy services.

The primary responsibilities of this position include conducting initial ABA assessments for new clients, developing individualized treatment plans, preparing and submitting insurance authorization requests, and ensuring timely completion of clinical documentation.

The ideal candidate will have strong clinical assessment skills, extensive knowledge of ABA treatment planning, and experience navigating insurance authorization requirements. This individual will play a key role in ensuring clients receive appropriate services while maintaining compliance with payer requirements, professional standards, and applicable regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**

Initial ABA Assessments

* Conduct initial ABA assessments for new clients, including comprehensive evaluations of developmental, behavioral, communication, adaptive, and functional skills, as appropriate.
* Complete functional behavior assessments when clinically indicated.
* Develop individualized ABA treatment plans based on assessment findings, client needs, and measurable treatment goals.
* Establish appropriate treatment recommendations, service intensity, and hours based on clinical necessity and assessment results.
* Prepare comprehensive assessment reports and supporting clinical documentation for insurance submission.
* Update treatment plans as required by insurance providers and applicable standards.
* Collaborate with parents, caregivers, and other professionals to gather relevant clinical information and support treatment planning.

Insurance Authorizations & Utilization Review

* Take primary responsibility for the ABA insurance authorization process.
* Prepare, submit, and track initial authorization requests for new clients.
* Complete and submit reauthorization requests, continued-service reviews, and requests for additional treatment hours.
* Ensure all authorization submissions include the required assessments, treatment plans, progress reports, and supporting documentation.
* Communicate with insurance companies, utilization review teams, and case managers regarding pending requests and clinical requirements.
* Monitor authorization expiration dates and submission deadlines to minimize interruptions in client services.
* Respond to requests for additional information and assist with peer-to-peer reviews, reconsiderations, and appeals when needed.
* Maintain accurate records of approved hours, authorization periods, submission dates, and authorization status.
* Review payer specific guidelines to ensure documentation meets medical necessity and coverage requirements.

Clinical Oversight, Session Note Reviews & Treatment Compliance

* Oversee the clinical review of ABA session notes to ensure documentation is accurate, complete, clinically appropriate, and compliant with insurance payer requirements.
* Review session notes submitted by BCBAs, RBTs, and other clinical staff to verify that services delivered align with authorized treatment plans and approved service hours.
* Ensure session documentation includes appropriate descriptions of interventions, client responses, progress toward treatment goals, and data collection, as applicable.
* Monitor compliance with treatment plan requirements, behavior intervention protocols, and individualized clinical recommendations.
* Verify that clinical documentation supports medical necessity and meets payer-specific billing and documentation standards.
* Identify incomplete, inaccurate, or noncompliant session notes and ensure corrections are completed within established deadlines.

**Skills**

* Previous experience as a Clinical Director, Clinical Supervisor, or Lead BCBA in an ABA therapy organization.
* Experience with commercial insurance plans and Medicaid ABA programs.
* Familiarity with functional behavior assessments, adaptive behavior assessments, and evidence based ABA treatment planning.
* Experience with peer-to-peer reviews, insurance denials, reconsiderations, and appeals.
* Experience coordinating clinical intake, assessments, and authorization workflows for new clients.
* Demonstrated experience conducting initial ABA assessments and developing individualized treatment plans.
* Experience preparing and submitting insurance authorizations for ABA therapy services.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assessments, authorization requests, and deadlines simultaneously.

We are looking for a dependable professional who takes ownership of their responsibilities and is committed to helping families access timely, high quality ABA services.

jobs.title: Analyst, Financial Asset Management
jobs.description:
The Analyst of Financial Asset Management is responsible for supporting day‑to‑day financial execution for the regional portfolio. This role focuses on portfolio maintenance, preparation of Investment Committee materials, and analytical support for asset management and transaction initiatives. The Analyst works closely with the Region Manager and Vice President, as well as the broader regional teams, to ensure financial models, reports, and materials are accurate, timely, and consistent, forming the foundation for effective regional decision‑making.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Portfolio Maintenance & Financial Data Management**

* Maintain asset‑level financial models used for forecasting, planning, and reporting
* Update models for leasing activity, capital expenditures, budget changes, and other asset‑level events
* Coordinate with property management and leasing teams to gather required inputs
* Perform routine data checks and reconciliations to identify errors, inconsistencies, or missing inputs

**IC Preparation & Support**

* Support preparation and updating of IC materials for the regional portfolio
* Populate models, tables, exhibits, and supporting analyses used in IC submissions
* Ensure IC materials are consistent with underlying models
* Incorporate feedback from the Manager accurately and efficiently

**Asset Management Project Support**

* Provide analytical support for approved asset management initiatives and projects
* Prepare ad‑hoc analyses and exhibits to support leasing, capital planning, and operational decisions

**Transaction Support**

* Support Transaction underwriting and diligence processes
* Develop asset-level Argus models for potential acquisition and disposition opportunities
* Refine acquisition underwriting models for transition into the Argus Financial Asset Management environment

**Reporting & Ongoing Analysis**

* Prepare recurring financial reports and summaries for regional and executive use
* Coordinate with Property Management to produce analyses that estimate recovery impact on incremental spend
* Be responsive to regional requests for ad hoc financial analysis

**Team & Process Support**

* Support Manager‑led workflows and recurring processes
* Build and leverage AI and PowerBI tools to improve team efficiency and decision-making
* Identify data gaps or process inefficiencies and raise them to the Manager

**Success Looks Like**

* Financial models and materials that are consistently accurate and well‑maintained
* IC analyses that require minimal rework at the Manager level
* Timely completion of recurring and ad‑hoc requests
* Strong attention to detail and responsiveness to feedback
* Dependable execution that enables Managers and Directors to operate efficiently

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required – finance, real estate, business, or economics major preferred
* Entry-level to one year of analyst experience
* Exposure to ARGUS preferred but not required
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word
* Ability to multi-task and work well in a team-focused environment
* Excellent communication and organizational skills
* Professional approach and demeanor

The base salary range for this position has been established as $75,000-$85,000 PLUS participation in our annual cash bonus plan. This salary range represents the Company’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.

Brixmor offers a hybrid work schedule (first three days of the week in the office, the balance remote optional), very competitive pay commensurate with background and responsibilities plus a benefits and perks package that supports career engagement, growth, good health and connection with teammates and our communities.

*EOE (Brixmor is an Equal Opportunity Employer)*

jobs.company: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey
jobs.title: HEDIS Data Quality Integrity Analyst
jobs.description:
**Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey** empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over **90 years**, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the **3.5 million** people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

**About the Role**

The role is a technical lead that requires deep knowledge, skills, and experience in designing and carrying out quality analytics. The incumbent for this position will design and implement a structured approach to data quality, ensuring our HEDIS data accurately reflects the health status of our members. The position is a key team member collaborating in a multi-disciplinary business environment with colleagues across the enterprise to lead quality performance analytics, development, and reporting that deliver actionable insights. As a subject matter expert, the role collects business requirements as per State, CMS, and NCQA specifications, translates business requirements into analytics design, define data & analytics specifications, manipulates and analyze large healthcare data from various data sources, and interpret the findings to inform opportunities and solutions that improve clinical quality and increase cost efficiency and health care affordability. This position requires advanced data analytic programming and coding skills with robust knowledge and understanding of the healthcare business and data.

**What You'll Do**

* Functions as the implementation lead for projects designed to improve HEDIS, Stars, accreditation and State performance.
* Functions as the vendor relationship owner (VRO) to vendors utilized intended to improve quality performance.
* Builds robust quality assurance criteria and processes to ensure regulatory reporting data is complete and accurate.
* Acts as the analytic liaison for complex clinical analytics projects involving multiple data resources and teams to inform business decisions in clinical, network, and value-based performance models.
* Understands the strategic direction of the organization and the analytic and reporting requirements to meet departmental needs. Translates business questions and needs into analytics technical requirements including data analytics design, clinical and data.
* Creates integrated analytic datasets and summarizes findings to inform business opportunities and address business questions. Provides insight and guidance into analytic findings (including root causes and contributing factors – both actionable and not) through clear, professional, succinct written and oral summaries, tables, charts, reports, or presentations.
* Navigates across multiple analytical and business units to socialize analytics design, results and interpretation, including making recommendations on how to use the results to inform business decisions.
* Documents methods, specifications and findings clearly. Collaborate with team members to document work appropriately, including SAS coding comments and use of analytic plan/timeline where needed for analytic projects.
* Presents analytics findings to internal leadership teams to inform actionable opportunities and solutions.
* Provides technical trainings (analytics design, data, programming, QA, statistics, documentation, etc.) to junior analysts.

**What You Bring**

**Education/Experience:**

* High School Diploma/GED required.
* Bachelor degree in Math, Statistics, Data Science, or Public Health preferred or relevant experience in lieu of degree.
* Requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in data analytics, HEDIS, SAS or related field.
* Requires a minimum of 5 years of experience performing analysis on healthcare data, HEDIS data or relational health care databases with significant experience analyzing medical, pharmacy and behavioral data.

**Knowledge:**

* Requires extensive knowledge of US healthcare industry, health plan business, claims data, clinical data, and coding practices.
* Prefers knowledge and working experience of visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau) with preference given to Tableau experience.

**Skills and Abilities:**

* **Strongly Prefers SAS, SQL and Python experience**
* Requires proficiency with MS Excel for data analysis and reporting.
* Requires solid organizational skills and attention to details.
* Requires strong ability to work in a fast-paced team-oriented environment and strong ability to manage competing priorities.
* Must be highly motivated and able to work independently.

**Why Horizon?**

At Horizon, you’ll do meaningful work that directly improves lives—while being supported by a mission‑driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and growth. We believe that when our people thrive, our communities do too. If you are passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

**Salary Range:**

$109,600 - $149,625

This compensation range is specific to the job level and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to: education, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity. This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Horizon at the time of posting. Compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. Horizon also provides a comprehensive compensation and benefits package which includes:

* Comprehensive health benefits (Medical/Dental/Vision)
* Retirement Plans
* Generous PTO
* Incentive Plans
* Wellness Programs
* Paid Volunteer Time Off
* Tuition Reimbursement

jobs.description:
This is an exciting opportunity for someone with strong data skills and a passion for sustainability to help map regulatory obligations, analyze packaging and sales data, and support reporting that drives compliance and environmental improvement across our business. You will collaborate with internal teams and external consultants to ensure accurate data collection, reporting, and insight generation.

Solstice Advanced Materials is looking for a **Data Analyst to** support our **Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)** program across the **EU and UK / US.**

You will collaborate with internal teams and external consultants to ensure accurate data collection, reporting, and insight generation.

This role can be located in Morris Plains, NJ or Geismar, LA.

  

**About Solstice Advanced Materials**

Solstice Advanced Materials is a leading global specialty materials company that advances science for smarter outcomes. Solstice offers high-performance solutions that enable critical industries and applications, including refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, healthcare packaging and more. Solstice is recognized for developing next-generation materials through some of the industry's most renowned brands such as Solstice®, Genetron®, Aclar®, Spectra®, Fluka™, and Hydranal™. Partnering with over 3,000 customers across more than 120 countries and territories and supported by a robust portfolio of over 5,700 patents, Solstice’s approximately 4,000 employees worldwide drive innovation in materials science. For more information, visit Advanced Materials .

  

***Key Responsibilities***

* Map and track EPR obligations across Solstice businesses in the EU and UK / across US States and Canada
* Collect, validate, and analyze packaging, sales, and environmental data
* Investigate and implement alternative compliant packaging types [ FF1] in partnership with Logistics and Manufacturing organizations
* Support regulatory reporting and monthly leadership reporting
* Maintain accurate data within EPR management systems and reporting tools
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities to improve data quality and compliance
* Work with stakeholders across the business to resolve data issues and improve processes
* Support audits, evidence gathering, and continuous improvement activities
* Help translate complex sustainability data into clear insights and actionable recommendations

  

**Must Have**

* Degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Sustainability, Data Analytics, or a related field
* Strong analytical skills and confidence working with large datasets, Excel and PowerPoint
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to communicate insights clearly
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities
* Interest in sustainability, environmental compliance, and circular economy topics

**We Value**

* Exposure to EPR, packaging compliance, or environmental reporting
* Familiarity with UK pEPR, EU PPWR, or related US and Canadian legislation
* Knowledge of sustainability frameworks such as GHG accounting, ESG reporting, and SBTi

**U.S. PERSON REQUIREMENTS**

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.

**COMPENSATION**

The annual base salary range for this position is **$87762k-$109703.** Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Solstice Advanced Materials considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities or the position, the candidate's work experience education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

**BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR SOLSTICE ADVANCED MATERIALS**

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Solstice Advanced Materials employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer-subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. jobs.title: Corporate Governance and Entity Management Analyst
jobs.description:
**Corporate Governance and Entity Management Analyst**

**About the Role**

As a member of the Service Delivery team within the Global Legal, Compliance & Regulatory organization, you will support AIG's global corporate governance and entity management activities. This role serves as a key partner to Corporate Secretary, Legal, and business stakeholders, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of corporate records, supporting governance processes, and managing entity lifecycle events across a complex global organization.

The role also acts as the primary administrator for AIG's entity management platform, leveraging technology and data to enable efficient governance, reporting, and compliance activities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Corporate Governance & Entity Management**

* Support global entity management activities, including entity formation, dissolution, restructuring, officer and director changes, and other lifecycle events.
* Maintain accurate corporate records and entity information to support governance and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Partner with Corporate Secretary, Legal, and executive stakeholders to support governance-related activities and special projects.
* Assist with board and committee governance processes, including document management and meeting support.
* Monitor and maintain compliance with corporate governance policies and entity reporting requirements.
* Serve as a subject matter resource on entity management processes and best practices.

**Systems Administration & Reporting**

* Act as primary administrator for AIG's entity management platform, ensuring data integrity, quality, and system functionality.
* Manage production, quality assurance, and delivery of governance and entity management reporting.
* Analyze entity data, identify inconsistencies, and implement sustainable solutions to improve data quality.
* Partner with technology teams and business stakeholders to identify and implement process improvements and system enhancements.
* Lead user acceptance testing, platform upgrades, maintenance releases, and reporting enhancements.
* Maintain technical and process documentation and provide support for user inquiries and system-related issues.
* Support board management technology platforms in partnership with technology teams and governance stakeholders.

**Qualifications:**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Experience supporting corporate governance, corporate secretary, or entity management functions within a legal department, law firm, financial services organization, or other regulated environment.
* Experience managing corporate records, entity lifecycle events, and governance documentation.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interact professionally with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.

Support the implementation and maintenance of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework in alignment with strategic objectives and regulatory requirements. * Develop reporting, including managing underlying data point and analysis.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations.

jobs.description:
**About AKAM**

Founded in 1983, AKAM provides comprehensive management services to condominiums, cooperatives, homeowners associations, and investment properties. Through financial oversight, operations management, compliance administration, and violation resolution, we help maximize operational efficiency and value for our clients.

**What We Offer**

AKAM is proud to be Great Place to Work-Certified™. We offer healthcare, dental, and vision options; a retirement program; paid time off; 11 paid holidays annually; educational reimbursement; transportation discount programs; service and performance awards; and social and recreational activities. Learn more at akam.com.

**Position Summary**

The Financial Analyst manages accounting and financial reporting for an assigned portfolio of condominium and cooperative communities throughout New York City, typically consisting of 30 or more buildings. This role prepares accurate and timely monthly and annual financial statements, develops budgets and cash flow projections, and provides analysis to support each community’s financial goals.

Working closely with property managers and board members, the Financial Analyst serves as a key financial resource, explaining financial results, responding to inquiries, and supporting informed decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Accounting and Financial Reporting*

* Manage general ledger accounting for an assigned portfolio of condominium and cooperative properties.
* Prepare and review monthly and annual financial statements, including supporting schedules and reports.
* Review general ledgers and trial balances, investigate discrepancies, and prepare necessary journal entries and adjustments.
* Apply the appropriate accounting basis for each property, including accruals and other adjustments where applicable.
* Prepare custom financial reports and cash flow projections to support property-level planning.

*Budgeting and Financial Analysis*

* Prepare annual operating budgets in collaboration with property managers and board members.
* Analyze budget-to-actual results, investigate variances, and provide clear explanations to property managers and boards.
* Monitor each property’s financial position and communicate cash flow needs and other financial considerations.

*Board and Property Manager Support*

* Serve as a financial point of contact for property managers, board treasurers, and board presidents.
* Explain financial statements, budgets, and operating results, and respond to financial inquiries promptly and accurately.
* Present budgets and financial information to boards as needed.
* Coordinate the investment of client funds in accordance with board direction and established procedures.

*Property Transitions and Audit Support*

* Review financial records for properties transitioning to AKAM to confirm required documentation is complete and funds are transferred appropriately.
* Assist with annual audits by preparing supporting schedules, providing documentation, and responding to auditor inquiries.

**Requirements and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
* Two to three years of public accounting experience.
* Two years of financial analyst or property accounting experience in the real estate or property management industry.
* Direct experience preparing and reviewing monthly financial statements for condominium and cooperative properties.
* Strong knowledge of general ledger accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, variance analysis, and cash flow forecasting.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage deadlines across multiple properties.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain financial information clearly to property managers and board members.
* Experience with BJ Murray or Yardi is a plus.

jobs.title: Lead Product Analyst, Content Supply & Understanding
jobs.description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

**Culture at Scribd, Inc.**
---------------------------

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

**The team.** Data & Analytics at Scribd brings together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Product Analytics to turn fragmented data and inconsistent definitions into trusted foundations, and to build AI-assisted tools that bring reliable intelligence into how teams make decisions.

**The role.** This role supports Content Supply & Understanding, the team that owns Scribd’s library of more than 400 million documents, which reaches over 250 million monthly active users. The team’s remit covers who contributes the content, how well we understand it, and how it reaches users. You will report to the Senior Manager, Data Analytics, and work embedded alongside Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering partners. The role is open at the Senior and Lead levels, and we will level based on the experience you bring. At the Senior level you own analytical workstreams within a defined area. At the Lead level you also set the measurement strategy for the area, take on the most open-ended problems, and raise the bar for the analysts around you.

**Mandate.** Make it possible to say with confidence what is in the corpus, where it falls short of what users look for, and whether enrichment is making content easier to find and use, with numbers that stay comparable as content sources, models, and pipelines change.

**Core philosophy.** A metric definition is a shared artifact. We care about documentation, versioning, and data quality as much as the readout on top, because a number that quietly breaks upstream is worse than no number at all.

**About you**
-------------

* You are at your best when the question is not yet well formed. You look at an incomplete picture, work out what matters, and produce an answer a product team can act on, with the limits of the evidence stated plainly.
* You are equally comfortable as the strategist and the analyst. You can size an opportunity, model its return, write the SQL behind the metric, and defend the number in a room full of product and executive leaders.
* You are skeptical by default. When a metric moves sharply, your instinct is to find the field or pipeline that changed before you write the narrative.
* You are pragmatic. You ask what the right next version is, and you use AI where it creates measurable value.
* You communicate early and plainly, and you write things down. Methodology and metric documentation are part of the deliverable.

**You will**
------------

* Build measurement for content understanding. Define how we measure classification and metadata coverage, accuracy, and the effect of enrichment on discovery and engagement.
* Own analytics for content supply and generate insights on where the corpus falls short: size the gap between user demand and the corpus, estimate the value of closing it, and help prioritize where to invest, using the same market sizing, segmentation, and ROI methods applied in go-to-market analysis.
* Partner with Product Managers on strategy and roadmap. Translate product bets into success and guardrail metrics, size opportunities, and make trade-offs explicit.
* Design and read experiments (A/B tests and other methods) for content-related product changes, from hypothesis through analysis and readout.
* Define and maintain the KPIs, metric definitions, and dashboards for the content domain, and work with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering on instrumentation and data quality so that metrics stay consistent over time.
* Investigate discontinuities and anomalies in content data, and separate real changes in user behavior from pipeline, definition, or instrumentation changes.
* Use AI-assisted workflows to speed up analysis and reporting, document how results are validated, and keep AI tools grounded as definitions change.
* Present findings and recommendations to product, engineering, and executive audiences, including in regular metrics reviews.
* At the Lead level: set analytical standards for the area and mentor other analysts.

**You have**
------------

* 4+ years of experience in product analytics or a closely related role for Senior, or 7+ years for Lead, with a record of influencing product or business decisions.
* Experience turning ambiguous, loosely defined questions into analysis that changed a decision, in areas where data is sparse or metrics did not yet exist.
* Experience with opportunity sizing, segmentation, or business and go-to-market analysis, such as market sizing, pipeline prioritization, or ROI modeling.
* Advanced SQL,

With over 50 years of serving the creative community, Adorama has grown from a beloved New York City camera store into the world's only full-service destination for photo, video, and electronics. **What You'll Do**

  

The Inventory Planning & Data Analyst will combine hands-on inventory planning, SQL, business intelligence, and reporting automation to improve product availability, strengthen purchasing decisions, and optimize inventory investment.

Reporting to the Head of Inventory and Demand Planning and working directly with Merchants, you will investigate inventory, demand, and supply issues, identify root causes, and turn findings into actionable SKU-level recommendations. You will independently build dashboards and analytical tools, own recurring analysis and replenishment reviews, and follow corrective actions through resolution within established planning policies and purchasing authority.

This role offers direct exposure to initiatives in forecast optimization, warehouse distribution, lead time, and excess inventory management, with opportunities to improve how the team uses data and reduce recurring manual work.

* Merchant Support and Inventory Decisions

* Replenishment and PO Execution
  + Review daily replenishment and PO needs against established inventory and WOS targets, run-rate, lead time, available inventory, open POs, backorders, and demand trends to control purchasing and avoid excess inventory.
  + Validate system recommendations before execution, especially for high-velocity, high-value, long-lead-time items and SKUs with demand spikes or overstock risk.
  + Release purchase orders within approved authority and follow up with vendors on past-due POs, delivery changes, and supply constraints.
  + Monitor backorders and stockout risk; escalate issues affecting availability, inventory exposure, or merchant goals and track corrective actions through resolution.

* BI Dashboards and Planning Analytics
  + Independently build, maintain, and enhance inventory and planning dashboards in Looker, including data preparation, calculated metrics, filters, and reporting validation.
  + Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, join, aggregate, and validate sales, demand, inventory, item master, and PO data.
  + Monitor dashboard refreshes and reporting accuracy; reconcile outputs with source data and troubleshoot discrepancies with BI and technical partners.
  + Automate recurring reporting and build exception dashboards that prioritize stockout risk, aged inventory, overstock, backorders, past-due POs, demand anomalies, and data gaps; highlight affected SKUs, investigation priorities, recommended actions, and follow-up owners.
  + Maintain reporting that monitors inventory, WOS, and aged inventory against established targets; verify their correct application in replenishment and PO review, investigate variances, and recommend corrective actions for approval.
  + Support approved initiatives in forecast optimization, warehouse distribution and transfers, slow-moving and excess inventory reporting, and lead time and customer ETA reporting through data validation, analysis, and follow-up.

* Root Cause Analysis and Planning Data Accuracy
  + Work with Merchants and Item Master to keep planning-related item fields accurate and updated promptly; identify missing, outdated, or incorrect attributes affecting replenishment and reporting.
  + Follow up on item setup and planning feed issues that create inaccurate recommendations, reporting gaps, or poor inventory decisions.
  + Investigate flagged exceptions involving aged inventory, overstock, past-due POs, backorders, planning overrides, unusual demand, and data gaps to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.
  + Perform root-cause analysis to identify demand shifts, vendor delays, lead time changes, PO timing issues, item setup errors, or execution gaps; recommend practical corrective actions.
  + Account for promotions, one-time sales spikes, new items, vendor transitions, and opportunity buys when evaluating planning recommendations.

  + Coordinate with Vendors, Item Master, Warehouse Operations, Finance, and BI to resolve inventory issues; own related JIRA tickets from intake through closure.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

  
  
  

**Excited to grow your career?**

  
  

We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!

Our people make all the difference in our success.

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

The Production Management organization provides business critical application management and support for our Services, Markets, Banking, USCC, Wealth and Functions clients globally.

Join our Stability Governance team as a Lead Analyst (VP), a key role within the broader horizontal Optimization and Enablement function dedicated to strengthening our entire Production Management landscape. This position offers a meaningful opportunity to actively contribute to and drive critical stability governance initiatives and frameworks. As Production Management evolves its operating model through AI capabilities and intelligent automation, this role plays an important part in that transformation. We are seeking a proactive individual with a solid understanding of Production Management, Risk Management, and Data Analysis, eager to apply their expertise within the complex and highly regulated environment of the banking sector. Your contributions will be instrumental in ensuring the resilience and optimal performance of our vital systems.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  
  

* Generate, own, and present comprehensive monthly stability metrics and reports for diverse business units, leveraging data analysis and visualization to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for Production Management stakeholders.
* Establish, monitor, and continuously refine key performance indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for application stability, ensuring alignment with enterprise risk appetite and business objectives.
* Actively leverage artificial intelligence and automation tools to reduce manual toil, streamline reporting workflows, and enhance the efficiency of stability governance operations.
* Identify, implement, and champion stability best practices and engineering standards to drive continuous service improvement across the technology landscape.
* Conduct in-depth thematic analysis of stability data, identifying key trends, systemic patterns, and providing well-evidenced, actionable recommendations for preventative and corrective measures.
* Support and contribute to the Focus and Intensive Care application improvement programs, working alongside senior application owners to help develop and track remediation plans for high-risk systems.
* Participate in the review and attestation processes for critical stability artifacts (e.g., Priority Matrices, Change Risk Index, Market Event Management), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Lead initiatives focused on improving data quality, streamlining reporting processes, and proactively driving continuous improvement activities that enhance stability governance products and frameworks.
* Contribute to and help manage high-priority initiatives, coordinating across teams, tracking progress, and ensuring timely delivery. Manage ad-hoc requests and project contributions as required.
* Participate actively in advancing the Production Management strategy, contributing ideas and analysis to support the function's ongoing transformation.
  

  

**Required Skills**

  
  

* 6-10 years of experience in IT governance, production support, data analysis, or risk management within the banking or financial services industry.
* Prior exposure to ITIL practices, production management frameworks, or SRE principles is beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively, lead workstreams, and influence cross-functional team

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

**How does this role contribute to our collective success?**  
Data, analytics and AI are critical enablers of AXIS' strategic ambitions. The Insights & Analytics Lead – North America will be a hands-on technical leader who turns business questions into high-quality insights, analytical solutions and clear recommendations for North American underwriting teams.  
This role is responsible for translating business requirements into well-defined data, analytics, data science and AI requirements. You will explore and analyse large and complex data sets, identify trends and opportunities, determine the most appropriate analytical approach, and communicate conclusions in ways that support better, faster and more informed decisions.  
Working within an agile delivery model, you will partner closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Architects and Technology experts to design, test and deliver solutions that are practical, scalable and aligned to measurable business outcomes.  
Reporting to the Insights & Analytics Director – North America, you will combine technical depth, business understanding and strong delivery skills. You will provide day-to-day technical leadership on initiatives while remaining personally involved in analysis, solution design and the development of analytical outputs.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Translate Business Needs into Analytical and AI Requirements  
  Partner with North American underwriting and business teams to understand business objectives, decision points, pain points and opportunities.

Imperial Brady, a leading North American distributor, has a Contract Compensation Analyst role available in North Bergen, NJ reporting to the Director of Compensation! The analyst will evaluate and analyze compensation elements of our total rewards package to ensure we provide a competitive and equitable program and will also assist in developing and implementing compensation programs that are fair, competitive, and align with the company’s business goals. This is a hybrid position with 4 days in office and 1 day remote.
  
Imperial Brady is the leading independently owned and operated distributor of foodservice packaging and janitorial supplies in North America. As a provider of customized supply chain solutions, we serve customers in many business-to-business market segments including restaurants, grocery stores, healthcare, sports and entertainment, and cruise lines.
  
  
**You will:**

* Participate in salary surveys and analyze data from survey sources to determine internal and external competitiveness.
* Assist with year-end compensation processes, including merit and incentives, data audits, communications, and processing.
* Assist with variable pay design, analysis, payment calculation, and budget modeling.

* Proficiency with compensation market pricing and survey tools, including Salary.com CompAnalyst or comparable benchmarking platforms.
* Knowledge of compensation practices supporting both hourly and salaried employee populations across multiple job families and organizational levels.

* Extensive knowledge of quantitative, qualitative, and research methods.
